title: Director - Residential & Commercial | Real Estate | Asset Management
description:
Overview Of The Role:


The Director – Resi Comm+ is responsible for leading the strategic and operational performance of Al-Futtaim Real Estate’s residential and commercial portfolio, driving asset value growth, revenue optimization, and tenant satisfaction. The role oversees asset management, leasing, tenant mix, service charge governance, and capital improvement initiatives while ensuring sustainable financial performance and effective stakeholder management across the portfolio.


What You Will Do:


Strategic Asset Management & Portfolio Planning

  • Develop and execute asset strategies tailored to DFC and AFRE's residential and commercial assets, aligned with long-term financial goals and investment mandates.
  • Drive annual business planning processes, performance benchmarking, and asset repositioning strategies across all asset classes.
  • Increase in Net Operating Income (NOI).
  • Delivery of approved annual and 5-year asset plans.
  • Asset valuation growth based on external and internal benchmarking.

P&L Accountability

  • Manage the full profit and loss statement of each residential and commercial asset, including income, cost controls, service recovery, and profitability tracking.
  • Drive the creation of asset-level budgets, forecasts, and capital expenditure plans in collaboration with Finance.
  • Ensure budget compliance and variance control.
  • Meet or exceed revenue targets across the portfolio.
  • Timely and accurate reporting of monthly and quarterly financials.

Residential & Commercial Leasing Strategy

  • Lead commercial leasing initiatives across retail and office segments in DFC and ARE projects, ensuring optimal occupancy, market-aligned rents, and long-term tenant satisfaction.
  • Define and monitor the residential leasing and sales strategy with a focus on tenant retention, unit absorption, and product-market alignment.
  • Maintain high occupancy rates by asset and segment.
  • Achieve renewal success rates and churn reduction.
  • Optimize average rental yield and tenant mix.

Tenant Relationship & Community Management

  • Serve as a senior point of contact for VIP tenants and commercial lease partners.
  • Establish and act upon tenant feedback loops to support tenant retention and service excellence.
  • Achieve high tenant satisfaction and net promoter scores (NPS).
  • Resolve tenant issues within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Secure long-term lease renewals of strategic tenants.

Property and Facilities Management Oversight

  • Oversee the performance of in-house and outsourced facilities management teams, ensuring assets meet operational KPIs, health and safety standards, and maintenance SLAs.
  • Align operational services with asset class needs, tenant expectations, and cost-efficiency mandates.
  • Ensure AMC contract compliance and SLA delivery.
  • Monitor downtime metrics for critical systems such as HVAC and elevators.
  • Enhance service issue resolution and preventive maintenance scores.

Capital Projects, Lifecycle Planning & ROI Management

  • Lead planning and execution of major capital improvements, refurbishments, and lifecycle upgrades across all properties.
  • Prepare business cases for Capex approval, tracking performance through KPIs and ROI metrics.
  • Ensure timely and on-budget delivery of capital projects.
  • Achieve positive ROI on Capex investments.
  • Improve building quality and asset competitiveness.

Service Charge Structuring, Recovery & Transparency

  • Oversee the development and auditing of service charge budgets in coordination with Finance and FM, ensuring transparency and recoverability.
  • Ensure compliance with RERA and relevant strata management regulations.
  • Achieve high annual service charge recovery rates.
  • Maintain audit compliance and reconciliation timelines.
  • Enhance tenant satisfaction with cost transparency.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Benchmarking

  • Monitor real estate market trends, competitor positioning, and regulatory changes to inform pricing, leasing, and asset repositioning decisions.
  • Actively engage with brokers, research agencies, and industry events.
  • Ensure market-aligned pricing and product positioning.
  • Benchmark performance against peer assets.
  • Develop updated strategic responses to regulatory or market shifts.

Team Leadership & People Development

  • Provide strategic direction and leadership to the asset management team responsible for residential and commercial properties across Dubai Festival City and AFRE’s broader portfolio.
  • Guide, mentor, and develop high-performing professionals including property managers, leasing specialists, and analysts.
  • Ensure alignment with organizational goals and foster a culture of performance, accountability, and collaboration.
  • Lead by example in cross-functional coordination with Finance, Legal, Facilities Management, and Development teams.
  • Achieve effective cross-functional collaboration and project delivery outcomes.


Skills

Required Skills To Be Successful:


  • Strategic financial and commercial acumen with P&L accountability.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple assets.
  • Sound understanding of leasing, FM operations, and capital planning.


What Qualifies You For The Role:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or MSc in Real Estate or Asset Management) preferred.
  • 20+ years of experience in asset and property management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing large mixed-use portfolios.
  • Proven record of managing income-producing residential and commercial real estate assets.
  • Strong exposure to the UAE or GCC market essential.
  • Experience in design input, lease structuring, and service charge governance.
  • Experience in freehold properties advantageous.

title: Director - Interior Design | Real Estate | Asset Development
description:
Overview Of The Role:


The Director – Interior Design is responsible for providing creative and technical leadership across all interior design projects, developing overall design concepts and ensuring a consistent design vision and quality standard. The role oversees the full interior design lifecycle, from pre-concept and concept development through detailed design, FF&E selection, construction documentation and project delivery, including the selection and management of design consultants.

The Director will also lead the development and continuous improvement of Al-Futtaim Real Estate’s interior design standards, providing technical guidance across both new developments and existing properties to ensure design quality, consistency and alignment with the organisation’s vision.


What You Will Do:

  • Lead the interior design function and projects from concept development to completion, handling different design phases and managing multiple projects with a clear and coherent design process.
  • Develop the Interior Design brand standards and guidelines in line with Al-Futtaim Properties vision and standards.
  • Create guidelines, design and technical standards, and specifications of FF&E and OS&E for the family.
  • Lead interior design projects, ensuring layouts, detailed drawings, and FF&E specifications meet unified schemes according to the program.
  • Maintain current knowledge of trends in materials, techniques, and other developments in interior design.
  • Assess the market, define specific requirements, set qualification criteria, and recommend selection of designers.
  • Define design scope and contribute to creating and managing design agreements and contracts, controlling design costs.
  • Verify and procure acceptable design documentation for each design stage.
  • Lead periodic on-site observations during construction to monitor compliance with plans and ensure the final product meets initial requests.
  • Represent Al-Futtaim Real Estate in meetings reviewing interior design proposals, contracts, and mock-ups.
  • Monitor the implementation of departmental KPIs and motivate teams of interior designers to use their talents effectively.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


Skills

Required Skills To Be Successful:

  • Extensive experience in interior design, with in-depth knowledge of FF&E, materials, finishes, and space planning.
  • Experience working in a client-side role or with leading interior design consultancies, overseeing the full design lifecycle from concept development through to project completion is essential.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to effectively engage and manage a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Lead, develop and manage the Interior Design team to ensure high-quality design delivery.


What Qualifies You For The Role:


  • Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or a relevant subject.
  • 15+ years of experience in high-end or large-scale residential and hospitality projects, with at least 5 years in a leadership position.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable standards, regulations, and procedures.

title: Quality Technical Specialist – Customer Quality & Locomotive Testing
description:
The Quality Technical Specialist provides strategic leadership for Customer Quality, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), and Locomotive Testing Quality, ensuring product compliance with customer, regulatory, and organizational requirements while optimizing Cost of Quality. The role is accountable for driving quality excellence through robust quality systems, defect prevention, reliability improvement, and continuous process enhancement.

As a key quality Specialist, the incumbent leads a team of Quality Inspectors and partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Program Management, Service Quality, Reliability, and Supplier Quality teams to achieve world-class product quality, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead Customer Quality, PDI, and Locomotive Testing Quality activities to ensure flawless product build Quality and and customer satisfaction.
  • Champion a First-Time-Right culture through rigorous testing, inspection, documentation, and process discipline.
  • Drive structured RCA, CAPA, and defect prevention strategies for manufacturing, reliability, and field quality issues.
  • Ensure effective management and closure of NCMRs, quality escapes, audit findings, and corrective actions.
  • Maintain compliance with QMS, ISO standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish and continuously improve inspection, testing, and detection plans across incoming, in-process, and finished product stages.
  • Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives focused on product reliability, process capability, and operational excellence.
  • Drive the vision of Zero Defects, Zero Customer Escapes, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Develop organizational capability through coaching, auditing, training, and implementation of quality best practices.
  • Promote strong EHS and compliance standards across all quality activities.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Mechanical Engineering
  • 12–16 years of progressive experience in Complex Products testing, troubleshooting and Customer Quality, preferably from Locomotive or Rolling Stock, Heavy Machinery, or related industry
  • Strong technical expertise in locomotive systems, troubleshooting, testing and manufacturing processes
  • Demonstrated experience with APQP, PPAP, NPI, Problem Solving and customer quality management
  • Qualified Process Auditor with working knowledge of ISO and QMS
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent problem-solving and continuous improvement experience

Leadership Competencies

  • Customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on quality and reliability
  • Proven ability to lead teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Effective communicator with excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills
  • Results-oriented, data-driven, and committed to operational excellence

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: System Administrator - Privacy
description:
Who we are: 
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.
We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.
Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on, technically driven Privacy Systems Analyst to own Rover's privacy technology platform stack. You'll be the technical operator behind our privacy compliance program: configuring, integrating, troubleshooting, and maintaining our privacy management platform and the systems connected to it.
You'll partner closely with the GRC team, who own the program-level requirements, and make sure what compliance defines, the platform reliably delivers. We're especially looking for someone with a strong instinct for automating manual work, including with AI tooling, and the technical depth to keep the privacy stack performing at scale.
 This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

What You'll Do:
Own the privacy platform: configure and maintain workflows, assessments, consent management, DSAR automation, and reporting. Be the go-to person when something isn't working.
Coordinate consent and marketing preferences: support opt-in/opt-out workflows with Marketing, Legal, and Engineering; ensure preference signals are captured, synced, and enforced correctly downstream; troubleshoot gaps between what's configured and what's actually enforced.
Manage integrations and APIs: own the API surface connecting the privacy platform to other Rover systems, including authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
Handle DSARs end to end: ensure connectors fire correctly, monitor success rates, and resolve errors that block fulfillment.
Keep RoPA and Data Map accurate: maintain connectors, validate data inventory, and onboard new sources.
Lead new integrations: act as technical lead on integration projects, from design through go-live.
Support incident response: partner with Cybersecurity on privacy/security incidents, owning platform-level triage and technical evidence collection.
Build AI-driven automation: identify manual, repetitive work (DSAR intake, RoPA upkeep, documentation, vendor tickets) and build AI-assisted workflows to reduce it, always with human review for compliance-sensitive output.
Document and mentor: keep configurations, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides current; support more junior team members.
Own the vendor relationship: raise and manage technical escalations with evidence, and engage vendor professional services only when the work genuinely exceeds in-house capability.

What You'll Need:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2-5 years administering SaaS platforms, with experience leading moderately complex projects
Hands-on experience with an enterprise privacy management platform (consent management, DSAR automation, data discovery)
Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth/API keys, webhooks, and integration troubleshooting
Understanding of SaaS architecture: environments, sandbox-to-production, change management
Strong independent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
Clear communication, especially with non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable working autonomously and knowing when to escalate
Practical, hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to automate workflows, draft documentation, or accelerate troubleshooting

Nice to Have:
Vendor certifications (OneTrust, Ketch, DataGrail, TrustArc, or similar)
Cloud fundamentals certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
GDPR/CCPA or global privacy regulation awareness
Scripting experience (Python, JavaScript)
IAM/SSO knowledge
Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) or calling LLM APIs directly
Awareness of AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001)

Benefits of Working at Rover.com:
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office

Compensation:
In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €38,946 - €47,207. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

They direct teams on what features the product will have and support the adoption of the product within our clients and thus need to understand the telecoms and enterprise domain to make sound decisions.

title: Ecosystem Coordinator
description:
Would you enjoy working closely with different actors in the Tiko ecosystem to help solve any issues or answer any questions that they may have? Continue reading to find out more about our Ecosystem Coordinator role in Kenya!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJYCIChXdKE).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_We are hiring a Makueni-based Ecosystem Coordinator with proven experience working within the local ecosystem._

The Job

The Ecosystem Coordinator will work closely with all actors across Tiko Ecosystems to tackle any first-line non-technical questions they may have. You and your team will also visit ecosystems across the county to do regular in-person checkups with actors.

You'll also be responsible for:

- Responding to questions asked by actors across ecosystems via phone, internet and other sources. You'll solve any issues within your capabilities and escalate any other issues to the right internal team.
- Ensuring that branding has been done correctly at each actor, and providing support where you identify compliance issues.
- Coordinating activities with other field teams to ensure work runs smoothly and effectively.
- Identifying, preventing and responding to, and mitigating any kind of fraud in any ecosystem that you work in. This will involve flagging and reporting any suspicious activity or breaches of our code of conduct and standard operating procedures.
- Mapping and setting up new Tiko ecosystems and finding and contracting all new actors

About you

title: Director of the Photon Science Institute
description:
**Director of the Photon Science Institute**

**Shape our research vision. Strengthen collaboration. Lead world-class photon science.**

The University of Manchester is seeking an outstanding academic leader to become Director of the Photon Science Institute.

Our Manchester 2035 strategy, From Manchester for the World, sets a bold direction for the University. This is an opportunity to lead a distinctive interdisciplinary research community, build on its international reputation and ensure that our facilities, expertise and partnerships continue to enable outstanding science with real-world impact.

**The opportunity**

As Director, you will provide strategic academic leadership for the Photon Science Institute, shaping its future direction and leading the development and delivery of its strategy. Working closely with colleagues across the Faculty of Science and Engineering and the wider University, you will bring together researchers, professional services and technical teams around a shared vision for the Institute.

You will lead the evolution of the PSI to achieve greater research success, including the quality and impact of its outputs, research income, industrial collaboration and international reputation. You will support the development of ambitious multidisciplinary funding proposals and strengthen partnerships with UKRI, the EU, government, industry and other external organisations.

The PSI brings together world-leading facilities and expertise across quantum devices, advanced characterisation and the electromagnetic spectrum, enabling researchers to investigate everything from ultrafast processes to nanoscale material interactions. Its mission is delivered through three core themes: Quantum Technology, Net Zero and Sustainability, and Healthcare.

A central priority will be ensuring that the Institute’s facilities, resources and expertise are used effectively and sustainably. You will help shape investment and research priorities, support financially responsible access to facilities for internal and external users and ensure that the PSI operates safely and in line with University policies and regulatory requirements.

Alongside this, you will build an inclusive and engaged community in which colleagues and students can thrive. You will support researcher development at every career stage, strengthen succession planning and encourage collaboration across disciplinary and organisational boundaries.

**About you**

You will bring an outstanding academic track record in an area relevant to the PSI, together with substantial experience of leading research activity in a complex academic environment. You will have a strong portfolio of research funding and evidence of developing successful strategic partnerships, including collaboration with industry.

You will be an experienced and collegiate leader, able to engage and motivate academics, researchers, technical specialists and professional services colleagues. You will have led cross-disciplinary activity and know how to create the conditions in which ambitious research and innovation can succeed.

An effective communicator and relationship builder, you will be able to establish credibility, influence across organisational boundaries and navigate competing priorities. You will combine strategic thinking with a practical approach to delivery and be comfortable leading change in consultation with the communities affected by it.

You will also bring a strong understanding of higher education governance, academic structures and regulatory requirements, together with a clear commitment to inclusion, academic freedom, sustainability and social responsibility.

**Why Manchester?**

You will join a University with a globally recognised research profile, a strong commitment to interdisciplinary working and an ambition to tackle major societal challenges through research, innovation and partnership.

For an academic leader with vision, credibility and a commitment to collaborative research, this is an opportunity to shape the future of the Photon Science Institute, strengthen its national and international influence and support scientific discovery with impact within and beyond the University.

**Find out more**

Please see the link to the **[Candidate Brochure](https://documents.manchester.ac.uk/display.aspx?DocID=81121)** and job description, attached below, for further information about the role and selection criteria.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact [talent.attraction@manchester.ac.uk](mailto:talent.attraction@manchester.ac.uk) so that we can discuss how best to support you.

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
6-month internship: TypeScript, Next.js & agents. Hybrid, starting December 2026 to February 2027.


About Influentials

Influentials is a creator marketing platform and managed service built to help brands scale creator content. More than 16,000 creators are directly connected and verified on our platform, and more than 500 brands, including McDonald's, Disney, Samsung, ALDI and Volvo, have run over 5,000 campaigns with us. We're headquartered in Rotterdam, Netherlands and building our tech hub in Marseille, France.

How we build

AI is both how we build and what we build. We practise agentic engineering on a modern TypeScript stack: AI agents write most of the code, and humans specify and review everything that goes live. We merge hundreds of PRs each month, and our velocity keeps accelerating. We're not tied to one tool (Claude Code today, Codex before), and we adopt new practices as they land, like cloud coding agents and agent loops. The job is changing fast right now, and you'll learn it with us.

Over the coming months, we're building what comes next for brands and creators, and we're looking for a full-stack intern to build it with us.

What you'll work on

This is an internship: you're here to learn. You'll work alongside the CTO and contribute to real features in production, used by thousands of creators and by brands. Depending on timing and what you enjoy, that can include:

  • AI agents that run campaigns. Agents that propose a shortlist of creators, draft the brief and follow up with creators, while a campaign manager approves each step. We already have a creator-review agent in production and a cockpit to track what agents do and what they cost.

  • The brand app. New features for brands in our Next.js app, including an AI assistant that helps a brand write its campaign brief.

  • A Claude connector (MCP) for brands. Brands connect Claude to their Influentials account and ask questions about their campaigns. The same architecture already runs internally: our whole team uses Claude on top of the Hub every day.

  • The mobile app (Expo / React Native). Push notifications, live messaging and the first store releases.

  • Scraping social platforms. Scrapers that collect public creator profiles and their content at scale, and the pipelines that clean and store that data.

  • Creator analytics. Our own AI analysis of what creators publish (themes, brand safety, brand affinity), built into an in-house analytics tool.

With the CTO's support, you'll take part in every step of a feature: spec, code, tests, review, release, then watching it in production with Sentry and PostHog. This is AI engineering, not machine learning: agents, AI features, tools, prompts and evals built on top of existing LLMs. No model training.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with Matthieu, our CTO, in Marseille: specs, code reviews and architecture discussions, every day. Matthieu cares as much about business and product as about code, so you'll also learn why we build what we build. The rest of the team is in Rotterdam: weekly video calls with sales, campaign management and product, in English, with no travel needed. You'll be one of the first people in our Marseille tech hub, with a real scope and someone next to you to help you get there.

Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript · React 19 · Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components) · Tailwind / shadcn/ui

  • Backend: tRPC · Zod · Prisma · MySQL 8.4 on AWS RDS

  • Background jobs: Inngest (durable workflows, crons, fan-out)

  • AI: LLM APIs through the Vercel AI SDK · MCP servers

  • Mobile: Expo / React Native

  • Payments & auth: Stripe Connect · Better Auth

  • Infra: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo · Vercel · AWS (RDS, S3, EC2) · Docker · GitHub Actions CI

  • Quality & observability: Vitest · Sentry · PostHog

  • Tooling: Claude Code · Codex · GitHub · Linear

Plus a legacy PHP API that we're migrating to TypeScript, piece by piece.


Who we're looking for

  • A final-year student (Master's or engineering school) in computer science / software engineering, looking for a 6-month internship: end-of-studies internship, or an internship abroad as part of your degree.

  • You've built and shipped things with TypeScript and Node.js, plus React or another JavaScript frontend framework such as Vue or Angular: school projects, side projects, open source or a previous internship. Show us.

  • You already use AI coding tools, and you have opinions on when not to trust them.

  • You read code carefully. Writing code is fast now; judgement and quality are the skills that matter.

  • You're comfortable working in English (weekly calls with the Rotterdam team). Day to day in Marseille, we speak French or English, whichever you prefer.

Nice to have: React Native / Expo, SQL, experience with LLM APIs or agents, a project with real users.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

Practical details

  • 6 months, starting between December 2026 and February 2027

  • Based in a coworking space in Marseille, with a sea view. Flexible hybrid: around 2 days of remote work a week. We care about what you ship, not the hours you spend at your desk.

  • Internship agreement with your university (convention de stage)

  • Students from other EU countries welcome, including Erasmus+ traineeships. If you've always wanted to spend six months by the Mediterranean, this is a good excuse.

How we hire

  • A 15-minute call with Matthieu, our CTO, to get to know each other.

  • A 30-minute technical interview.


How to apply

Apply here with your CV. In a few lines, tell us about one project: what you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. Add a link to your GitHub or to something you built; if your best work is private, just tell us about it. No cover letter needed.

title: Aeroseal Technician
description:
Are you looking for a career where you can make a real impact?

ARC Insulation, a Protect Environmental company, is driven by a mission to create healthy, safe, clean, and sustainable indoor environments across the United States.

We’re seeking an Aeroseal Technician to join our team. In this role, you’ll perform Aeroseal duct sealing services in residential homes, helping improve HVAC system efficiency and indoor air quality. You’ll prepare job sites, operate specialized sealing equipment, lead crew members, and ensure each project is completed safely, efficiently, and to company standards.

What's In It For You?

  • Competitive Pay: Hourly pay with bonus incentives
  • Career Growth: Opportunities to develop your technical skills and obtain Aeroseal certification
  • Company Vehicle: Daily local travel in a company-provided vehicle
  • Equipment Provided: All necessary work equipment supplied
  • Full Benefits Package: Eligible for company benefits, including health, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and paid holidays
  • Consistent Schedule: Primarily normal business hours, with occasional overtime opportunities

We Think You're a Great Fit If You:

  • Have experience in residential contracting, HVAC, general labor, or a related trade
  • Have previous HVAC or Aeroseal experience (preferred)
  • Have the ability to lead and direct a crew on job sites
  • Are mechanically inclined and enjoy hands-on work
  • Have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Are organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage your time effectively
  • Can follow verbal and written instructions and job specifications
  • Are dependable, punctual, and comfortable working independently
  • Have strong customer service and communication skills
  • Are bilingual in English and Spanish (preferred)
  • Hold a valid driver's license with a clean driving record and can pass a background check

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Prepare residential job sites by protecting floors, furniture, and customer belongings
  • Set up Aeroseal equipment and prepare HVAC duct systems for sealing
  • Operate Aeroseal equipment to identify and seal duct leaks
  • Monitor leakage readings and perform post-service testing to verify results
  • Lead and direct crew members, assigning tasks and ensuring work is completed safely and correctly
  • Make on-site decisions to resolve issues and keep projects on schedule
  • Communicate with customers about services being performed and answer questions professionally
  • Maintain company vehicles and equipment, reporting any issues as needed
  • Complete job documentation and ensure all work meets company standards
  • Clean up job sites and leave customers' homes in good condition
  • Follow all safety procedures, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Represent Protect Environmental in a professional and customer-focused manner

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED preferred
  • Experience in residential contracting, HVAC, general labor, or a related trade preferred
  • Previous Aeroseal experience or certification preferred; ability to obtain Aeroseal certification within the required timeframe
  • Ability to regularly lift up to 60 pounds
  • Ability to stand, bend, kneel, and crouch for extended periods
  • Comfortable working in crawl spaces, attics, and other confined areas in varying temperatures
  • Ability to climb ladders and perform physical, hands-on work
  • Ability to travel locally each day using a company-provided vehicle
  • Availability to work occasional overtime as needed

If this is something you are interested in, APPLY today!

Benefits and Perks
Protect Environmental provides comprehensive benefits to full time employees, including:
• Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
• Short- and Long-Term Disability
• Life Insurance
• 401(k) Plan with Company Match

Protect Environmental is a national leader in the home services industry, focusing on insulation, radon, chemical vapor intrusion, and water quality management. With a proven track record spanning 39 years and more than 250,000 completed projects across all 50 U.S. states and two U.S. territories, the company delivers expert solutions that help property owners build and maintain healthy, safe, and sustainable indoor environments with confidence.

title: Assistant Director, Pre-College and Non-Degree, Slate

title: Schooldirecteur OBS Het Samenspel
description:
De Almeerse Scholen Groep (ASG) zoekt voor OBS Het Samenspel een daadkrachtige en verbindende directeur. Ben jij een mensgerichte leider die rust en duidelijkheid brengt én onderwijskundig sterk is? Heb je ervaring met verander- en verbetertrajecten en weet je samen met een team verder te bouwen aan onderwijskwaliteit en een sterk pedagogisch klimaat? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Over OBS Het Samenspel

OBS Het Samenspel is een dynamische openbare basisschool in Almere, met locaties in Stedenwijk Noord en Midden. Dit schooljaar 2026-2027 zijn de groepen 1 t/m 4 gevestigd op locatie Midden aan de Amsterdamweg, die speciaal is ingericht op het jonge kind. De leerlingen van groep 5 t/m 8 zitten op locatie Noord aan het Leeuwardenplein.

Het Samenspel staat voor een mooie nieuwe fase: de school krijgt nieuwbouw in de vorm van een Brede School. Daarin werken we samen met partners in de wijk, waaronder Activiteitencentrum Stedenpunt, Peuterspeelzaal Pierewiet en Playground Stedenwijk. Samen zorgen we voor een omgeving waarin onderwijs, ontwikkeling en activiteiten voor kinderen met elkaar verbonden zijn.

Onze gevarieerde schoolpopulatie weerspiegelt de buurt en de multiculturele samenleving waarin onze leerlingen opgroeien. Samen met partners in de wijk werken we aan hun ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei.

Het Samenspel heeft grote stappen gezet in de ontwikkeling van het onderwijs en de schoolomgeving. Het team staat met frisse energie en een gezamenlijke visie, klaar om verder te bouwen op de ingeslagen weg.

In onze focus voor de nabije toekomst staat centraal:

  • Sterke focus op rekenen, taal en gedifferentieerd onderwijs.
  • Het versterken van effectieve instructie, vooral door middel van Expliciete Directe Instructie (EDI).
  • Het uitwerken en implementeren van het beleidsplan burgerschap en sociaal-emotioneel leren met Kwink.

Wie zoeken we?

Als directeur van Het Samenspel ben jij de onderwijskundige leider die samen met het team verder bouwt op de ingeslagen weg. Je brengt rust, vertrouwen en duidelijkheid, stelt heldere kaders en houdt focus op het verbeteren van de onderwijskwaliteit en het pedagogisch klimaat. Je weet wat leerlingen nodig hebben en hebt affiniteit met onze leerlingenpopulatie en hun verschillende ondersteuningsbehoeften.

Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Je bent een mensgerichte en verbindende leider: je bent benaderbaar, geeft ruimte voor creativiteit en investeert in goede relaties. Je creëert een omgeving waarin teamleden, ouders en leerlingen zich gehoord voelen;
  • Je bent een onderwijskundige professional met een duidelijke visie en ervaring in schoolontwikkeling;
  • Je bent transparant in je communicatie met een sterke focus op helderheid en verwachtingen;
  • Je bent daadkrachtig, verzamelt input uit het team en durft beslissingen te nemen;
  • Je kunt goed organiseren, luisteren, oplossen en relativeren;
  • Je hebt de intentie om je voor langere tijd aan de school te verbinden.

Wat bieden wij?

Als directeur van Het Samenspel maak je deel uit van het directeurenteam van ASG, waarin je collega’s inspireert, met hen samenwerkt en ook sparringpartners vindt. Daarnaast zijn er volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen het netwerk van ASG. Inschaling vindt plaats conform de CAO-PO schaal 12.

Wil je meer weten?

Lees hier het uitgebreide profiel van deze uitdagende functie.

De volgende data hebben wij gereserveerd om het sollicitatieproces zorgvuldig af te kunnen ronden:

  • 24 november 17:00 - 18:00 uur: Benoemingsgesprek met CvB lid en Clusterdirecteur
  • 25 november 15:00 - 17:00 uur: Gesprek met benoemingsadviescommissie (BAC)
  • 27 november 10:30 - 11:30 uur: Arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek met HR-adviseur

Neem bij vragen contact op Annelieke van Geffen, clusterdirecteur, via 036 540 6363 of kijk op voor meer informatie. Het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag is onderdeel van de aanstellingsprocedure.

title: Senior Java Backend developer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 130 – 170 PLN / godz. netto

Bulk payments through a file upload sound simple until you build them: many transactions in one file, validation for each of them, and an existing banking backend that has to accept them. You’ll write the Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.5 services that bring business banking to an e-banking platform, as part of a new team.

WHO WE ARE
Specific-Group is an owner-managed IT services company with 26+ years in the market, 600+ specialists across 10 countries, and no VC funding or exits. Around 90% of our people are senior-level, and 82% of projects get extended - because clients value the work. Our AI tooling varies depending on the project and business requirements. All solutions we use are selected with GDPR compliance in mind.

Thanks to the continued growth of our Financial Services portfolio and the expansion of our Polish office, we’re creating new opportunities for professionals who want to grow together with the business.

THE CLIENT & THE PROJECT
Our client provides IT infrastructure, platforms and applications for three Austrian banks. Its e-banking app currently serves private customers; the next step is new features for small and medium businesses, including bulk payment processing through file uploads.
These are built as new services alongside the existing app. SPG already has around 13 people working with this client on another project, so you’ll have colleagues on the ground. The team works in English.

YOUR ROLE IN THE TEAM
You’ll join the new SME team while it’s still being formed, so you’ll be among its first members. The planned setup is three backend developers (including the Tech Lead), three frontend developers, three manual QA engineers and one test automation engineer. You’ll share the Java codebase with the Tech Lead, who codes at least half of the time, and one more backend developer, work closely with the SPG architect and report to the Tech Lead.

HOW IT STARTS

  • First weeks: Get to know the existing app, the EJB middleware and the target architecture defined by the Tech Lead and the architect;

  • Next: Deliver the first SME services and their integration with the existing backend;

  • Ongoing: Own backend features from design to production. Concrete milestones will be agreed during your first weeks.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Write production code in Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.5;

  • Build new SME services, including bulk payment processing;

  • Integrate them with existing Java EE / EJB middleware;

  • Read legacy JSP code to understand existing behaviour and dependencies;

  • Work with Redis and MS SQL, and review your teammates’ code.

YOUR PROFILE

  • You have 7+ years of commercial experience with Java, including Spring Boot in production;

  • You’ve worked with or integrated Java EE / EJB systems;

  • You’re comfortable with relational databases, ideally MS SQL;

  • You’re comfortable shaping solutions while requirements are still evolving;

  • Banking or payments experience is a plus, not a must.

STACK
Java 21 · Spring Boot 3.5 · Redis · MS SQL · Java EE / EJB (integration) · JSP (reading) · Angular 21 (frontend team)

FAIR TO SAY
This isn’t a greenfield project without legacy constraints. The new services must integrate with EJB middleware and older JSP code, and both the team and the scope are still taking shape. The role is hybrid: you’ll be at the SPG office in Kraków 2 - 3 days a week, and for now you choose which days. If you prefer a fully defined spec or fully remote work, this may not be the right fit.

HIRING PROCESS

  1. Screening call with SPG Recruiting

  2. Technical interview (1 hour)

  3. Final round with the SPG architect → Contract

title: HR Representative
description:
## **Job Description**

### **You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.**

**Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.**

**The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026, when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.**

Who We Are:

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years.  We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients.  As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

What We Do (The Team You’ll Be Part Of):

As a key member of the HR Services team, the **HR Representative** plays an integral role in delivering high-quality HR support. This position is responsible for a broad range of administrative, coordination, reporting, and analytical activities that help ensure accurate employee data management and the seamless delivery of HR services.

How You’ll Make An Impact:

- Act as the primary contact and troubleshoot issues for the HR Information System (HRIS)
- Prepare and maintain standard and ad-hoc reports on HR related activities.
- Facilitate a wide range of HR transactions in collaboration with HR team members, including, but not limited to, the preparation, coordination, and processing of employee lifecycle events such as new hires, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, leaves of absence, and terminations/departures, employee correspondence and other employment-related documentation, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with company policies and legislative requirements.
- Perform systems audit comparing information in HRIS with the data in the payroll system to ensure integrity of all employee data.
- Reconciliation of the Manulife benefit premium statements and process payments.
- Manage and submit inSite Submission Forms to request updates to HR related information on the Fidelity intranet site (inSite).
- Create, maintain, and update job codes and job profiles to support organizational and business requirements, partnering with key stakeholders to provide updates on a timely basis.
- Administer and distribute employee documents through DocuSign, including share plan documents, compensation plans, and other employment-related documentation.

What We Are Looking For:

- Completion of college diploma or degree preferably in Human Resources Management or equivalent experience
- Minimum of 1+ years’ experience working in an HR related function, preferably in financial services industry
- Experience using an HRIS system or other related applications.
- Experience using Workday (or equivalent HRIS tool) is a nice to have
- Experience with payroll, invoice management, accounts payable is an asset
- Completion of or working towards the CHRP or CHRL designation is an asset
- Bilingualism in English and French is an asset
- Exposure to employee relocation and immigration cases is required

What You Will Bring

- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Knowledge of MS Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Word
- Strong organizational and time management skills
- Ability to adapt and work effectively in a variety of situations
- Strong Attention to detail
- Ability to learn new systems and apply knowledge to existing processes
- Ability to work within a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and demonstrate considerable use of tact, diplomacy, discretion and judgement.

Total Rewards That Reflect Your Impact

We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a **competitive compensation package** designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.

For this role, your total rewards include:

- **Base Salary and discretionary Performance Bonus**: Total annual cash compensation (base salary plus target bonus) ranges from **$59,000 to $75,000** based on experience and qualifications
- **RRSP Contribution**: After 6 months of employment, we invest in your future with an **RRSP contribution—no employee matching required.**


We offer **market-aligned rates** that recognize the specialized skills and agility required for this role.

We’re proud to offer a compensation package that aligns with **provincial pay transparency requirements**.

This posting is for an **existing vacancy** within our organization.

_We use AI-enabled LinkedIn Hiring Assistant to support parts of our sourcing process. Every hiring decision is reviewed and finalized by our recruiters. If you choose to ask questions to the LinkedIn HR Hiring Assistant, please be mindful that the responses are not official and must be confirmed for accuracy and completeness by Fidelity.  If you are selected for an interview, the recruiter who contacts you can best answer your questions_.”

Some of the ways we’ll help you feel valued and supported as part of our team:

- Flexible working arrangements - 100% remote, hybrid, and in office options
- Competitive total compensation, including company contributions to your group RRSP without a matching requirement from you
- Comprehensive health benefits that start on your first day, with 100% employer-paid premiums, that include up to $6000 annually for mental health services and therapy
- Parental leave top-up to 100% of your salary for a period of 25 weeks
- Up to $650 for home office equipment
- Generous time off policy, including 2 paid days annually to volunteer at a charity of your choice
- Diversity and inclusion programs, including an active network of Employee Resource Groups
- Extensive professional development opportunities, including access to over 11,000 training and development courses, tuition reimbursement, and monetary rewards for completing a required designation

We care a lot about fostering a compassionate, people-centric culture, and are proud to have been named one of Canada’s Top 100 employers for the last five years.

**Fidelity Canada is an equal opportunity employer**

Fidelity Canada is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, age, disability, family status, protected veterans’ status, Aboriginal/Native American status or any other legally-protected ground.

**Accommodation during the application process**

Fidelity Canada welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in the selection process. If you require an accommodation, please email us at [FidelityCanadaStaffing@fidelity.ca](mailto:FidelityCanadaStaffing@fidelity.ca).

**No telephone inquiries or agencies please. We thank all applicants for their interest, please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.**

**Why Work at Fidelity?**

**Awards**

Translate business strategies and finance transformation goals into scalable, integrated SAP solutions

title: Strategic Planning Specialist
description:
• Challenge yourself in this key relationship & people leadership role in Workforce Planning
  • Take an opportunity to grow and develop your career
  • Full time, 12 Month Fixed Term Contract based at our Mascot Corporate Campus

Today, we’re busy planning for tomorrow. We look to the future to guide the way we innovate, helping us stay relevant and responsive in an unpredictable industry. Our collaborative culture allows us to dream big and deliver successfully, knowing we’re supported by the best people. Together we drive positive business outcomes, taking a considered, cost-conscious approach that makes a difference to our customer experience.

As the Strategic Workforce Planner you will be responsible for developing, implementing and monitoring the long-term strategic resource plans for airports and freight in line with the airports, freight and group strategy. You will identify and implement transformation initiatives across the Airports/Freight portfolios through extensive stakeholder engagement and effective business partnering, and will work on a range of programs, projects and long-term initiatives.

You will also be responsible for leading a team of workforce planners to produce effective, safe and cost-effective seasonal planning and monthly rosters, planning rule set up and maintenance, Master Roster Build and creation to (-28) days.

You’ll have –

  • Proven experience in Workforce Planning, Resource Planning or Workforce Management, ideally within a complex operational environment.
  • Strong analytical capability, including workforce forecasting, scenario modelling and translating data into practical business solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop workforce plans and resource strategies that balance operational requirements, service outcomes and labour costs.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships across all levels of the organisation.
  • A proactive, commercially minded approach with proven experience driving workforce improvements, process enhancements and operational efficiencies.
  • Intermediate to Advanced Excel skills and experience with workforce planning, scheduling or rostering systems.
  • Experience with GroundStar software and/or aviation, logistics, freight or transport environments is highly regarded.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time.

You’ll be supported from day 1 with on-the-job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas are equal opportunity employers, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace.

If you’re ready to step into a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application and let’s explore how we go places together.

title: Head of DevOps and IT Service Delivery
description:
Help shape the future of student funding services in Scotland by leading the technology platforms and service delivery that enable thousands of students to access the support they need.

The Student Awards Agency Scotland (SAAS), an Executive Agency of the Scottish Government, is seeking a Head of DevOps and IT Service Delivery to lead a key function within our Digital team. Our mission is to provide secure, reliable and user-focused digital services that support students, colleagues and partners to access and administer student funding effectively.

In this senior leadership role, you will oversee the operational delivery of infrastructure, DevOps and IT service management capabilities, ensuring our technology ecosystem remains resilient, secure and fit for the future. You will drive continuous improvement across platforms, services and ways of working, enabling high-quality digital services that support SAAS's strategic objectives and deliver excellent outcomes for users across Scotland.

**Responsibilities:**

- Provide strategic leadership for Infrastructure, DevOps and IT Service Delivery, ensuring technology services are secure, resilient, customer-focused and aligned to organisational priorities.

- Lead the development and continuous improvement of IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities, including incident, problem, change, release, request and performance management.

- Oversee availability, capacity and service performance, identifying risks, driving improvements and implementing effective solutions to maintain high-quality services.

- Lead, develop and inspire a multidisciplinary team of technical specialists, setting standards, policies and best practice to support effective service delivery and continual improvement.

- Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices, emerging technologies and engineering approaches to improve the quality, reliability and efficiency of digital services and delivery.

- Ensure security is embedded throughout the design, development and operation of platforms and services, mitigating risks and supporting organisational compliance requirements.

- Provide technical leadership across systems design, software engineering, infrastructure and integration activities, ensuring appropriate standards, tools and design patterns are consistently applied.

- Oversee the design, build, testing, deployment and support of technology solutions, ensuring services meet business needs and can be effectively maintained and enhanced.

- Lead the planning and coordination of system integration and testing activities, ensuring successful delivery of complex technical changes and programmes.

- Champion user-centred service delivery, working collaboratively with user researchers, delivery teams and stakeholders to ensure services meet the needs of users and the organisation.

**Success profile:**

Success profiles are specific to each job and they include the mix of behaviours, experience and technical criteria (if applicable) that candidates will be assessed on.

**Experience:**

- Proven experience of leading Infrastructure, DevOps and IT Service Delivery functions within a complex organisation, delivering secure, resilient and customer-focused digital services aligned to organisational objectives.

- Significant experience of developing, implementing and continuously improving IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities, including incident, problem, change, release and service performance management.

- Demonstrable experience leading modern infrastructure and platform environments, including cloud technologies, automation and DevOps practices, driving improvements in service reliability, quality and operational efficiency.

- Strong track record of managing technology risk, resilience and compliance requirements, ensuring services remain secure, available and fit for purpose.

- Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams whilst building effective relationships with senior stakeholders, influencing decision-making and driving organisational change and continuous improvement.


**Behaviours:**

- Leadership – **Level 4**
- Making effective decisions – **Level 4**
- Seeing the bigger picture – **Level 4**
- Changing and improving – **Level 4**

You can find out more about Success Profiles Behaviours [here](https://www.gov.scot/publications/success-profiles-candidate-guide/pages/behaviour-levels/):

**Technical Skills:**

This role is aligned to **Lead DevOps Engineer** job role within the Government Digital and Data Profession.

These skills will be tested during the Technical Assessment if you are successful at sift stage. They will be not be assessed at application stage.  Please review the following to understand the skill expectations: [Development operations (DevOps) engineer - Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework.](https://understand-digital-data-roles-skills.service.gov.uk/role/development-operations-devops-engineer/#lead-devops-engineer-management)

**How to apply:**

Apply online, providing a CV and Supporting Statement of no more than **1500** words which provides evidence of how you meet the Experience and Behaviours listed in the Success Profiles above.  Be sure to provide specific examples of work that you’ve done that showcase your relevant experience.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.  Please see our [candidate guidance](https://www.civil-service-careers.gov.uk/artificial-intelligence-and-recruitment/) for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

**Skilled Worker sponsorship is not available for this role. As a result, we are unable to appoint candidates who require Skilled Worker sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must have an existing and ongoing right to work in the UK.**

Candidates will have their applications assessed against all Experience criteria at sift stage. Successful candidates will be invited to attend an Interview and Technical Assessment. The interview will further assess the Experience and Behaviours outlined in the job advert, while the Technical Assessment will evaluate the technical skills required for the role. Candidates invited to this stage will receive a Technical Assessment Candidate Pack detailing the skills to be assessed and the assessment methods that will be used. Following the application sift, there may also be a short telephone interview as part of the assessment process prior to the main interview.

Assessments are scheduled for w/c **30 November 2026** however this may be subject to change.

Apply before 23:59 on **22 November 2026**.  This post is open to internal candidates and Common Citizenship Organisations only (external candidates and staff from UK Other Government Departments are not eligible to apply for this vacancy).

**Recruitment Principles:**

As a government organisation, we adhere to the [Civil Service Commission Recruitment Principles](https://civilservicecommission.independent.gov.uk/recruitment/recruitment-principles/) and we investigate any [complaints](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/complaints/) received in relation to the recruitment cases.

**About us:**

SAAS is an executive agency of the Scottish Government and responsible for assessing and paying student awards for Scottish domiciled students in Higher Education throughout the UK. We administer budgets of around £1.4 billion each year, making payments to both educational institutions and over 190,000 students a year. We are committed to recruiting a diverse workforce that is representative of the clients we serve.

More information on SAAS can be found on our website [https://www.saas.gov.uk](https://www.saas.gov.uk)

The Scottish Government is the devolved government for Scotland. We have responsibility for a wide range of key policy areas including: education, health, the economy, justice, housing and transport. We offer rewarding careers and employ people across Scotland in a wide range of professions and roles.

Our staff are part of the [UK Civil Service](https://www.civil-service-careers.gov.uk/about-us/), working for Ministers and senior stakeholders to deliver vital public services which improve the lives of the people of Scotland.

We offer a supportive and inclusive working environment along with a wide range of employee benefits. Find out more about [what we offer](https://www.jobs.gov.scot/what-we-offer).

As part of the UK Civil Service, we uphold the [Civil Service Nationality Rules](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/nationality-requirements/).

**Working pattern:**

Our standard hours are 35 hours per week and we offer a range of flexible working options depending on the needs of the role, including Flexi-leave. Scottish Government staff in hybrid-compatible roles should aim to work in-person 40% of the time, either in an office or other agreed work location. If you have specific questions about the role you are applying for, please contact us.

**Security checks:**

Successful candidates must complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), before they can be appointed. BPSS is comprised of four main pre-employment checks – Identity, Right to work, Employment History and a Criminal Record check (unspent convictions).

You can find out more about BPSS on the UK Government website, and read about the Government Vetting Charter, or about all the different levels of security checks in our Candidate Guide.

Internal candidates may need to gain higher security clearance than they currently hold if successful in their application.

**Pay supplement:**

This post is part of the Government Digital and Data (GDD) profession and currently attracts a **£6000** annual GDD pay supplement, which is paid monthly – pay supplements are reviewed regularly.

**Equality statement:**

We are committed to equality and inclusion and we aim to recruit a diverse workforce that reflects the population of our nation.

Find out more about our commitment to diversity and how we offer and support recruitment adjustments for anyone who needs them.

**Further information:**

Find out more about our organisation, what we offer staff members and how to apply on our Careers Website.

Read our Candidate Guide for further information on our recruitment and application processes.

title: PROJECT MANAGER
description:
Job Summary

The Project Manager (Civil) is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of civil construction projects within time, cost, quality, and safety parameters. The role involves managing project teams, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

Candidate Profile

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Planning & Execution

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and resource allocation strategies.
  • Define scope, milestones, deliverables, and risk management measures.
  • Ensure all work aligns with project specifications, client requirements, and UAE standards.

2. Budget & Cost Control

  • Prepare, monitor, and control project budgets.
  • Manage procurement processes in collaboration with the procurement department.
  • Implement cost-saving strategies without compromising quality.

3. Team Leadership & Coordination

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams, including engineers, supervisors, and subcontractors.
  • Assign tasks, monitor performance, and provide guidance.
  • Facilitate collaboration between design, procurement, and site teams.

4. Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the main point of contact with clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
  • Conduct regular progress meetings and provide project status updates.
  • Resolve issues and manage change requests effectively.

5. Compliance & Quality Control

  • Ensure adherence to local authority regulations (Dubai Municipality, ADM, etc.).
  • Oversee quality control inspections and implement corrective actions where needed.
  • Monitor Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) compliance on site.

6. Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare weekly and monthly project reports for senior management.
  • Maintain proper documentation for contractual, financial, and operational records.


Skills

Qualification

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.

PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification preferred.

Minimum 10–15 years of experience in civil construction, with at least 5 years as a Project Manager in the UAE.

Proven track record in delivering large-scale residential, commercial, or infrastructure projects.

Required Experiences

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
  • Proficiency in project management software (Primavera P6, MS Project).
  • In-depth knowledge of UAE construction codes, FIDIC contracts, and safety regulations.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

title: Senior School Administrator
description:
- Location: Keele University
- Salary: £27,319 - £31,236
- Department: Support Staff
- Closing date: 22 November 2026

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative team at the Vet School, contributing to the ongoing enhancement and continuous improvement of business operations during a maternity cover period.

The post holder will contribute to the delivery of a cohesive and high-quality administrative service across a split-site office, working as part of a collaborative and supportive team within the Vet School. This role offers an opportunity to be actively involved in the continued development and improvement of business operations, supporting a wide range of administrative functions.

Key responsibilities will include working with colleagues to support student recruitment and outreach activity, including event coordination and staffing; assisting with financial processes such as payroll administration, contracts, and procurement systems; and providing effective diary management support to the senior leadership team.

The role requires excellent organisational, communication, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with colleagues and external stakeholders across both campuses. A high level of accuracy, strong IT skills, and a proactive, flexible approach are essential. Previous customer service experience would be advantageous.

The role will be based primarily at Harper Adams University but will require occasional travel between Keele and Harper Adams campuses.

The School recognises that its success depends upon the contribution and dedication of its talented staff. In return, we have a competitive benefits package available, including:

- Competitive rate of pay with annual increments within the grade (Keele Spine)
- Generous annual leave entitlement with opportunities to purchase additional leave
- Excellent staff pension scheme
- Access to continued personal, professional and career development
- On site ‘outstanding’ nursery (Keele campus only)
- Health & fitness facilities on site
- Cycle to work scheme (subject to eligibility)

Please note that the starting salary will typically be at the bottom of the pay scale shown above

Both Harper Adams University and Keele University are committed to operating flexible working practices wherever possible.

Harper & Keele Veterinary School launched in 2020 with our first cohort of students. Combining the extensive resources and excellence at Harper Adams and Keele universities has created a rich and authentic environment for veterinary education and research, with both institutions recognised for their excellent student experience, strong community spirit, and high-quality teaching.

Combining a strong pedigree in animal sciences, veterinary nursing, veterinary physiotherapy, and agricultural sustainability at Harper Adams University with the established reputation that Keele University proudly boasts in life sciences and human medicine, the School's model of veterinary education has strategic partnership at its very core.

Staff and students at the Vet School uniquely benefit from two highly successful institutions, drawing on the resources at each campus and a network of partner veterinary practices and industry partners.

Further information can be found at [harperkeelevetschool.ac.uk](https://www.harperkeelevetschool.ac.uk/).

Keele University is committed to the principles of the Athena Swan charter, and values equality and diversity across our workforce. We strive to ensure that our workforce is representative of broader society, and therefore, we would actively welcome applications from all genders for this role.

Both universities value equality and diversity across our workforce and to ensuring our staff community is reflective of the diversity of our student population. In support of these commitments the University welcomes applications from individuals of Black, Asian and ethnic minority backgrounds for _all_ roles.
