title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
Who we are: 
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.
We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.
Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


This role is approved for Sponsorship and provides relocation assistance to Barcelona. It is full-time permanent and hybrid (Mondays & Thursdays in our office in Poblenou, Barcelona).
 
Curious about what it's like to engineer at Rover?
Take a look at our Engineering Blog to see how our teams approach technical challenges, share what they've learned, and build products at scale. We hope it gives you a better sense of what it's like to work with us.
 
About the Trust & Safety Engineering Team
We build the systems that prevent incidents before they happen: identity verification, risk scoring, fraud detection, and AI-powered detection that flags problems in real time. It's some of the most important work at Rover, our users are pets, and keeping them safe is the whole point.
We're a cross-functional team of full-stack engineers based in our Poblenou, Barcelona office, working closely with product, design, and data science. We care about clean code, thoughtful collaboration, and building systems people can rely on, and we make time to enjoy each other's company too, from team lunches to coffee on the office terrace.
If you're looking to learn from a strong team, make an impact, and enjoy the ride along the way, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for someone who
Has a true passion for Rover's mission and values and is highly motivated by the responsibility to foster a safe environment for our community.
Has empathy for users and enjoys building customer-facing products that improve people's and pets' lives.
Takes ownership of problems end-to-end: from understanding the business need, to designing the solution, shipping it, and monitoring it in production.
Is able to take loose requirements, collaborate with product managers, designers, and data scientists to determine what needs to be done, and drive a project forward.
Brings their own unique background to the team, adding fresh ideas and perspectives.
Cares deeply about code quality, maintainability, and engineering craftsmanship; writing code that is clear, well-tested, and built to last.
Is excited about using AI tools to accelerate their workflow, improve code quality, and ship faster. You see AI as a core part of modern software engineering, not a novelty.
Is equally eager to share their knowledge and help foster a culture of learning through mentoring, code reviews, and technical leadership.

Your qualifications
7+ years of experience as a professional software engineer, with a strong track record of delivering backend systems.
Technical leadership: you've mentored engineers, driven architectural decisions, led technical design reviews, or shaped team engineering practices, formally or informally.
Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in Python and Django. If your background is in another major backend language (Java, Go, C#, Kotlin), that's absolutely welcome,  what matters most is engineering depth, and we'll support you in ramping up on our stack.
Solid knowledge of relational databases (schema design, query optimization, migrations)
Observability mindset: experience instrumenting services with structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. You care about understanding system behavior in production, not just at deploy time.
Strong testing discipline: you champion automated testing (unit, integration, contract) and treat it as a core part of shipping, not an afterthought.
AI-augmented engineering: you actively use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) in your daily work,  for code generation, debugging, refactoring, code review, and exploring unfamiliar codebases. You understand how to write effective prompts, validate AI output critically, and integrate these tools into a professional workflow.
Comfortable working across the stack: while your strength is backend, you can navigate a React/TypeScript frontend to unblock yourself or collaborate effectively with frontend engineers.

A note on qualifications: we know great candidates don’t always match every requirement. If you’re excited about the role but don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. You might bring strengths or perspectives we haven’t considered—and we’d love to learn more.

Nice to have
Experience with React or React Native, enough to contribute to frontend work when the team needs it.
Experience with distributed systems patterns: async task queues (Celery, RabbitMQ or similar), caching layers (Memcached, Redis), and event-driven architectures.
Familiarity with search infrastructure (Elasticsearch or similar).
Experience with REST API design at scale (Django REST Framework or equivalent).
Exposure to continuous deployment pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Experience pushing the boundaries of AI-assisted development, building custom workflows, automating repetitive tasks, or using AI tools beyond basic code completion.

General skills
You are a collaborative team player who lifts others through constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and pairing.
You bring analytical thinking to new problems and are energized by ambiguity.
You are meticulous about system design and user experience because you want to deliver the best service to your customers.
You are comfortable working with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, XP).
Good level of written and spoken English (our engineering team is in Barcelona, but we work in English).
You love pets! :)

Our style
We are proud to be professional software developers building high-quality, scalable, and supportable solutions.
We are curious and passionate about learning, providing the right environment and resources for professional growth.
We are committed to building, fostering, and maintaining a culture of inclusivity and diversity, both on our teams and in our products.
We embrace progressive engineering practices, including continuous deployment, automated testing, observability-first development, and AI-augmented workflows powered by tools like Claude Code, every engineer on the team uses AI daily to move faster and build better software.
We are serious about the quality of our production operations, with thorough system, application, and user interaction monitoring and anomaly detection.
We are passionate about data-driven decision-making.
Our teams are integrated, with developers, product managers, designers, and data scientists working side-by-side.
We run Maker Days three times a year, company-wide hackathons where engineers get to explore new ideas, experiment with emerging technologies, and build creative prototypes outside their day-to-day work.
And, dogs in the office. Bring yours, too!

Benefits of working at Rover
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursemen
Flexible work hours — sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Dedicated learning time
Grab snacks and fresh fruit in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office

Compensation
In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €62,722 - €76,027. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Mechatronics Engineer III
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical and Control Systems Division (35)**, which creates advanced mechanical, robotics, thermal, propulsion, onboard GNC, and electronic packaging systems. Division 35 develops hardware and systems from early architecture through design, fabrication, subsystem, and system-level integration and test.

You will be working as a **Mechatronics Engineer** within the **Mechanical Engineering, Integration, and Test Section**, which leads the design, analysis, development, integration, and test of flight mechanical and robotic systems for spacecraft, payloads, and ground-based systems. In this role, you will:

- Develop and lead the implementation of mechanisms, materials, and electronics, including actuators, sensors, controllers, structures, and moving mechanical assemblies, for current and future JPL missions.
- Lead mechanical hardware development and mechanical systems engineering activities for payloads, instruments, and spacecraft during all mission phases including proposal, concept/system architecture development, detailed design, integration & test (I&T), verification, delivery, and flight operations.
- Derive, document, and manage complex system, subsystem, and interface requirements and ensure traceability through implementation and verification activities.
- Perform and lead design and analysis activities, generate and maintain engineering documentation, and be responsible for the delivery of mechanical engineering products for spaceflight missions.
- Research, assess, and develop system architectures, technical approaches, and risk mitigation plans for complex mechatronic and robotic systems.
- Ensure that delivered products meet all technical requirements and programmatic commitments.
- Develop cost and schedule estimates, implementation plans, and technical approaches for engineering tasks and project activities.
- Prepare and lead verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution efforts, including development of test plans and leadership of integration and test activities for complex assemblies and subsystems.
- Lead and present at team, line management, subsystem, and project-level technical reviews.
- Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers, designers, structural analysts, and other technical team members.
- Coordinate and lead project activities across organizations, disciplines, vendors, and external partners to achieve project objectives.
- Contribute to proposal and concept study activities, including development of technical content, evaluations, graphics, and engineering analyses.
- Assess and infuse new technologies into flight projects and technology development efforts while remaining current on advancements in mechatronics, robotics, and related engineering disciplines.
- Perform tasks with minimal direction from the group supervisor, project management, and project technical leads; work independently and lead multidisciplinary teams in the execution of key project activities.

### **REQUIRED SKILLS**

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related technical discipline with a minimum of 6 years of related experience; Master's degree with a minimum of 4 years related experience; or PhD in similar disciplines with a minimum of 2 years related experience.
- Experience serving as a technical lead for subsystem development, integration, and verification activities.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating technical efforts across multiple engineering disciplines and organizations.
- Experience leading spacecraft or instrument mechatronics development and/or mechanical hardware design, fabrication, integration, and test efforts.
- Knowledge and experience translating design and performance requirements into electro-mechanical hardware architectures, subsystem designs, and development plans.
- Experience deriving, managing, and verifying system and interface requirements for complex engineering systems.
- Experience developing and executing technical plans, managing risk, and meeting cost, schedule, and technical commitments.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently on key project assignments with limited direction and to lead multidisciplinary technical efforts.
- Experience leading integration, verification, and validation activities for complex mechanical or mechatronic systems.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical information to project leadership, review boards, and customers.

### **DESIRED SKILLS**

- Demonstrated experience with mechanisms, actuators, sensors, robotic systems, and motor controller technologies.
- Advanced knowledge and experience in electrical engineering and software development for embedded systems.
- Experience developing and delivering spaceflight hardware or other relevant spaceflight project experience from concept through mission implementation.
- Practical experience using CAD modeling software (preferably Unigraphics/Siemens NX, SolidWorks, and Teamcenter) used in a Product Delivery Management (PDM) or similar Concurrent Engineering environment.
- Practical experience performing analysis of mechanical elements using classical hand-calculation methods, Finite Element Analysis (FEA), or modeling and simulation techniques.
- Knowledge of Standards for Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) per American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) Y14.5.
- Ability to develop innovative solutions and resolve complex design, integration, implementation, and verification challenges.
- Knowledge of academic and industry practices and standards across a range of applications related to the development, analysis, production, testing, verification, and safety of spaceflight hardware and systems.
- Experience managing, implementing, and verifying project and institutional requirements at the subsystem or system levels.
- Experience developing verification approaches, risk mitigation plans, and system-level technical documentation.
- Experience with proposal development, concept studies, mission formulation activities, or technology maturation programs.
- Experience serving as a technical reviewer or subject matter expert for project design, integration, or verification reviews.
- Experience working across organizations and subject areas, and with outside companies, vendors, NASA centers, and external partners.
- Experience assessing, developing, and infusing new technologies into flight systems, technology demonstrations, or research projects.
- Demonstrated mentoring, coaching, and technical leadership experience.
- Record of technical publications, conference presentations, proposal support, or concept study contributions.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Excellent collaboration skills and ability to lead teams and work across subject areas and organizations.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for education, a commitment to fostering a supportive learning environment, and the ability to inspire both students and educators alike. This is not just a job; it is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of young learners and the broader community.


As a School Principal, you will have the chance to implement innovative educational strategies and programs that enhance student engagement and achievement. You will collaborate closely with teachers, parents, and the community to create a holistic educational experience that respects diverse backgrounds and promotes bilingual proficiency. This position offers extensive opportunities for professional growth, including leadership training, mentorship programs, and participation in educational conferences, ensuring that you remain at the forefront of educational best practices.

  8. Lead initiatives that promote student well-being and mental health, ensuring that all students have access to support services and resources.
  9. Engage in continuous professional learning to stay updated with the latest educational trends, research, and technologies, ensuring the school remains competitive and innovative.

Skills

  • Leadership: Proven ability to inspire and guide a diverse team of educators towards achieving common goals.
  • Curriculum Development: Expertise in designing and implementing effective bilingual curricula that cater to various learning styles.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Community Engagement: Experience in building partnerships with parents and community organizations to support educational initiatives.

title: Analytics Engineering Lead
description:
Are you an Analytics Engineering Lead, who knows exactly how to bridge the gap between raw data engineering and high-impact business insights? Read on to find out more!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9nxt4LcByn0).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_We are open to remote work for this position and will happily accept applicants from anywhere in Portugal, Kenya and South Africa._

The Job

We are looking for a highly skilled Analytics Engineering Lead to provide technical leadership and bridge the gap between data engineering and data analysis. In this role, you will lead the vision for our data environment, mentoring a team to design, build, and maintain clean, reliable, well-documented data models that power analytics, dashboards and operational workflows.

Responsibilities:

- Leadership & Strategy
  - Mentor and grow the analytics engineering team, fostering a high-performance culture.
  - Collaborate with cross-functional leadership (Engineering, Product, Architecture) to align data efforts with business goals.
- Data Modeling & Transformation
  - Lead and/or oversee the design, development, and maintenance of scalable DBT and tableau data models following best practices.
  - Direct the creation of clean semantic layers with fully validated metrics and business logic.
  - Optimise transformations for performance, cost, and maintainability.
- Collaboration & Enablement
  - Lead collaboration with analytics engineers to translate business questions into well-structured data models.
  - Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure upstream pipelines and schemas support downstream needs.
  - Build documentation, playbooks, and self-serve layers for stakeholders.
- Analytics & Insights
  - Own the development of reusable metrics and business definitions for consistent reporting.
  - Oversee the building semantic layers where needed.
  - Conduct exploratory analysis to validate models and understand data behaviours.
- Governance & Best Practices
  - Accountable for high standards of data reliability, version control, and CI/CD for analytics code.
  - Drive data modelling standards across the organisation.
  - Contribute to data literacy initiatives through documentation and training.
  - Contribute to the data quality framework (tests, contracts, alerting).
- Continue to work in an Agile way, as per our teams.

About you

This role is ideal for someone who cares deeply about the business meaning of data, its quality and enabling analysts and business teams to self-serve. You will sit at the centre of our data ecosystem—working closely with Data Engineering, Product, Finance, and Operations.

Requirements:

- Leadership Experience:
  - Proven experience leading or mentoring data teams.
  - Ability to set technical strategy and vision for analytics infrastructure.
  - Strong stakeholder management experience (mainly Product and Architecture)
- 8+ years in Analytics Engineering
- Strong experience with dbt, SQL, and analytics-focused data modelling.
- Deep understanding of dimensional modelling, ELT/ETL design, and data quality practices.
- Knowledge of CI/CD, Git, and modern data stack tooling.
- Familiarity with software engineering best practices: testing, pull requests, code reviews, environments.
- Strong communication skills: able to translate technical data concepts into business-friendly language.
- You have excellent English skills

Nice to have:

- Airflow experience would be very beneficial
- Experience with Tableau (modeling and optimization)
- Experience in data engineering
- Experience with lakehouse and cloud environments
- Understanding of event-driven architecture or streaming systems (Kafka/Kinesis).
- Experience building metric layers (LookML, MetricFlow, DBT Semantic Layer).

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Technical Challenge | Final interview with the Tech Team

The Rewards

The gross monthly salary brackets for this position are:

Kenya: Ksh444,178 - Ksh740,000 (x12)

South Africa: R88,008 - R146,600 (x12)

Portugal: €3,660 - €6,100 (x14)

Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

- Benefits and allowances tailored to your location.
- Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
- A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website [Tiko – Do more with Tiko](https://tiko.org/). We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

- Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
- Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
- Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

_Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. title: Deputy CTO
description:
Have you ever had to make the tough call on what to build, what to buy, and what needs fixing now while keeping the business moving? If you know how to balance great engineering with commercial reality, bring teams together, and turn a messy technology estate into something that can scale, we have a system for you to shape.

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9nxt4LcByn0).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_For this position we will happily accept applicants from Portugal, Kenya or South Africa._

The Job

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology and Product Officer (CTPO), the Deputy Chief Technology Officer will take end-to-end operational and strategic ownership of roughly half our total tech organisation - leading 50 - 60 engineers, architects, and data professionals across four distinct teams. You will partner closely with your peer, the Deputy Chief Product Officer, to turn our technology vision into a resilient, scalable, and high-throughput reality.

This is not an advisory, fractional, or hands-off consulting role.

We are looking for an operational heavyweight who thrives in the weeds of engineering standards, architecture trade-offs, and ISO 27001 compliance, while building the conditions that make delivery predictable and sustainable. You will lead through directors, raise the bar for technical excellence, and serve as the ultimate arbitrator for build-vs-buy decisions across our platform, data, and infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Architecture Strategy

- Own the overarching integrity of Tiko's technical architecture, setting cross-cutting principles and standards across engineering, data, and cloud infrastructure.
- Arbitrate major build-vs-buy decisions, evaluating long-term operational costs, reliability, and platform growth against immediate business priorities.
- Contribute technical initiatives directly to the joint product and tech roadmap, ensuring foundational platform health and tech-debt management are prioritised alongside feature delivery.
- Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry shifts to ensure Tiko's platform remains modern, secure, and fit for purpose across our operating regions.

Leadership & Operational Excellence

- Directly manage, mentor, and develop senior leaders—including two Engineering Directors, a Data Architect, and a Software & Infrastructure Architect.
- Scale and nurture a high-performing 50+ person engineering organisation, fostering a culture grounded in psychological safety, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous learning.
- Establish metrics, SLAs, and KPIs to track platform health, delivery performance, and engineering effectiveness, using data to drive continuous optimisation.
- Own the organisational conditions for predictable, low-toil delivery, empowering your Engineering Directors to execute individual projects with autonomy and accountability.

Governance, Risk & Security

- Champion security, privacy, and regulatory compliance across all engineering practices, keeping our ecosystem strictly aligned with ISO 27001 standards and strict data protection obligations.
- Identify, monitor, and mitigate technical, operational, and vendor risks, maintaining tested continuity and disaster-recovery plans across our platform.
- Serve as the primary engineering and architecture interface for executive leadership, effectively translating technical debt, risk, and architectural choices into business outcomes.
- Lead cross-functional collaboration with product, operations, marketing, and MERL teams to break down silos and ensure seamless execution of company objectives.

About You

You are a grounded, low-ego technical leader who values organisational impact and real-world delivery far above corporate titles. You are energized by the systemic challenge of leading a multi-team engineering organisation through its next stage of scale. You combine deep, battle-tested software and data engineering fundamentals with the emotional intelligence needed to mentor directors, align cross-functional peers, and foster a growth-oriented, inclusive environment for girls and the communities we serve.

Requirements

- Proven Scale Leadership: 8+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, with a track record of directly or indirectly managing multi-team organisations of 40+ people (managing through directors, not just individual contributors or frontline managers).
- Full-Time Operational Ownership: Demonstrated history of full-time, hands-on operational leadership in scaling product-led tech environments (fractional, part-time, or pure advisory experience will not fit this requirement).
- Architectural Mastery: Deep experience defining enterprise architecture standards, managing complex distributed systems, and leading data infrastructure transformations.
- Security & Compliance: Direct experience driving compliance, security governance, and data privacy frameworks (specifically ISO 27001 and local data protection regulations).
- Communication & Alignment: Exceptional verbal and written European English communication skills, with a proven ability to act as an internal and external technical evangelist.

Bonus Points (The Differentiators):

- Hands-on experience scaling technology platforms across emerging markets or lower-bandwidth environments in Africa.
- Deep background in data engineering, analytics architectures, or financial/incentive payout systems at scale.
- Direct experience partnering with executive leadership in a matrixed, cross-functional global non-profit or social enterprise.

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Second Interview with Tech Team | Final interview with the Co-CEO

The Rewards

- We offer a competitive salary based on experience, location and the agreed scope of the position
- Benefits and allowances tailored to your location
- Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
- A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement


The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website [Tiko – Do more with Tiko](https://tiko.org/).

We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

- Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
- Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
Why This Role Matters
The Senior Database Engineer at Bluestaq owns the data systems that move and protect information behind national security decisions — the schemas, pipelines, and datastores our enterprise platform runs on. This is not a ticket-closing seat. You are the go-to engineer for a data domain: you design the schemas, tune the queries that are actually slow, keep the pipelines healthy, and lead the medium-sized data work from requirements through production. You operate independently, call out risk before it becomes an outage, and set the bar for the engineers around you.

What You Own

  • Own sets of tables, schemas, and data flows end-to-end within a larger product or program — including their data quality, performance, and operability over time.
  • Design robust relational schemas and data models with sound normalization and denormalization tradeoffs, DDL, and extensive SQL.
  • Work across SQL and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Postgres/RDS, Amazon Athena) following best practices, and represent practical DB constraints in data modeling discussions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of medium-sized data features — new domains, new ingest, or significant schema changes.
  • Build moderately complex ETL/ingest pipelines with incremental loads, error handling, and validation.
  • Investigate and fix non-trivial performance problems — bad query plans, missing indexes, partitioning, table bloat — and tune queries, indexes, and configurations for real workloads.
  • Apply database-level security controls — row-level security (e.g., Postgres RLS), roles and permissions, and auditing patterns — to protect sensitive data.
  • Plan and execute database upgrades, patches, and migrations with minimal disruption to dependent systems.
  • Serve as the escalation point for Associate and mid-level engineers on data correctness and performance, and mentor through code review and by explaining design choices.
  • Partner with Software Engineering, Data Modeling, Systems, and Cyber to align data design, performance, and access patterns with mission needs.
  • Keep database and process documentation current — schema and data-flow diagrams, runbooks, and how-to guides for operating and querying key datasets.

What You Bring

Required Education & Experience

  • High School Diploma/GED and 8+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Associate degree in a related field and 6+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Master's degree in a related field and 2+ years of relevant experience

Must-Haves

  • Relational database mastery — production experience designing, tuning, and operating one or more of Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
  • NoSQL / large-scale stores — hands-on work with MongoDB, Athena, or equivalent, and sound judgment on when to use them.
  • Schema and data modeling — designing normalized and denormalized structures that hold up under real-world query and storage conditions.
  • Performance engineering — diagnosing bad plans and bottlenecks, and applying indexing, partitioning, and query rewrites that stick.
  • ETL / ingest pipelines — building moderately complex loads with incremental processing, error handling, and validation.
  • Database security — row-level security, roles and permissions, and auditing patterns applied in production.
  • Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery — you know the plan and have exercised it.
  • Linux environments and scripting / automation — PowerShell, Bash, Python, and SQL.
  • SQL depth — Common Table Expressions, dynamic SQL, and the ability to reason about complex queries.
  • Independent delivery — you scope the work, choose the approach, surface risk, and drive it from design through rollout without being managed through it.
  • Mentorship and communication — you raise the bar through code review and clear technical writing for peers, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ownership mentality — you follow through, document your work, check downstream impact, and know when to persevere vs. ask for help.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., DBA certifications).
  • Cloud platforms — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Containerization — Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Schema automation / migration tooling — Liquibase, Flyway.
  • Monitoring and observability — Splunk or equivalent.
  • DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

Salary Range (US)
$115,000—$140,000 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

Relocation: Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.

About Bluestaq
At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

What We Offer:
For full-time positions

  • 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents
  • Up to 6% match to 401(k) contributions with additional discretionary 4% profit share on day one. Roth options available; no vesting period.
  • Every role is eligible for an annual performance bonus
  • $200,000 employer-paid life insurance, plus short- and long-term disability coverage
  • $5,000 annual professional development budget per employee
  • 20 days PTO, plus 8 paid holidays
  • Pet insurance, onsite gym, and flexible schedule

Bluestaq is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by state or local law.

Bluestaq will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities and employees whose work requirements interfere with a religious belief unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to Bluestaq or a direct threat. Employees needing such accommodation are instructed to contact Human Resources immediately at contact.us@bluestaq.com.

Applications will be accepted for 60 days beyond the posting date, or until the position is filled, whichever comes first.

title: Paint Shop Supervisor
description:
As the Paint Shop Supervisor, you will be responsible for overseeing daily paint department operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, employee performance, and safety requirements are consistently met. Provides leadership, training, and technical guidance while managing coating applications, equipment operations, workflow efficiency, and troubleshooting to maintain a safe, productive, and high-quality manufacturing environment.

Minimum Starting Salary: $75,000.00 - depending on qualifications

Essential Functions:

  • Oversee and direct daily department operations, ensuring employees meet production goals, schedules, and workload expectations.
  • Participate in daily toolbox talks and safety meetings; initiate team meetings as needed to improve morale, communication, and performance.
  • Maintain accurate employee attendance, safety, and departmental records.
  • Ensure employees are properly trained and understand their responsibilities, production expectations, and safety requirements.
  • Monitor employee performance and provide guidance and support to maintain productivity and quality.
  • Monitor product quality, paint application, material usage, and overall production efficiency.
  • Ensure proper preparation, loading, unloading, painting, and handling of parts throughout the production process.
  • Ensure proper setup, operation, and maintenance of painting equipment, including spray guns, spray booths, wash tanks, and conveyor systems.
  • Ensure employees follow established procedures for equipment inspections, titration measurements, color changes, paint reclaiming, spray-to-waste operations, and daily checklists.
  • Troubleshoot equipment and production issues to minimize downtime and maintain consistent quality.
  • Maintain knowledge of and provide guidance on mixing, thinning, and applying Alkyd, Latex, Zinc Rich, Epoxy (including Ultra High Solids), and Urethane coatings using airless and conventional spray equipment.
  • Ensure primers, liquid paints, and powder coatings are applied according to manufacturer specifications.

title: Ecosystem Trainer
description:
Would you enjoy working with different actors in the Tiko ecosystem to ensure that they are knowledgeable about our platform and its offers? Continue reading to find out more about our Ecosystem Trainer role in Kenya!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9nxt4LcByn0).

Globally, our team consists of +230 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_We are hiring a Makueni-based Ecosystem Trainer._

The job

The Ecosystem Trainer will work closely with all actors across Tiko Ecosystems to ensure that they can work with our platform and its offers.

In this role, you'll be responsible for:

- Conducting training when a new clinic, provider or retailer is onboarded onto our platform. This training will ensure that the actor is aware of how Tiko works and their role in the ecosystem, our standard operating procedure, our code of conduct and other policies they would need to comply with.
- Tracking inventory of all actors on the platform and whether each actor has a sufficient number of people who have been trained on Tiko at all times.
- Updating actors when new offers are introduced on the platform and providing the training on how these can be accessed, and on how they work.
- Identifying, preventing and responding to and mitigating any kind of fraud in any ecosystem that you work in. This will involve flagging and reporting any suspicious activity or breaches of our code of conduct and standard operating procedures.

About you

You are tech-savvy and proficient in mobile, messaging and the use of applications. You have brilliant interpersonal skills and can lead a team. You're a problem solver, who has the ability to innovate and improve the way that work is done.

Requirements

- Based in Makueni, Kenya (mandatory).
- 4+ years of experience in community development and public health programs (SRH).
- Over 3 years working experience in facilitating or training of trainers (ToT).
- Proven experience in developing learning programmes
- Degree in Social Science, Public Health, Community Development, or a related field preferred.
- Approachable and works well in a team.
- Experience with Salesforce is a plus.
- Fluency in English, Swahili (mandatory).


Compensation & Benefits

The gross salary range per month for this position is Ksh178,000 - Ksh220,000. Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

- Medical insurance with Old Mutual Insurance

- Provident fund - 4% of gross is paid by Tiko

- Accident insurance with Absa Life Assurance

- Communting allowance - Ksh.2000 per month
- Airtime / internet for work purposes - Ksh.4000 per month
- A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website [Tiko – Do more with Tiko](https://tiko.org/). We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

- Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
- Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
- Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

_Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the_ _[Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme](https://misconduct-disclosure-scheme.org/)_ _. As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures._

_We value your privacy and understand the importance of safeguarding your personal data. We invite you to review our privacy notice for the recruitment process to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. Click_ _[here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11PyH3M9NwpX1h2SbKZ9GQqhHg3WIaEuD/view?usp=sharing)_ _to view the document. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our privacy notice._

title: Product Operations Lead, Booking Platform (Cruise)
description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to build thriving travel advisory businesses. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel industry with AI woven through every part of the advisor's workflow, plus global supplier relationships, personalized training, and a vibrant community, all in one place. That's what lets advisors build businesses that scale, while their taste and service create trips no algorithm alone could plan. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time.

We're mission-driven and obsessed with our customers, and we believe humans and AI are both essential: the best work here comes from people and technology at their best, together. That's not just a philosophy about our product, it's how we build our team. Everyone at Fora gets hands-on with frontier AI tooling as part of the job. At Fora, you'll learn to be AI-fluent, with real experience applying AI to solve problems day to day, wherever you sit in the company.

Founded in 2021, Fora has grown to a team of 250+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. In 2026, we closed a $60 million Series D led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued backing from Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've been named a LinkedIn Top Startup (2024), one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies (2023 and 2025), and one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies (2026).

Come build something that hasn't existed before.

About The Role

Cruise is one of the most exciting growth opportunities at Fora, and we're looking for a Cruise Operations Lead to help us build the infrastructure to scale it.

As we expand our cruise business, we're rethinking how modern technology, smarter operations, and better supplier connectivity can transform the way travel advisors sell and manage cruises. We're looking for an innovative operator who can bridge deep cruise industry expertise with a passion for building scalable systems.

In this role, you'll own the operational foundation of our cruise business, spanning group inventory, booking accuracy, commission integrity, and the launch and adoption of our cruise booking technology. You'll work at the intersection of travel, technology, and operations, partnering closely with our Cruise, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Payment Operations, and Support teams to turn complex industry workflows into simple, reliable experiences for advisors.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape a growing business within Fora. You'll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, challenge how things have traditionally been done, and build the processes and technology that allow us to scale. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable solving a complicated booking issue today and designing a system that eliminates that issue tomorrow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the core operations that power Fora's cruise business, including group inventory management, booking quality, supplier workflows, and commission accuracy.
  • Build, automate, and continuously improve operational processes for cruise deals and cross-border selling, including streamlining data ingestion, standardizing workflows, and ensuring scalable, accurate maintenance of supplier information and selling rules.
  • Develop a scalable approach to managing HQ-held group inventory, from securing and monitoring space to optimizing utilization and ensuring advisors can confidently book available inventory.
  • Identify opportunities to improve booking conversion, reduce operational friction, and create a more seamless experience for advisors selling cruises.
  • Establish operational standards, controls, and performance metrics that support continued growth without adding unnecessary complexity.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years in an operational or a similar role.
  • 2+ years of hands-on cruise operations, such as group inventory, bookings and modifications, supplier management, or commission reconciliation.
  • Uses AI tools daily and has built at least one AI-powered workflow, agent, or automation that replaced manual work.
  • Has owned an operational workflow end to end, with a metric they reported on and improved.
  • Has led a root-cause review of a recurring issue that resulted in a shipped fix.
  • Uses SQL to pull and analyze data and has built dashboards or reports that others use to make decisions.
  • Has written SOPs, runbooks, or ticket specs that others used without a walkthrough.
  • Has written operational tickets that engineering scoped and shipped.
  • Has turned an unscoped problem into a defined process, tool, or ticket without a spec to start from.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with cruise booking platforms, GDS systems, supplier APIs, or other travel distribution technology.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or similar.
  • Has helped get a support team ready for a product launch (help center content, routing, escalation paths).

Compensation

The indicative range for this role is $92K–$116K + equity. Where a candidate lands within in the range reflects their experience and the scope of responsibility they bring.

  • Unlimited vacation
  • Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Wellhub Memberships
  • 401k plan with company match
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Stock Options

This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views.

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: WELFARE OFFICER
description:
Job Summary

The Welfare Officer is responsible for ensuring the well-being, safety, and overall welfare of employees, particularly site-based and labor workforce. The role focuses on maintaining a positive working and living environment in compliance with company policies and local regulations.

Candidate Profile

Responsibilities

Ensure all employees and workers across project sites and facilities are treated in accordance with UAE regulations, respecting and upholding human rights and fundamental freedoms.

Establish and manage an effective worker grievance and resolution system, ensuring fair and ethical treatment in the following areas:

  • Ethical recruitment practices
  • Timely payment of wages through WPS (no later than the 15th of each month)
  • Equality and non-discrimination
  • Freedom of movement
  • Leave entitlements, travel, medical insurance, and allowances

Collaborate with clients and main contractors to assess and address workforce welfare requirements.

Plan, develop, and implement welfare programs and accommodation standards across all project sites.

Verify and consolidate monthly timesheets and coordinate with the Accounts Department for payroll processing.

Monitor daily manpower deployment and support performance review processes.

Arrange transportation and accommodation for new employees and deploy them based on project requirements.

Conduct direct engagement with workers to address concerns, with appropriate approvals.

Act as the primary contact for emergency cases, coordinating with HSE teams and medical authorities until case closure.

Liaise with government authorities (e.g., Ministry of Labour, Police, Courts) on worker-related matters and compliance requirements.

Supervise administrative staff and ensure efficient execution of welfare-related administrative functions.

Manage employee separation processes, including exit interviews when required.

Skills

Strong interpersonal and communication skills

High level of integrity and professionalism

Problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities

Cultural sensitivity and adaptability

Strong organizational and reporting skills

Ability to work independently and under pressure

title: Kokenut kokki tilausravintolaan, Loppi
description:
Oletko kokenut kokki, joka nauttii laadukkaasta ruoanlaitosta ja viimeistellyistä yksityiskohdista? Etsimme itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää kokkia keikkatyöhön tasokkaaseen tilausravintolaan Lopelle.

Ei tavallinen ravintolakeittiö

Tilausravintolan työ rakentuu ennalta suunniteltujen tilaisuuksien ympärille. Jokainen tilaisuus on omanlaisensa, ja laadusta ei tingitä. Pääset käyttämään osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja vastaamaan siitä, että jokainen annos on viimeistelty.

Näin työpäivät rakentuvat

Tilaisuudet ovat yleensä kaksipäiväisiä. Ensimmäinen päivä on pitkä, aamusta myöhään iltaan, ja toinen päivä on tavallisen mittainen. Yöpyminen järjestetään useimmiten paikan päällä, tai tarvittaessa hotellissa Riihimäellä.
Työvuoroja tarjotaan varaustilanteen mukaan, ja niistä sovitaan aina etukäteen.
Työ sopii sinulle, joka arvostat vaihtelua perinteisen ravintolatyön rytmiin.

Odotamme sinulta
- useamman vuoden kokemusta kokin työstä ravintolakeittiössä
- hyvää raaka-aineiden tuntemusta ja laadukasta ruoanvalmistusosaamista
- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ottaa vastuuta keittiöstä
- huolellisuutta ja hyvää paineensietokykyä myös pitkinä päivinä
- joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen

Perehdytämme sinut talon tapoihin, mutta keittiötyön perusteiden tulee olla jo hallussa.

Tarjoamme

- keikkatyötä tasokkaassa ja tavallisesta poikkeavassa ravintolassa
- vaihtelevia tilaisuuksia, joissa ammattitaitosi pääsee esiin
- palkka kokemuksen mukaan, vähintään työehtosopimuksen mukainen
- majoitus kaksipäiväisten tilaisuuksien aikana
- Eezyn tuen koko työsuhteesi ajan

Kiinnostuitko?
Hae Eezyn sivuilla ja kerro hakemuksessa kokemuksestasi ja palkkatoiveestasi. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti.

title: Systems Engineer/Integrated Product Team Lead(IPT)
description:
﻿SAIC is seeking an Integrated Systems Engineer/Integrated Product Team Lead (IPT) to join the National Security and Space Sector (NSS). Our team has Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across a variety of disciplines, including physics, math, RF, optics, space acquisition and operations, and intelligence collection and analysis.
This IPT Lead will work in a collaborative team-focused environment of U.S. Government civilians and contractors solving applied technical problems and developing usable solutions for multiple space-related capabilities and threats. The ideal candidate will:

Demonstrate the ability to provide technical leadership to teams of SMEs to include providing technical guidance and oversight, mentoring team members, integrating and delivering timely, quality products

• Have excellent written and oral communication skills

• Have experience briefing and interacting with senior government customers

• Have experience creating, writing, integrating, and presenting technical briefings and documents

• Have the ability to decompose problems into analytical tasks

• Have experience with program planning, task decomposition, and resource assignments

This position qualifies for enhanced benefits.

Duties and responsibilities include:

• Tasking, timelines, status, and deliverables for the IPT across the analysis, threat and phenomenology functions

• Maintain communications and schedule meetings with end-customer offices, coordinate information needs, product delivery timelines and status

• Provide status of IPT projects, tasks, and deliverables to program and immediate government customer management at periodic reviews

• Identify, remove, and/or escalate blockers to team tasks or deliverables

• Participating in intelligence or cross-team product production meetings as required

• Achieving detailed understanding of multiple satellite systems, designs, operations and classifications

• Identifying gaps and prioritizing recommendations to achieve program protection objectives

• Author, review, and coordinate documents to facilitate Government decision making;

• Repeated use and application of technical standards, principles, theories, concepts and techniques

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of U.S. national security space capabilities, foreign space capabilities, and counter-space threats;

• Participate and represent the customer in various Government and contractor meetings and attend contractor programmatic and technical reviews (e.g. PMR, PDR, CDR, etc.) to provide technical recommendations and risk assessments;

• Frequently interacting with program managers, SETAs, FFRDCs and external stakeholders;

• Developing productive relationships with the Program Office, Prime, and Subcontract counterparts, functional IC or DoD counterparts, and other SMEs;

  • In-depth technical expertise in at least two of the following areas: orbital analysis, satellite communication systems, space surveillance technologies, radar systems, and/or optical systems
  • Experience with satellite acquisition, development, and operations
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience interacting with the intel community to include reading and applying intel assessments and coordinating with intel community experts
  • Experience using STK or similar satellite mission analysis software

_Department and team leadership_

- Take part in hiring, crewing decisions, talent reviews, and ongoing performance management.

title: Ecosystem Coordinator
description:
Could you imagine orchestrating an entire regional ecosystem—scouting new markets, negotiating partner deals, and stepping onto the field to ensure thousands of young women receive seamless, dignified healthcare?

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJYCIChXdKE).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_We welcome applicants who are available to work from__Adama City Oromia region__, Ethiopia_

The Job

At Tiko, we do not just manage health programs—we build fast-moving, high-impact digital ecosystems that empower adolescent girls and young women across Sub-Saharan Africa to take control of their health and futures. As our Ecosystem Coordinator (EC), you are the strategic orchestrator and operational heart of Tiko’s regional footprint. You will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of local health networks, from scouting and launching new expansion markets to optimizing the daily performance of active ecosystems.

This is a dynamic, high-mobility role that bridges high-level strategic deal-making with high-touch field execution. Serving as the vital link between country leadership, community partners, and local healthcare providers, you will negotiate contracts, conduct risk assessments, lead field audits, and host donor delegations—ensuring every actor in the network performs at the highest standard.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Mapping & Partner Acquisition

- Ecosystem Expansion: Conduct strategic market mapping to identify high-potential health networks, community providers, and strategic partners for new ecosystem launches.
- Deal Structuring & Contracting: Pitch Tiko’s value proposition to prospective partners, leading contract negotiations and structuring agreements that align strictly with internal Delegation of Authority (DOA) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
- Due Diligence & Risk Vetting: Execute rigorous due diligence, documentation vetting, and risk assessments for all prospective platform actors prior to onboarding.

High-Touch Field Operations & Monitoring

- Rotating Field Audits: Conduct structured, rotating field visits across assigned regions to evaluate actor performance against KPIs and enforce brand alignment on the ground.
- Risk Mitigation & Investigation: Identify operational anomalies or compliance breaches in real time, collaborating directly with the Risk Team to execute swift suspension or corrective protocols.
- Partner & CBO Enablement: Supervise Community-Based Organizations (CBOs), lead performance reviews for community mobilisers, identify capability gaps, and coordinate targeted training deployments.

Stakeholder Activation & Ecosystem Governance

- Demand Generation & Events: Plan and execute localized demand-generation campaigns while organizing and hosting field visits for donors, government officials, and VIP stakeholders.
- Strategic Alliances: Cultivate long-term relationships with local authorities, administrative bodies, and sector peers to safeguard operational goodwill alongside Country Partnership Officers.
- Continuous Improvement & Storytelling: Document field best practices, capture real-world success stories, and feed operational insights back into cross-functional planning teams to optimize ecosystem workflows.

About You

You are an agile pioneer who combines strategic business acumen with a passion for field-level execution. You are as comfortable negotiating complex agreements in a boardroom as you are conducting spot-checks at community clinics or briefing local administrative leaders. Naturally tech-savvy, you leverage digital platforms to track performance, spot anomalies, and streamline reporting. You possess exceptional relationship-building skills, a growth-oriented mindset, and the diplomatic wit needed to align diverse stakeholders around a shared impact mission.

Requirements

- Experience Profile: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience managing projects or field operations within the international development, humanitarian, or medical health sectors.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, Social Sciences, Project Management, International Development, or a related field.
- Stakeholder & Negotiation Mastery: Proven track record of pitching value propositions, negotiating partner contracts, and managing multi-stakeholder relationships across public and private sectors.
- Tech & Analytical Skills: Proficient in using digital platforms, management dashboards, and mobile data tools to optimize workflows and monitor field compliance.
- Operational Mobility: Willingness and capability to conduct frequent, structured field travel across regional operational sites. Geographic-specific language fluency may be required based on operational region.

Compensation & Benefits

The gross salary range per month for this position is €1,527 - €1,909. Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

- Benefits and allowances tailored to your location.
- Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
- A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website [Tiko – Do more with Tiko](https://tiko.org/). We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

- Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
- Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
- Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

_Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the [Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme](https://misconduct-disclosure-scheme.org/). As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures._

_We value your privacy and understand the importance of safeguarding your personal data. We invite you to review our privacy notice for the recruitment process to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. Click [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11PyH3M9NwpX1h2SbKZ9GQqhHg3WIaEuD/view?usp=sharing) to view the document. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our privacy notice._

### About The University

Swansea University is a research-led university that has been making a difference since 1920. The University community thrives on exploration and discovery and offers the right balance of excellent teaching and research, matched by an enviable quality of life.

Our stunning waterfront campuses and multicultural community make us a desirable workplace for colleagues from around the world. Our reward and benefits, and ways of working enable those who join us to have enriching careers, matched by an excellent work-life balance.

We are seeking to appoint an enthusiastic and self-motivated Research Assistant to join our team to work on studies focusing on primary and emergency care.  As part of the PRIME Centre Wales collaboration funded by Health and Care Research Wales, we use a range of quantitative and qualitative approaches to study models and treatments to improve patient outcomes, avoid unnecessary contacts, and streamline the emergency care system.  We have a strong international reputation in the field and established collaborations with health service and academic colleagues across the UK and internationally.

The successful applicant will be expected to work independently contributing to the conduct and delivery of research, including project and data management of studies so that they are delivered on time and within budget.

The University is committed to supporting and promoting equality and diversity in all its practices and activities.
