title: Consulting Architect - Search
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the Role?

As a Consulting Architect, you will play a pivotal role in helping customers realize the value of Elastic’s Solutions. While your primary focus will be on observability, you are a versatile expert capable of designing and scaling security architectures to strengthen detection, response, and resilience.

Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will work with enterprises to improve application performance, infrastructure visibility, and end-user experience, while also improving their overall security posture. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Professional Services, Engineering, Product, and Sales to accelerate adoption of the Elastic platform, ensuring customers maximize the value of their data while achieving critical business outcomes.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Solution Design & Delivery: Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, outcome-driven solutions built on the Elastic Stack.
  • End-to-End Engagement: Lead the delivery of customer projects from discovery and roadmap design through implementation, enablement, and optimization.
  • Architecture: Create captivating proof-of-concepts that highlight the value proposition of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Your expertise will be the driving force behind accelerating the adoption of Elastic solutions, optimizing queries, fine-tuning clusters, and delivering lightning-fast search and analytics at scale.
  • Data Engineering: Optimize ingestion pipelines for performance, scalability, and resiliency using Elastic Agents, Beats, Logstash, and stream processing.
  • Actionable Insights: Design and implement custom dashboards, visualizations, detection rules, and alerting in Kibana for both observability and security operations.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide oversight and knowledge transfer to customers and teammates throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Community & Culture: Capture and share best practices and solution patterns, contributing to internal enablement and a culture of continuous learning.

What You Bring

  • Professional Expertise: 5+ years as a consultant, architect, or engineer with deep expertise in Search, and a strong capability in security and Observability domains.
  • Deployment Experience: Proven track record of deploying Elastic Search, Observability (APM, logs, metrics) and Elastic Security (SIEM, endpoint) or similar enterprise-scale solutions.
  • Technical Knowledge:
    • Hands-on expertise with distributed systems, Linux, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
    • Deep understanding of E-Commerce search solutions, query development, relevancy tuning, and implementing Natural Language Processing (NLP) use cases.
    • A background in open-source machine learning frameworks like PyTorch, backed by a degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Security Literacy: Familiarity with incident response workflows and common frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, or ISO 27001.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or PowerShell).
  • Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to engage directly with stakeholders and explain complex technical concepts.
  • Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Flexibility: Comfort working in highly distributed, remote teams and a willingness to travel to customer sites as required.

Bonus Points

  • Elastic Certification: Elastic Certified Engineer or deep expertise with Elasticsearch and Lucene.
  • Consulting Background: Prior experience in Big 4 or equivalent professional services environments.
  • Modern Tooling: Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible) and container orchestration (ECK).
  • Emerging Tech: Knowledge of machine learning or AI as applied to Search, observability and security.

title: Senior System & Network Engineer
description:
#### **About Signaturit Group, a Namirial Company**

Signaturit Group, part of the Namirial group, is the European leader in secure digital transactions. Its cloud-native, unified and modular platform enables public and private organisations to manage the entire lifecycle of their digital operations: from identity verification and onboarding to electronic signatures, authentication, communications, fraud prevention, qualified archiving and electronic invoicing.

As a Qualified Trust Service Provider (QTSP) under the eIDAS Regulation, the group guarantees the highest level of legal certainty and regulatory compliance, anticipating initiatives such as eIDAS 2 and the European Digital Identity Framework (EUDI Wallet).

Following the integration of Signaturit into the Namirial Group in 2025, the company consolidates a multinational position with more than 250,000 customers, a presence in more than 90 countries, and a team of more than 1,400 employees. Headquartered in Italy and with a strong presence in Spain, France, Germany and LATAM and South-East Asia —the group combines global reach with local proximity to offer direct service to businesses and public administrations

**What you will do at Signaturit, a Namirial Company 🚀**

As a **Systems & Platform Engineer**, you will join an infrastructure team that operates with a **product mindset**. Your mission is to build, scale, and run our next-generation internal platform—unifying existing environments to accelerate the integration of future acquisitions and empowering our development teams to deploy and scale applications effortlessly.

This is a true **Build & Run** role where infrastructure is treated as software. You will design a platform that is reliable, secure, API-driven, and delightful to use.

- **Platform Engineering & Product Mindset:**

  - Design, build, and evolve our internal developer platform (IDP), acting as a bridge between legacy environments and modern cloud-native architectures.

  - Unify fragmented platforms to streamline and accelerate the technical integration of future company acquisitions.

  - Treat our platform as a product: focus on developer experience (DevEx), usability, automation, and self-service capabilities.

- **Infrastructure as Code & Automation:**

  - Drive the transition toward full **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, moving away from manual configurations to reproducible, automated environments using **Terraform, Ansible, and modern orchestration tools**.

  - Manage containerized workloads across Docker Swarm and Kubernetes, alongside hybrid virtualization (VMware, Proxmox, Nutanix) and bare-metal servers.

- **Reliability, SRE & Observability (Run):**

  - Own the end-to-end **Run** of the platform, ensuring high availability, disaster recovery readiness, and robust business continuity.

  - Implement proactive **observability** (metrics, logs, tracing via Datadog, Zabbix) to catch issues before they affect production.

- **Security & Compliance by Design:**

  - Embed security and compliance directly into the platform architecture, aligning with strict standards (including **ETSI EN 319 401**) and protecting our Certificate & Time Stamping Authorities.

What we believe should contribute to your success in this context **🎯**

- **Core Foundations:** Solid, battle-tested fundamentals in **Linux (Debian internals)** and **Networking**—these are non-negotiable prerequisites.

- **Experience:** Master’s degree in IT, Networks, or Systems, with **6+ years of experience** in infrastructure engineering across hybrid architectures (VMs, containers, physical servers).


- **The Product & Automation Mindset (The Real Challenge):**

  - You have a genuine shift in mindset: you see infrastructure as software and want to build **self-service, API-driven tools** rather than just performing ticket-based ops.

  - Strong expertise in **IaC and Orchestration** (Terraform, Ansible).

  - Familiarity with container orchestration ( **Kubernetes, Docker Swarm**).

- **Collaborative & Proactive:**

  - You enjoy working closely with developers, understanding their pain points, and building solutions that make their lives easier.

  - Proactive problem solver: you design for resilience, automation, and root-cause prevention.

- **Language Skills:** Fluency in **French and English** is mandatory.


**Interview process (indicative, may require additional stages if required)**

- HR Discovery Call (30 min)

- 1st interview with our business (direct report)

- Business case

- 2nd interview with our business & business case feedback

- Reference check


**Why Join Us 🤝**

- 👩🏽‍💻 Flexible hybrid work set up

- ⏰ Flexible working hours and A framework status with RTT

- 🏥 Health Insurance 100% covered

- 🍽️ Meal Vouchers (Ticket restaurants)

- 💂🏼‍♀️ Tailor-made onboarding and skills development program

- 📚 Access to specialized technical training platforms

- 🎂 Regular events to maintain a good atmosphere

- ✍🏻 Permanent role

- 💰 Annual base salary €63/69K€, depending on experience level.


**Join Our Vision** 🚀

Be part of Signaturit Group's journey to revolutionize digital transactions across Europe and beyond. We are excited to welcome fresh talent who are eager to make a meaningful impact in the digital world.

For more information, explore our [website](https://www.signaturit.com/) and discover how you can contribute to our mission.

Overview of the role

Lead the corporate finance, new business and credit control agenda for Automotive across UAE and overseas operations. You will safeguard liquidity, optimize working capital and evaluate strategic investments while maintaining robust credit governance. This role balances commercial growth with funding capacity, collectability and risk-adjusted returns.

What you will do

• Partner with Treasury, Tax, FP&A and business teams on cash conversion, funding requirements and currency exposures.

• Evaluate investments and capital expenditure through financial modelling, valuation, scenario analysis and post-investment reviews.

• Strong expertise in corporate finance, cash-flow forecasting, working-capital management and investment appraisal.

• Sound knowledge of credit assessment, security structures, receivables analytics and collections governance.

• Commercial judgement and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear executive recommendations.

• Strong stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation-support skills.

• Collaborative leadership, constructive challenge, integrity and delivery discipline.

Reporting to the General Manager – Divisional Finance, you will lead a team with five direct reports within Automotive Finance, supporting UAE and overseas operations. • Chartered Accountant, CPA, CFA, ACCA, MBA in Finance, or an equivalent professional qualification.

• 10 to 15 years of relevant finance experience, including leadership responsibility in corporate finance, treasury-facing roles, investments, new business, credit risk or collections governance.

• Demonstrated experience in financial modelling, business-case development, liquidity management, senior approvals and cross-functional collaboration.

• Treasury exposure covering cash forecasting, currency exposures and funding requests to a group treasury function.

• Experience owning or governing a customer credit framework, including risk appetite, limits, securities, delegated authority and portfolio reporting.

The mission of the F. David Fowler Career Center is to increase the number of business school students obtaining quality employment after graduation. In support of that mission, F. The Employer Relations Consultant works closely with employers who want to engage with GWSB talent. The core responsibility of this role is to provide employer introductions to students. The position assists with the collection and reporting of statistics on student employment outcomes. Additional responsibilities include providing relevant market insight to students, participating in career services events, and creating, developing, and maintaining relationships with industry-specific contacts. This position also plays an integral role in developing, delivering, and managing career development programs, workshops and classes to build foundational career skills of students. This role works with employers in all aspects of the employment relationship to facilitate the employment of students.

**Key responsibilities are:**

- Consults with employers and alumni to determine the best recruiting plan for their unique needs.
- Coordinates day to day employer activities (initiating new contacts, updating, scheduling and providing information to existing employers; coordinating with internal and external organizations to facilitate employer and career center needs).
- Coordinates marketing and branding to promote employer events to students.
- Hosts and monitors employer events to ensure employers receive “red carpet” service.
- Ensures the posting and advertising for jobs & events with career coaches, student leaders, professors and web-based resources.

title: Specjalista/ka Meta Ads
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 40 – 55 PLN / godz. netto
umowa zlecenie: 40 – 55 PLN / godz. brutto

O nas

W cwimedia nie jesteśmy agencją „od wszystkiego”. Od ponad 3 lat zajmujemy się wyłącznie marketingiem dla deweloperów.

Jesteśmy małym, celowo kameralnym zespołem. Nie planujemy rosnąć przez zatrudnianie dziesiątek osób. Rośniemy dzięki AI, automatyzacjom i ludziom, którzy biorą odpowiedzialność za swój obszar.

Kogo szukamy w jednym zdaniu

Marketera, który dobrze zna Meta Ads i umiejętnie wykorzystuje AI, a przy tym świetnie rozmawia i pisze z klientem. Poprowadzi wdrożenie od przyznania dostępów do działającego lejka. Komunikacja nie jest jego wąskim gardłem.

Czym się zajmiesz

Wdrożenia od A do Z

  • Przejmujesz klienta i prowadzisz go przez cały onboarding: brief, plik onboardingowy, materiały, dostępy, podpięcie kont. Mamy na to procedury.

  • Koordynujesz pracę z grafiem oraz osobą od stron www.

Kampanie i kreacja

  • Samodzielnie planujesz, uruchamiasz, optymalizujesz i skalujesz kampanie Meta Ads nastawione na pozyskanie zapytań o lokale.

  • Piszesz skrypty wideo i teksty reklamowe przy wsparciu AI, a potem dbasz o jakość zleconych grafik i montaży na bazie renderów i materiałów klienta.

  • Analizujesz cały lejek, nie tylko panel reklamowy. Patrzysz, co dzieje się z leadem po wypełnieniu formularza, i wyciągasz konkretne wnioski: co działa, co wyłączamy, co testujemy dalej.


Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy

  • Minimum 2 lata samodzielnego prowadzenia kampanii Meta Ads na pozyskiwanie kontaktów (leadów). Znasz menedżera reklam na wylot i wiesz, które wskaźniki naprawdę coś mówią.

  • Bardzo dobra komunikacja interpersonalna: umiejętność nawiązywania i utrzymywania relacji z klientami biznesowymi, asertywna postawa oraz zdolność przystępnego wyjaśniania złożonych zagadnień związanych z Meta Ads osobom spoza branży;

  • Praktyka w pracy z klientem B2B: swobodne prowadzenie korespondencji mailowej i spotkań online.

  • Praktyczną znajomość narzędzi AI w pracy z treścią i procesami. Wiesz, kiedy AI pomaga, a kiedy trzeba poprawić to, co wygenerowało.

  • Rozumienie, że dziś o wynikach w Meta decyduje przede wszystkim kreacja.

  • Samodzielność z rozsądkiem. Najpierw sam szukasz rozwiązania, pytasz bez wstydu, ale nie o drobiazgi.

  • Działalność gospodarczą (B2B) albo gotowość do współpracy na umowie zlecenie.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w marketingu nieruchomości lub znajomość realiów sprzedaży mieszkań (rezerwacje, etapy sprzedaży, biuro sprzedaży).

  • Znajomość Google Ads.

  • Podstawy techniczne: piksel i zdarzenia, lub podobne narzędzia do automatyzacji, ClickUp.

Co oferujemy

  • Wynagrodzenie: 40-55 PLN netto/h (B2B lub UZ), adekwatne do poziomu.

  • Jedną niszę i powtarzalny, sprawdzony system. Nie skaczesz między branżami, tylko pogłębiasz wiedzę o rynku nieruchomości.

  • Realny wpływ. W kilkuosobowym zespole Twoje decyzje i pomysły od razu widać w wynikach klientów.

  • Jasne role. Wiesz, za co odpowiadasz, a za co nie.

  • Rozwój w AI i automatyzacjach, dostęp do narzędzi i szkoleń oraz bezpośrednia współpraca z założycielem.

title: Results Based Management/Monitoring & Evaluation Associate (Open to Internal & External Applicants)
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The RBM/M&E Associate position falls under the PMSU unit within the UNDP Egypt office. In this context, the Programme Management Support Unit in UNDP Egypt provides a critical function by serving as the essential bridge between the office's programme and operations teams, ensuring that development initiatives are both strategically aligned and operationally sound. By offering centralized guidance on Programme Finance, Results-Based Management (RBM) and quality assurance, the unit enhances the impact of the UNDP Egypt Country Programme (2023–2027) through systematic monitoring, evaluation, and strict adherence to corporate compliance standards.

Under the direct supervision of the Programme Management Analyst (NOA), the RBM/M&E Associate provides support to the leadership in the execution of oversight and management performance, and supports the formulation, planning and management of the country programme and integrated support team by managing data and facilitating implementation of various initiatives and activities aiming to effectively deliver development results. The RBM/M & E Associate promotes a client-oriented approach consistent with UNDP rules and regulations. In this context, the incumbent is responsible for the continuous identification and updating of project risks (strategic, operational, financial, and political) within UNDP’s enterprise resource planning system (Quantum).

Duties and Responsibilities

1. Supports timely implementation and effective management of RBM and M&E for the country office and projects focusing on achievement of the following:

  • Supports the planning process of monitoring activities and follow up its implementation. Prepares project operational and administrative reports by collecting, selecting, reviewing and maintaining a wide range of information. Verifies that all projects are monitored in accordance with the monitoring plan. Informs deviations from the planned activities and identifies needs for reprogramming;
  • Provides technical assistance for quality assurance of the implementation of the monitoring process, results framework and management arrangements of projects to guarantee a result-based management approach. This includes regular review of progress against set targets at project level. Assists in the provision of guidance/inputs at the design stage of projects;
  • Supports the development of instruments to ensure a high quality of monitoring activities. Participates in results-oriented monitoring and evaluation training efforts in the Country Office;
  • Assists in the development, updating, effective and efficient implementation of the CO programme and projects’ Monitoring and Evaluation plans;
  • Assists in development of measurement and monitoring tools and identify data sources for programme and/or projects’ performance and indicators;
  • Supports establishment and coordination of effective mechanisms of monitoring the programme and projects’ implementation including development of evaluation processes using innovative approaches;
  • Supports preparation of the programme/project(s) Monitoring and Evaluation Plans capturing qualitative and quantitative aspects according to the annual work plans and log-frames;
  • Supports the programme/project team with data management and identifying programmatic/project issues and prompt corrective actions to enhance the programme/project objectives;
  • Supports the development and testing of M&E methods, revises and assists in the implementation of recommendations to improve the efficiency of current monitoring systems;
  • Prepares necessary M&E forms and format to capture necessary data and information from the field;
  • Supports and/or works to capture, document, and analyze that information and data from the projects’ activities in a results-based and timely manner;
  • Provides and/or supports coordination of inputs in developing the Annual Work Plans (AWPs), projects’ implementation plans, etc.;

2. Assists the effective management and implementation of the evaluations policies, strategies and processes focusing on achievement of the following:

  • Prepares reports and submits documents to the Government, UN Agencies and UNDP Headquarters by collecting and selecting relevant data from documents, legislation extracts, specialized publications and websites;
  • Drafts preliminary presentation of information;
  • Provides inputs in the formulation of Terms of Reference for outcome evaluations. Assists in the revision of TORs for specific project/thematic/sectorial evaluation missions and/or desk evaluations/reviews;
  • Participates in consultant and evaluation team selection and technical feedback on evaluations;
  • Assist in the process of carrying out evaluations (review of reports, participation in meetings, participation in the management and/or organization of seminars, meetings and other special events).

3. Provides administrative supports in preparation of reports completion of corporate online tools focusing on achievement of the following:

  • Enters and/or reviews projects’ data to the data management system (Quantum, Quantum+, IMRP and other systems), updates project-related data on websites, as needed;
  • Schedules and assigns responsibilities for activities/events needed for monitoring;
  • Assists in the identification of potential implementation problems and bottlenecks and contributes to the common M&E activity of the UNDP Country Office;
  • Supports programme/projects’ teams in conducting surveys, studies, assessments and similar activities;
  • Liaises with the Field Moniroting Assistants within broader UNDP M&E activities and efforts;
  • Maintains sound filing system including in the online SharePoint/MS Teams systems and appropriates use and recording of programme/project’s experience, activities and results;
  • Provides inputs, information and statistics for quarterly, annual and other reports;
  • Assists in the preparation of background documentation and working papers for its utilization in meetings with the Government and project authorities;

4. Facilitates knowledge building and knowledge sharing focusing on achievement of the following:

  • Identifies and formulates lessons learned and documents best practices from evaluations and studies to be integrated into programme reports;
  • Contributes to knowledge networks and communities of practice;
  • Under the supervision of the Head of Unit, establishes connections, coordinates and disseminates information, in both ways, within the team, with other relevant units and the whole office;
  • Contributes to regular capacity building of the programme/project(s) and CO staff on RBM, M&E and other relevant topics;
  • Supports programme/project teams in the promotion of monitoring and evaluation standards, quality assurance/control and capacity development;
  • Supports knowledge sharing and learning programme-wide in the MSU Team and the entire CO;

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

The incumbent will report directly to the Programme Management Analyst (NOA) and will work closely with the G7 RBM/M & E Associate. S/he will work closely with the other members of the PMSU team and the Programme team to support quality assurance and compliance of programme policies and procedures. The RBM/M&E Associate also works on project-specific tasks while ensuring compliance with UNDP Corporate Guidelines and is expected to act a liaison between project-level data collection and Country Office-level reporting, to better support Results-Oriented Annual Report (ROAR).

Competencies

Core

Achieve Results

 LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

Think Innovatively

 LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

Learn Continuously

 LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

Adapt with Agility

LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
Act with Determination LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident

Engage and Partner

 LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships

Enable Diversity and Inclusion

 LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies

Thematic Area Name Definition
Finance Management and cost accounting Ability to produce periodic qualitative and quantitative performance reports to facilitate effective decision making and performance monitoring. Ability to use a range of costing techniques and analyse cost related data to provide quantitative information to the users of reports.
Business Direction & Strategy Business Acumen Ability to understand and deal with a business situation in a manner that is likely to lead to a good outcome and understanding of the operational frameworks in the organization and ability to make good judgments and quick decisions within such frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of the operational frameworks in the organization.
Business Management Customer Satisfaction/Client Management Ability to respond timely appropriately and with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide inputs to the development of customer service strategy. Look for Za\s to add Value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.
Business Development Knowledge Generation Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need. Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. Knowledge of relevant concepts, conceptual models, and theories that can be useful in addressing new situations.
Business Management Risk Management Identify and organize action around reducing, mitigating and proactively managing risks.
2030 Agenda Engagement and Effectiveness

Effectiveness:Project Quality Assurance.
2030 Agenda Engagement and Effectiveness Effectiveness: RBM standards and practices for programming

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

  • Secondary education is required.
  • A university degree (bachelor´s degree) in Business Administration, Public Administration, or an equivalent field will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.

Experience:

Minimum of 6 years (with secondary education) or 3 years (with bachelor’s degree) of relevant programmame management support at the national or international level is required.

Required skills:

  • Experience in the use of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and advanced knowledge of web-based management systems such as ERP.
  • Experience using Excel at advanced level (pivot tables, data visualization).
  • Experience in data analytics.

Desired skills in addition to the competencies covered in the Competencies section:

  • Prior relevant working experience with the UN/UNDP, an international organization or an international NGO.
  • Experience in handling of web-based management systems (Quantum).
  • Direct experience applying and ensuring compliance with UN/UNDP rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Practical experience with the full range of programme and M&E processes and systems.

Professional Certificates:

Specialized certification in Administration or Procurement is desirable

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Data Privacy

Please click here to view UNDP Data Privacy Statement

title: Senior Linux Drivers Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Engineer - Linux Kernel and Device Driver to provide technical leadership for the architecture, development, and optimization of our low-level software stack. This role requires strong expertise in debugging complex system-level issues and performing root-cause analysis across hardware and software layers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build robust and scalable solutions for next-generation embedded systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, development, and maintenance of Linux kernel modules and subsystems, with a strong focus on device drivers for a variety of hardware interfaces (e.g., Ethernet, PCIe, USB, I2C, SPI, SGPIO, eSPI, Display).

  • Own the kernel-level aspects of system integration and board bring-up. Collaborate with hardware and other software teams to define interfaces, debug bring-up issues, and validate functionality.

  • Employ expert-level debugging skills to diagnose and resolve complex kernel-level issues, including kernel panics, race conditions, and tricky hardware-software interactions.

  • Partner with hardware and system-level software teams to define requirements, co-design interfaces, and ensure seamless hardware-software integration.

  • Participate in the broader Linux kernel community, contributing patches, and staying current with evolving kernel development.

  • Use advanced tools (e.g., ftrace, perf, kdump) to profile the kernel and drivers, and implement improvements for stability and performance.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in Linux kernel development, with a specialization in device drivers. Deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals, including memory management, process scheduling, and concurrency.

  • Proficiency in C/C++ and assembly programming for embedded systems.

  • Strong experience with Linux kernel, device drivers, and system-level software.

  • Proficiency in debugging tools such as GDB, JTAG, Lauterbach, serial consoles, and oscilloscopes.

  • Ability to perform root cause analysis for hardware/software interaction issues.

  • Hands-on experience with embedded Linux systems, Drivers, Board Support Packages (BSPs), and bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot).

  • Familiarity with one or more of the hardware communication protocols like I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, USB, SGPIO, eMMC, eSPI, Display, and Ethernet.

  • Experience with Yocto Project, Buildroot, and cross-compilation toolchains.

  • Experience with Software open-source methodologies for Linux Kernel and related projects is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse technical teams.

Hvem vi ser etter:
Vi ser etter en psykiatrisk sykepleier/sykepleier med stort engasjement og gode samarbeidsevner. Du vil bli en viktig ressurs i vårt tverrfaglige team bestående av kompetente og dyktige kollegaer.

Arbeidsoppgaver:
Ved Avdeling for familiebehandling vil du få muligheten til å jobbe med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver i et tverrfaglig og inspirerende arbeidsmiljø. Avdelingen har inntil 6 familieplasser og tilbyr par- og familiebehandling til familier hvor de voksne har psykiske lidelser som angst, depresjon og traumelidelser i moderat til alvorlig grad. Dette samtidig med et dysfunksjonelt par- og familiesamspill. Vi jobber etter modellen Emosjonsfokusert parterapi (EFT-C).

Som sykepleier vil du ha ansvar for sykepleiefaglige oppgaver som somatiske oppgaver og medikamenthåndtering, miljøterapeutisk oppfølging av enkeltfamilier, samt delta i gruppeaktiviteter og familieterapi-samtaler.

Stillingen er en dagtidsstilling med arbeidstid kl.08.00-15.30, tidligvakt fra 07.30-.15.00. Stillingen innebærer ikke arbeid i helger eller helligdager. I forbindelse med jul og påske er det samordning på tvers av Modum Bad.

Kvalifikasjoner:
Vi søker en autorisert spesialsykepleier i psykisk helse, eventuelt sykepleier med annen relevant erfaring og kompetanse. Erfaring fra familieterapi og arbeid med barn og unge er en fordel. Det legges vekt på arbeidserfaring og personlig egnethet.

Personlige egenskaper:
Vi ønsker en lagspiller med gode samarbeidsevner som evner å jobbe målrettet og resultatorientert. Du viser interesse for faglig utvikling og er en pådriver for delingskultur. Du er en positiv bidragsyter til både det sosiale og faglige arbeidsmiljøet og har kunnskap om egne holdninger og handlinger i møte med andre. Du må ha god norsk språk- og kulturforståelse.

Avdeling for familiebehandling:
Avdeling for familiebehandling har et godt faglig behandlingsmiljø, med høy kompetanse innen fagfeltet for familieterapi og systemisk tilnærming. Sentrale elementer i behandlingsprogrammet er par- og familieterapi, miljøterapi, undervisning, gruppeterapi, utrykksterapi og fysisk aktivitet. Innenfor de rammene vi har ved avdelingen, vil hvert behandlingsforløp tilpasses behovene hos den enkelte familie. Avdelingen har tett samarbeid med Forskingsinstituttet på Modum Bad og bruker et elektronisk pasient tilbakemeldingsverktøy, M-POQ, som legger grunnlaget for en evidensbasert praksis.

Modum Bad er en foregangsinstitusjon som kontinuerlig utvikler tjenestetilbudet i tråd med ny kunnskap og faglig forståelse. Vi vektlegger verdier som kvalitet, samarbeid og pasientfokus, og sammen skaper vi et arbeidsmiljø som er preget av faglig dyktighet og et sterkt kollegialt fellesskap.

Hva vi tilbyr:
Modum Bad tilbyr et godt tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø med utfordrende oppgaver og muligheter for faglig utvikling. Vi tilbyr lønn etter avtale, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, tilgang til hytte for personalet, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden og andre velferdstiltak. Det finnes også muligheter for etter- og videreutdanning.

Det forventes at alle ansatte bidrar til å virkeliggjøre våre verdier og vår visjon.

Søknad:
Vi ønsker at du søker elektronisk.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Stilling: Platform Engineer
Arbeidssted: Fornebu eller Oslo, Norge
Mulighet for hjemmekontor: 50 %
Krav til fysisk tilstedeværelse: Fornebu, 2–3 dager per uke

Om rollen:

Vi søker en erfaren fagperson som kan bidra til å etablere og drifte alternativer til dagens samhandlings-, dokumentasjons- og oppgavehåndteringsverktøy, som i dag er basert på Confluence, Jira og Slack.

Den aktuelle kandidaten vil jobbe i et lite internt team og samarbeide med sentrale nøkkelpersoner utenfor teamet, blant annet innen arkitektur og design.

Konsulentens hovedansvar vil være det tekniske eierskapet til applikasjonene, og ikke ansvar for prosesser eller arbeidsmetodikk (Ways of Working – WoW).

Rollen vil primært ha ansvar for de strategiske og tekniske aspektene knyttet til valg, utvikling, implementering og drift av samhandlingsverktøy.

Konsulenten må ha tilstrekkelig kompetanse på plattformens kjøremiljø, spesielt Kubernetes, for å kunne etablere, vedlikeholde og integrere disse applikasjonene.

Vedkommende vil ikke ha ansvar for drift eller vedlikehold av selve Kubernetes-plattformen, men må ha god kompetanse i å bruke den.

Krav til samhandlingsløsningene:

De valgte løsningene bør oppfylle følgende kriterier:

  • Sikkerhet og etterlevelse: Være egnet for håndtering av informasjon gradert K (Konfidensielt) i henhold til sikkerhetsloven.

  • Moderne og brukervennlige: Tilby intuitive brukergrensesnitt og moderne funksjonalitet.

  • Integrasjonsmuligheter: Kunne integreres med andre verktøy og arbeidsprosesser, inkludert kunstig intelligens (KI/AI).

  • Skalerbarhet og pålitelighet: Være skalerbare, robuste og driftssikre i produksjonsmiljøer.

  • Kostnadseffektivitet: Være kostnadseffektive og bærekraftige over tid.

  • Tilpasset utviklingsteam: Oppfylle de spesifikke behovene til utviklings- og produktteam.

  • Lav grad av leverandørbinding: Minimere avhengigheten av enkeltleverandører, for eksempel gjennom bruk av åpne standarder.

  • Enkel forvaltning: Være enkle å administrere, vedlikeholde og videreutvikle.

Kompetanse og kvalifikasjoner:

For å lykkes i oppdraget bør kandidaten ha relevant kompetanse og erfaring innen følgende områder:

  • Erfaring med utvikling og drift av applikasjoner på private skyplattform (Titan), inkludert containerisering, Kubernetes, automatisert utrulling, skalering, sikkerhetskopiering og gjenoppretting.

  • Kompetanse innen Git, GitHub Actions, automatisering, konfigurasjonsstyring og observability (overvåkning og innsikt i systemenes tilstand).

  • Erfaring med etablering og vedlikehold av sikre løsninger, inkludert sårbarhetshåndtering, logging og sikkerhetsoppdateringer, også for eksisterende løsninger.

  • Erfaring med Single Sign-On (SSO), autentisering, autorisasjon og integrasjon med virksomhetens katalog- og identitetsløsninger.

  • God erfaring med API-er, webhooks, e-postintegrasjoner, varslingssystemer og koblinger til eksisterende interne systemer.

  • Kandidaten må kunne sikkerhetsklareres til nivå K (Konfidensielt) i henhold til sikkerhetsloven og være villig til å gjennomgå den nødvendige klareringsprosessen. Aktiv sikkerhetsklarering er en stor fordel.

  • Det er en fordel om kandidaten har erfaring med alternative samhandlingsløsninger, for eksempel åpen kildekode (open source), samt kjennskap til beste praksis innen samhandlingsverktøy og samarbeidsplattformer.


Rekrutteringspartner: Sperton

Denne stillingen håndteres av Sperton, en global rekrutteringspartner som kobler dyktige fagpersoner med ledende virksomheter over hele verden.

title: OD & Learning Partner - 8m contract

  • Lead the delivery and ongoing evolution of MAX (Manager Accelerator Programme), including programme evaluation, impact assessment and alumni engagement.

  • Design and develop fit-for-purpose learning solutions that support leadership development, employee experience, health and safety, and change initiatives.

  • Contribute as an active member of the People & Performance team, continually seeking opportunities to enhance the value and impact of our work.

What You'll Bring...

You'll bring a passion for learning, development and organisational effectiveness, along with the ability to build strong relationships and influence at all levels of the business.

You'll also have:

  • Experience in Learning & Development, Organisational Development, or a related field.

  • Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with leaders and teams.

  • Experience in learning needs analysis, instructional design and learning development.

  • The ability to translate business challenges into practical, engaging learning solutions.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong communication, planning and organisational skills.

Our Hamilton office is located in a park-like setting, with tennis court, pool, and onsite café and bar.

If you're energised by helping people grow, developing leadership capability, and creating learning experiences that have a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and help build the capability that enables LIC and New Zealand farmers to thrive into the future.

title: Service Quality Officer
description:
Could you imagine building and overseeing a quality assurance framework that guarantees thousands of adolescent girls and young women receive safe, high-standard, and dignified health services across a network of clinics, pharmacies, and healthcare providers in Ethiopia?

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJYCIChXdKE).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_We welcome applicants who are available to work from__Adama City Oromia region__, Ethiopia._

The Job

At Tiko, we do not compromise on the safety, dignity, or quality of care provided to young women. We build fast-moving, technology-driven ecosystems that empower adolescent girls across Sub-Saharan Africa to address the "Triple Threat" of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV). As our Service Quality Officer based in Adama City (Oromia region, Ethiopia), you will be the chief custodian of provider standards on our platform across local health ecosystems. Your core mission is to ensure that every provider—from public and private health clinics to independent pharmacies—delivers uncompromised care to our end users.

This is a dynamic, high-accountability role. You will bridge the gap between regional healthcare regulations, local market realities, and real-time user feedback. From setting up independent auditor pools to enforcing strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and translating rating data into continuous quality improvements, you will drive accountability across our entire health provider network.

Key Responsibilities

Policy & Governance

- Standard Optimisation: Tailor and continuously update Quality Assurance operating procedures to reflect evolving Ethiopian healthcare regulations, regional Oromia market conditions, and Tiko platform standards.
- SLA & Franchisor Management: Oversee and enforce Service Level Agreements with diverse clinical partners and franchisors, tracking compliance, maintaining governance records, and swiftly flagging breaches.
- Independent Provider Network: Contract, onboard, and manage a pool of independent health providers on the platform, ensuring they are thoroughly vetted, trained, and capable of operating to our quality benchmarks.

Audit Infrastructure & Capacity Building

- Auditor Pool Coordination: Establish and coordinate an independent pool of quality auditors responsible for certifying and auditing platform providers against set clinical standards.
- Training Gap Analysis: Continuously assess provider and field employee training gaps across health offers, executing targeted on-the-job training for clinics and community pharmacies.
- System Evaluation: Regularly evaluate Tiko’s operational workflows and digital systems to identify and mitigate any systemic bottlenecks that could compromise service quality.

Beneficiary-Centric Quality Improvement

- User Feedback Loops: Solicit and analyse feedback from end users, beneficiaries, and community actors to assess whether health services meet set minimum care standards.
- Data-Driven Accountability: Leverage user rating data, audit reports, and performance trends to provide strategic recommendations for quality improvement and hold service providers accountable.
- Documentation & Reporting: Develop and maintain meticulous quality reports, compliance records, and risk logs to inform leadership and drive organizational learning


About You

You are a deeply customer-centric professional with an eye for detail and a passion for clinical quality, safety, and systemic accountability. You bring a global perspective to service quality processes and do not hesitate to challenge sub-standard practices. You possess brilliant communication skills, enabling you to build constructive relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders—from public health authorities and clinical franchisors to community pharmacists. You are an adaptive, growth-oriented pioneer who is driven by the knowledge that your QA rigor directly protects the well -being of young women.

Requirements

- Sector Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of proven experience in a Quality Improvement or Quality Assurance role within the health clinical services sector (mandatory, with direct exposure to SRHR highly preferred).
- Audit & Systems Mastery: In-depth knowledge of modern Quality Management Systems (QMS) alongside hands-on experience designing and executing clinical health quality improvement audits.
- Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated track record of managing multi-stakeholder QA operations, including SLAs, clinical networks, and independent auditor frameworks.
- Communication & Location: Confident and clear English and Ormifa communication skills (written and verbal). You must be currently based in or available to work from Adama City, Oromia region, Ethiopia (mandatory).

Compensation & Benefits

The gross salary range per month for this position is €1,710 - €2,138. Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

- Benefits and allowances tailored to your location.
- Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
- A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website [Tiko – Do more with Tiko](https://tiko.org/). We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

- Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
- Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the [Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme](https://misconduct-disclosure-scheme.org/). As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures._

title: Programme Manager
description:
Company: Ultra Intelligence & Communications

Cyber (UK) Business

## **Powering Decision**

Join the team redefining defense technology. From engineering systems that save lives to leading programs that change the battlefield—find your place in the future of defense.

**Cyber Business**

Our Cyber business unit is at the forefront of pioneering advanced cryptographic and key management solutions, facilitating the confidential exchange of vital information for customers operating at both tactical and strategic echelons. Join our team and participate in the innovation that ensures the highest security and trust worldwide.

## **Job Description**

This role is based at our Cyber Centre of Excellence in Maidenhead.

Due to the sensitive nature of our work, you will be required to work on-site for a minimum of four days per week.

Ultra Cyber Ltd is seeking an accomplished Programme Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, multidisciplinary engineering programme.

This is a pivotal role, accountable for driving successful outcomes across the full project lifecycle—from bid development and concept definition through delivery, acceptance, and close-out.

You will provide strong leadership and governance, guiding projects through defined stage gates while ensuring schedule, cost and quality objectives are met. Working closely with technical, commercial, and wider business stakeholders, you will bring structure, pace, and assurance to the delivery of highly complex technical solutions.

The ideal candidate will have experience within Defence or closely-related engineering programmes, with a proven track record of managing large-scale and technically demanding projects and or programmes in highly regulated structured delivery environments.

**Notice:**

All candidates must be willing and able to obtain and maintain DV Security Clearance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes across the full project lifecycle, from bid and concept development through delivery and close-out.

- Provide strong project leadership and direction, establishing clear governance structures and successfully managing projects through defined lifecycle and assurance gates.
- Develop, maintain, and control detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets, ensuring delivery in line with agreed scope, cost, and timescale commitments.
- Direct and coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, procurement, and external partners, to achieve project objectives.
- Partner closely with the Engineering Project Lead to ensure rigorous adherence to systems engineering processes, technical governance, and design assurance.
- Proactively manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, implementing effective mitigation strategies and ensuring timely escalation where required.
- Provide clear, concise, and accurate project reporting, communicating status, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leadership.
- Ensure full compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, security standards, and quality frameworks throughout the project lifecycle.
- Drive continuous improvement in project delivery methodologies, tools, and governance, embedding lessons learned and best practice.
- Lead, manage, and coach a team of project managers to deliver the scope of complex engineering design, development and qualification programmes.

**Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:**

- Solid experience in project/programme management within a defence, IT, engineering, or technology environment.
- Proven experience delivering large and complex projects or programmes within a technical or technical  environment.

- Experience managing programme budgets, forecasting, and resource planning.
- An awareness and understanding of engineering principles and lifecycle models.

- Experience with structured project management methodologies such as Waterfall, Scrum and Agile.

- Excellent stakeholder management, both internal and external, with superb communication skills.

- Experience managing contracts for and interfacing with a government customer.

- Strong leadership and team coordination capabilities.

- Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira).

- Experience in shaping and delivering costed proposals for new business, either as growth on an existing contract or through the Business Development function for new business opportunities.
- Formal certification in project management (e.g., APM PMQ, PRINCE2, AgilePM).
- High levels of integrity, professionalism, and ethical behaviour, demonstrating and promoting Ultra's values.

**Desirable Experience, Skills and Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
- Additional qualifications in programme management, business management, engineering, or leadership.
- Experience with defence, aerospace, or highly regulated industries.

- Experience delivering projects involving software, firmware and hardware integration.
- In-depth understanding of the Systems Engineering V-Lifecycle.

- Experience managing physical production and/or product through life support.

## **Notice**

Due to the nature of the programs we deliver for our customers, candidates may need to obtain the relevant security clearance or handle export-controlled material as defined by the role's requirements. Applicants must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance for the role. Due to the nature of our work, you must be a British Citizen who has been resident in the UK for the past 5 years in order to apply for SC clearance and 10 years for DV. For more information, please visit the UKSV website.

**Our Benefits**

Every employee is critical to our success, and as such, we offer a range of flexible employee benefits, including:

- Participation in an Annual Bonus Scheme

- Private Medical Cover

- 25 days’ holiday (plus Bank Holidays) with the option to buy an extra 5 days

- Pension Contribution

- 4 x Life Assurance Cover

- Flexible working hours with opportunity for a 1pm finish on a Friday

- Flexible benefits including cycle to work scheme, will writing and more

- Security Clearance Allowance – where relevant and subject to you holding the required security clearance


## **Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Statement**

At Ultra I&C, we are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusivity. Underpinned by our values, behaviours, and policies, we want you to feel empowered to be the best version of yourself. We also believe that people from different backgrounds and cultures will increase our diversity of thinking, ensuring we successfully deliver to our customers. We, therefore, do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **About the project**

Costain are working with Thames Water on a variety of water and wastewater projects and have fantastic opportunities for individuals to join our growing AMP8 delivery team, working predominantly across the Thames Valley and Thames South regions. There is a mix of projects ranging from smaller capital maintenance to large civil new build schemes.

**Apprenticeships at Costain**

At Costain, we’ve got an exciting range of apprenticeships available—working on innovative projects across the UK in sectors like highways, rail, integrated transport, water, energy, and nuclear & defence. There’s truly something for everyone.

Our apprenticeships run from Level 2 to Level 6, with durations of 1 to 6 years. We’ll work with you to find the best route based on your current qualifications, skills, and preferred way of learning.

Being an apprentice means you’ll get the best of both worlds: earning while you learn. You’ll be gaining real experience day-to-day with your team, alongside off-the-job learning with your apprenticeship provider and other apprentices in similar roles.

Throughout your apprenticeship, you’ll be supported every step of the way—by your line manager and team, the Costain Early Careers Team, and your training provider (which could be a college, a university, or an independent training provider).

You’ll also have dedicated time to study with your provider. Your on-site work will be matched to the needs of the project, and it’s designed to ensure you’re building the technical skills and competencies you need to successfully complete your apprenticeship.

And to make it even better, we recommend joining our Graduate and Apprentice network (GRaAPs). It’s a great way to meet other Early Careers colleagues, learn about exciting projects and teams across Costain, and find support and inspiration for what you do next.

Many of our projects are delivered through joint ventures, too—so you’ll have the opportunity to meet even more apprentices and learn from partners, sharing skills and working practices along the way.

### Description

Watch here to see a quick glimpse into careers with Electrical Services!

At Western Municipal Water District ("Western Water ") we believe in a one-team mindset and prioritize collaboration within the department and throughout the agency (across people, processes, resources) — no silos here. Together, we work to understand and anticipate Western Water's needs.

**Who we are**

Western Water is one of the largest public agencies in Riverside County providing water and wastewater (sewer) services to nearly one million people across 527-square-miles of inland southern California. Our customers are an essential partner in ensuring long-term water resiliency for our region. Together, the Western Water team is focused on being the definitive leader in water and wastewater (sewer) services, upholding the highest level of stakeholder trust, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience.

**Western's values include:**

- Service Excellence
- Efficiency
- WaterSupply Reliability
- Fiscal Responsibility and Value
- PublicTrust,Accountabilityand Transparency
- Environmental Stewardship
- Employee Empowerment
- Innovation

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Western Water is seeking a journey- to advanced-level electrician to join our Electrical Services Team as an Operations Technician Ill or IV (Electrical Services). This position plays a vital role in ensuring the operational integrity, efficiency, and safety of electrical systems across our water and wastewater treatment facilities.

As part of the Electrical Services Team, you will focus exclusively on electrical systems and be responsible for maintaining the District's water and wastewater infrastructure. This includes work on:

- 480V-5kV power distribution systems
- Switchboards, transformers, and grounding systems
- Motor control centers (MCCs)
- Variable speed drives (VFDs/VSDs)
- Emergency backup generators and UPS systems
- Solar electrical systems
- Process and safety instrumentation

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with power distribution systems, motors and motor controls, and be confident working independently in the field performing skilled electrical maintenance, repair, and installation work.

Operations Technicians receive their direction from a Senior Operations Technician as well as the Operations Supervisor.

District employees are expected to work overtime, weekends, evenings and holidays as required to accommodate Western Water's needs, in addition to responding as a Disaster Emergency Service Worker.

### Examples of Duties

The **_Operations Technician III_** is the full journey-level class in the Technician series. Under minimal guidance and direction, incumbents carry out duties and assignments requiring full technical knowledge and skill in the work of an assigned unit. Incumbents work under general supervision while exercising independent judgment within established functions and procedures.

The **_Operations Technician IV_** is the advanced-level class in the Technician series. Under general direction, incumbents work independently to carry out duties and assignments requiring advanced technical knowledge and skill. Incumbents exercise independent judgment in the interpretation of procedures and regulations, participate in special projects, and provide training to entry or journey level employees. Incumbents may provide oversight of operational areas or subordinate staff as assigned.

Selected candidate will be placed into the level of position commensurate with experience. Incumbents within the Operations Technician series report to an Operations Field Manager. Operations Technicians may receive general direction from a Senior Operations Technician I/II.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to this classification.

- May perform grounds maintenance, weed abatement and facilities cleaning duties, some of which requires heavy manual labor.
- Operate a cell phone, and a mobile and/or base station two-way radio for dispatching and routine communications.
- Investigate public complaints and recommend corrective action.
- Maintain accurate and legible records for timesheets, workload planning, and related documents in accordance with state and federal laws, regulations, and District policies and procedures.
- Utilize and maintain detailed records for use within the Computerized Work Management System (CWMS).
- Participate in safety training programs and other related functions.
- Inspect, operate, calibrate, and maintain light/heavy equipment linked to department functions.
- Perform inspections and maintenance of District facilities, equipment, tools, and vehicles.
- Monitor and utilize the District's SCADA system as required by department or call team roles.
- Coordination and purchase of department supplies or equipment.
- Operate GPS equipment in order to locate and survey District systems as determined by department functions.
- Perform lockout/tag out (LOTO) procedures to block electrical and other energy sources utilizing District safety policies and procedures.
- Perform duties in confined spaces utilizing District safety policies and procedures.
- Perform a variety of semi-skilled and skilled maintenance, operational, and repair tasks involved in the District's water or wastewater systems.
- Contingent upon meeting certification and experience requirements, employees may be assigned to the appropriate department call team to provide continuous operational services in accordance with the California Municipal Water District Act of 1911. This requirement is at the sole discretion of the District and typically occurs on a rotating basis for a 1-2 week period following supervisor approval.
- Must maintain a valid California Driver License.
- Contingent upon meeting certification and experience requirements, employees may be assigned to the after hour response team to provide continuous operational services in accordance with the California Municipal Water District Act of 1911.
- Must maintain a valid California Driver License.

**Electrical/Instrumentation****Services Team:**

**Working hours and schedules may change with operational need**.

_The Electrical/Instrumentation_ team is responsible for the maintenance for all Western Water pumping systems, process equipment, control systems and facilities. The department provides timely and cost effective testing, repair, maintenance, modification and installation of electrical power distribution, motors and motor controls, as well as, analytical, and process instrumentation. The performance of this team is essential to ensuring the reliability of Western Water's assets for the purposes of providing consistent district services. Operations Technicians are expected to exercise their skills in the areas noted below:

- Perform preventative and predictive maintenance of district analytical instrumentation, safety instrumentation, process control instrumentation equipment, and facilities.
- Perform a wide variety of electrical service and repair tasks to machinery, equipment, and electrical systems. Including 5 KV power distribution systems, switchboards, motor control centers (MCC's), VSD's, transformers, power panels, grounding systems, generators, automatic transfer switches, uninterruptable power supply (UPS) systems, solar arrays, etc.
- Maintain detailed records for use within the Computerized Work Management System (CWMS).
- Assist with research, writing, and maintaining of Energy Control Procedures (SOPs) for the District Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) program.
- Assignment to Call Team may be required.

### Typical Qualifications

- Know and understand District personnel rules, policies and labor contract provisions with the ability to exercise sound independent judgment within general policy guidelines.

- Independently oversee and direct crews during after-hour activities and emergency response.
- Utilize exceptional customer service and communication skills both verbally and in writing, with the ability to cultivate professional business partnerships and inspire team collaboration.
- Think creatively and seek alternative solutions in order to produce results that benefit Western Water, its internal and external customers, while clearly articulating options to management and policy makers.
- Use modern office equipment including basic computer software applications, and those related to the field of work.
- Define and explain key processes and business requirements within the department.
- Make effective and engaging oral presentations clearly, logically and persuasively.
- Highly motivated professional who is a self-starter, resourceful and able to work independently with minimum supervision.

title: Mobile Engineering Team Lead
description:
Do you have experience creating and maintaining software that enables mobile apps to function?  Are you looking to utilize your skillset whilst having a positive impact with tech?  Read on to find out more about our Mobile Engineering Team Lead position!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9nxt4LcByn0).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_For this position, we are happily looking for candidates currently based in Portugal, Kenya and South Africa._

The Job

The Mobile Engineering Team Lead is responsible for management tasks in addition to creating and maintaining the software that enables our platform to function.

- You coordinate the work that the mobile engineer team needs to do. You are actively involved in cross-team projects that involve development.
- You are responsible for the maintenance and development of new features on our software platform.

- You apply software engineering principles to the design, development, maintenance, testing, and evaluation of our software.
- You ensure that the software you develop is secure and safe when it comes to data protection.

About You

Having experience with mobile development and the principles of design, development maintenance, and more, you're excited by technology and passionate about utilizing it for social impact.

Requirements

- You have technical experience with Kotlin and firebase.
- You’re a natural problem solver and naturally logical - you are always pioneering for the best solution.
- You’ve experienced working in a team environment, as well as independently.
- You don’t want to just write code, you want to make it with quality and scalable
- You have excellent English Skills.

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Second Interview - Whiteboard Technical Session | Final interview with the Tech Team

Kenya: Ksh444,178 - Ksh740,000 (x12)

South Africa: R88,008 - R140,000 (x12)

Portugal: €3,660 - €5,500 (x14)

Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

- Benefits and allowances tailored to your location
- Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
- A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The details
