title: Senior Frontend Platform Engineer
description:
Who we are: 
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.
We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.
Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


We are the Client Platform team. We help other developers at Rover build high quality experiences quickly by focusing on underlying tools and frameworks. 
We manage and build out core tooling and platforms for frontend development across the web and mobile apps at Rover. We on rare occasion will work in our Django backend, but it’s not a focus for our team. We are looking for this role to be primarily focused on web and React Native frontend. 
Some of our key investments :
Continuing to expand our cross-platform Design System. We maintain the shared library of re-usable components that make it easy to build cross-platform apps quickly.
Moving the website to be served from Next.js. We are migrating the fundamental tech used to serve Rover.com to a community supported SSR platform. 
Making it easier to build with AI. Building workflows, skills, techniques, and approaches for AI-based development and migrations across all teams. 
Moving Rover to a React Native-first app + development cycle. We are completing our React Native migration (now serving 90+% mobile views) and fully migrating to a React Native development cycle. 
Managing Rover’s adoption of modern tech - notably Next.js, React Query, Expo, and others. 
As a Platform team, we build out the fundamental tech that powers the internals of Rover.com and the mobile apps. We empower developers to be able to focus more on building great experiences than fighting their tech.

Technologies
Rover.com is primarily built in React, served either from a SSR or Django backend, and compiled with Webpack. Our client API is written in Python in Django, which serves over 2 billion requests a month. Our mobile apps are a majority React Native. 
Our development environment centers around ready-to-use Codespaces. At Rover, we deploy to the web 40-60 times a day, with a median review -> merge time for PRs of 3 hours. So all that to say - we prioritize shipping small, incremental work often and quickly!

The role
We are looking for someone with a primarily web development background who is excited to work both on Web React and React Native. As a senior engineer on our team, you will:


Solve complex technical problems at the fundamentals of our web and React Native clients.


Work to set technical standards across Rover; then evangelize and educate on those standards. 


Build cross-platform code that works across both web and React Native.


Help to set a technical roadmap and vision for the team. We don’t have a partner Product Manager, and so “set our own destiny” in a sense.


Work with other engineers in Barcelona to help mentor them and answer questions on Client Platform topics. 


Represent Client Platform in broad forums and collect feedback that helps inform the team’s roadmap and vision. 


Help mentor and coach more junior engineers.


We are expanding our team’s presence in Barcelona. We are looking for this role to be a mix of contributing and driving the frontend platform while also supporting and upleveling other Barcelona teams.
This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

AI/LLM based development
Rover engineers, including this team, are heavy users of Claude for daily engineering practices. We have seen the benefits over the last year, and are convinced that we can build software that is better, more ambitious, and more quickly by smartly using these tools. It is an expectation that you adopt those practices in role, and ideally bring experience and perspectives of your own. 
AI Native
Client Platform aims to generally be “AI Native” with work. We are reworking our workflows to adopt AI practices to be central. This means things such as: using workflows to handle large migrations, iterating on Claude skills, developing codebase context. It also impacts how we accomplish our work, from reorganizing how we go about our days to restructuring PR descriptions. 
 
Principles
Alongside our move to AI Native workflows, we recognize that LLMs can’t do everything. These are actively being developed, but a few principles / working agreements on our team around AI use are:


You are still responsible for your code. AI should be used to expand understanding, not substitute for it. “Claude did it” is not an excuse. 


Text intended for humans should be written by humans. Slack messages, PR descriptions, design docs, etc should all still be written by you. We don’t want to read your undigested Claude output – copy-pasting AI output is just shifting the burden of comprehension to another. 


PR authors are responsible for making their PRs easily reviewable. The more complex/large a PR, the more the author needs to do for others.

Your qualifications
We are looking for a senior level engineer, with a rich background of solving complex web and react native issues. You may not have all of these, but some of the things you will bring are:


7+ years as a professional software developer


Expertise with Javascript frameworks (especially React) and component-driven design.


Experience in React Native development. 


Expertise in multiple parts of our tech stack (see above).


Experience building re-usable frontend libraries. 


Experience handling large-scale technology upgrades across a broad range of a codebase.


An excitement for defining technical standards that make sense for the organization.


Experience coaching more junior developers.


Rigor in automated testing, code quality, and engineering standard methodologies.


A focus on observability, a propensity to ship code with effective monitoring and logging.


Intuition for when to call it "good enough", and when to put in the extra time to polish.


You’re aligned with Rover Core Values.

Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going 
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office

Compensation
In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €62,722 - €76,027. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.

title: Senior Cloud & Security Engineer
company: Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity
description:
Are you an experienced Cloud and Security Engineer with a passion for platform engineering, cloud-native architecture and building secure, scalable infrastructure?

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Cloud and Security Engineer to help shape and evolve Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity's cloud platform, playing a key role in our cloud-first transformation and Cyber Security Programme.

Working closely with the Cloud and Security Lead, you'll take technical ownership of complex platform engineering initiatives, designing and delivering secure, resilient and cost-effective cloud infrastructure. You'll help establish reusable infrastructure components, automation and engineering standards that enable teams to deploy and operate cloud services securely and efficiently.

**Salary** The salary for this position is £68,000 per annum, and we operate a hybrid working policy requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in the office.

In line with our EDI strategy and Total Reward policy, we calculate our salaries based on benchmarking data across the charity sector. To ensure fairness for existing staff and new joiners, we do not offer salaries above the advertised rate.

#### Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Platform Engineering: Lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and platform services across AWS and Azure, ensuring alignment with agreed architectural and security standards.
- Platform Architecture: Independently assess technical requirements, evaluate architectural options and deliver cloud-native solutions that balance security, resilience, operational maintainability and cost.
- Infrastructure as Code: Design, develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules, infrastructure components and standardised deployment patterns to enable consistent and secure infrastructure provisioning.
- DevSecOps and CI/CD: Design, build and optimise CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated security controls, infrastructure validation and deployment practices across cloud environments.
- Cloud Security: Implement and maintain security controls across cloud platforms and workloads, including identity and access management, network security, data protection, monitoring and compliance.
- Platform Automation: Develop automation and tooling to streamline infrastructure management, improve reliability, reduce manual intervention and address technical debt.
- Technical Ownership: Independently deliver assigned platform engineering initiatives from discovery and technical design through implementation, validation and operational handover, coordinating dependencies with internal teams and external suppliers.
- Security and Risk Management: Conduct technical risk assessments, support threat modelling and incident investigations, and translate security frameworks and compliance requirements into practical engineering controls.
- Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance, review engineering solutions and mentor other engineers, promoting reusable patterns, secure engineering practices and continuous improvement.
- Platform Operations: Support the ongoing reliability, observability, performance and cost optimisation of cloud infrastructure, contributing to the evolution of the Charity's cloud-first operating model.

#### Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

We're looking for a technically strong, hands-on engineer with experience designing, building and operating secure cloud platforms, and the ability to independently deliver complex infrastructure solutions.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, architecture and security controls, including designing and operating secure cloud infrastructure.
- Experience designing and implementing cloud-native architectures, with a strong understanding of scalability, resilience, availability and cost optimisation.
- Extensive practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, including developing reusable infrastructure components and modules.
- Experience designing, implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitLab or GitHub, incorporating automated infrastructure deployments and security controls.
- Strong knowledge of AWS networking, including VPCs, routing, NAT gateways, private endpoints, connectivity and network security.
- Experience implementing DevOps and DevSecOps practices, integrating security and compliance controls into infrastructure delivery.
- Experience building, deploying and managing containerised infrastructure using technologies such as Docker.
- Experience developing automation and tooling using scripting languages such as Bash or PowerShell.
- Experience administering and securing Linux or Windows operating systems.
- Knowledge of cloud security principles and industry frameworks, including CIS, NIST and ISO, and experience translating requirements into practical technical controls.
- Experience conducting technical risk assessments, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending proportionate security improvements.
- Strong technical judgement and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently assess requirements, evaluate solutions and deliver complex engineering work.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering teams, engage technical suppliers and explain architectural decisions to stakeholders.

**Desirable Experience and Skills**

- Experience developing reusable platform services, standardised deployment patterns and self-service infrastructure capabilities.
- Experience implementing cloud observability, monitoring and operational resilience practices.
- Experience communicating technical risks, architectural trade-offs and recommendations to senior non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience using programming languages such as Python, Java or C++.
- Hands-on experience with security assessment tools, vulnerability management and penetration testing methodologies.
- Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements such as GDPR, PCI DSS and SOC 2.
- Industry-recognised cloud or security certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect.

DBS - note a basic DBS check is required for this role.

title: Field Disease Control Officer- For Internal Candidates Only, H09
description:
Org. Setting and Reporting
UNRWA is a United Nations agency established by the General Assembly in 1949 and is mandated to provide assistance and protection to a population of some 5.8 million registered Palestine refugees. Its mission is to help Palestine refugees in Jordan, Lebanon, Syria, West Bank and the Gaza Strip to achieve their full potential in human development, pending a just solution to their plight. UNRWA’s services encompass education, health care, relief and social services, camp infrastructure and improvement, microfinance, and emergency assistance. UNRWA is the largest UN operation in the Middle East with more than 30,000 staff. UNRWA is funded almost entirely by voluntary contributions. If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity to make a tangible difference for one of the most vulnerable communities in the world, UNRWA would like to hear from you. - Supervisor: The incumbent of this post is responsible to the Chief, Field Health Programme, L11, and technically to Chief Disease Prevention and Control, L11at HQ, Amman. - Supervisees: Not applicable.
Responsibilities
• Conducts regular supervisory visits to UNRWA’s Health Centres to ensure that programmes are implemented according to approved policies, strategies, and guidelines in line with the family health team approach; • Manages the implementation and evaluation of the Agency’s disease control programme in the Field s/he is assigned to; ensures that the epidemiology and control of communicable and non-communicable diseases and immunization programme are in line with the family health team approach; • Supervise and manage UNRWA's Mental Health and psychosocial Support (MHPSS) programme at Field level and ensure integration of MHPSS into family health team approach in line with UNRWA’s Guidelines and WHO MH gap. • Ensures that reviews on the Agency’s Disease Surveillance Systems are carried out periodically for the accurate assessment of the programmes’ efficiency and effectiveness; • Investigates health problems, promotes healthy behaviors, and helps in fostering a safe and healthy environment; • Coordinates with concerned public health departments in the host countries the disease surveillance and control measures; • Guides and provides technical advice on disease prevention and control to the medical and nursing staff to enable them to keep abreast of the changes and most recent developments in the field; • Manages the development of research on disease prevention and control to keep up to date with new developments, techniques, procedures, and scientific breakthroughs; • Performs such other duties as may be assigned.
Competencies
UN Core Values of Integrity, Professionalism and Respect for Diversity, and Core Competencies of Communication, Working with People and Drive for Results apply by default. In addition, the following competencies apply. - Applying Technical Expertise - Leading and Supervising - Coping with Pressure and Setbacks - Delivering Results - Managing Complexity and Change For guidance on how to prepare for competency-based interviews: https://hr.un.org/page/prepare-competency-based-interview
Education
- A university degree from an accredited educational institution in Medicine from a recognized university including an internship of at least twelve-month duration. - An Advanced degree from accredited educational institution in Public Health
Job - Specific Qualification
A license to practice medicine in the country of duty station. License is required.
Work Experience

title: Director/Sr. Director of Product Management
description:
THE ROLE

Axiado is seeking an accomplished Director/Sr. Director of Product Management to lead product strategy, product management, product marketing, and marketing communications for our next-generation TCU and AI infrastructure solutions, including our switch products.

This is a highly visible, strategic leadership position responsible for managing the complete product lifecycle, from initial concept and market requirements through product development, launch, commercialization, and end-of-life (EOL).

The ideal candidate combines deep technical understanding of server and datacenter infrastructure with exceptional business acumen, customer engagement, strategic planning, and marketing communication skills.

You will translate market opportunities and customer requirements into actionable product roadmaps, work closely with engineering and executive leadership, and establish compelling product positioning that differentiates Axiado in the marketplace.

In addition to owning product strategy and execution, this individual will serve as a key external representative of Axiado, presenting at industry conferences, engaging directly with customers, developing technical and marketing content, and supporting sales initiatives.

This position requires a leader who can operate strategically while remaining hands-on with execution.

You are an experienced product leader who understands the intersection of semiconductor technology, server architecture, software, firmware, and datacenter infrastructure.

You have successfully managed complex technology products and understand how to take products from concept to market. You are equally comfortable discussing technical requirements with engineering teams, presenting product strategies to executive leadership, and communicating product value propositions to customers and industry audiences.

You bring a combination of strategic and tactical thinking, strong business judgment, and the ability to influence decisions across multiple organizations.

You are an exceptional communicator who can bring clarity to complex initiatives, align expectations, establish priorities, and drive accountability across cross-functional teams.

You understand that successful product leadership extends beyond defining features and roadmaps. It requires understanding the customer, anticipating market needs, positioning products competitively, enabling sales teams, and communicating the company's vision to the marketplace.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Management & Strategy

  • Own and manage the complete product lifecycle for Axiado's TCU products and associated infrastructure solutions, from concept through development, commercialization, and end-of-life.

  • Define and execute product strategies, long-term roadmaps, market requirements, and product priorities aligned with company objectives.

  • Translate customer requirements, industry trends, and competitive intelligence into actionable product specifications and development priorities.

  • Establish product requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the software and hardware development lifecycle.

  • Demonstrate strong strategic and tactical thinking, balancing long-term product vision with hands-on execution.

  • Build compelling business cases and recommendations to support product investments, prioritization, and strategic decisions.

  • Monitor product performance, customer adoption, market share, and competitive positioning.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES OF A SILICON PM

  • Market Requirements Document (MRD): Defining the chip architecture, target power/performance/area (PPA) metrics, and cost targets 2 to 4 years before the chip is launched.

  • Ecosystem & Software Enablement: Ensuring the silicon is usable by managing the software stack (drivers, SDKs, firmware, and APIs) that sits on top of the hardware.

  • Foundry & Supply Chain Alignment: Collaborating with operations and external foundries (like TSMC or Intel Foundry Services) on yield metrics, wafer pricing, and capacity planning.

  • SKU & Pricing Strategy: Deciding how to bin chips (sorting manufactured chips by performance tiers) to maximize revenue from a single architecture.

PRODUCT DEFINITION FRAMEWORK

  • Market Requirements Document (MRD): Focuses on the market opportunity. It outlines the target customer segments, user personas, competitive landscape, and the broad high-level problems the product must solve.

  • Product Requirements Document (PRD): Focuses on the execution roadmap. It translates the MRD into explicit engineering goals, detailing the exact features, technical specifications, performance metrics, and release criteria.

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Axiado's products, particularly its next-generation switch products and AI infrastructure solutions.

  • Establish compelling product positioning, messaging, differentiation, and competitive value propositions.

  • Develop customer-facing presentations, product briefs, technical collateral, and sales enablement materials.

  • Partner with sales leadership and business development to identify market opportunities, support customer engagements, and accelerate revenue growth.

  • Analyze market trends, competitive offerings, and customer needs to identify opportunities for product expansion and differentiation.

  • Represent Axiado's products and technology at industry conferences, customer meetings, and strategic business engagements.

  • Support the development of product launch strategies and commercialization plans.

Marketing Communications & Industry Visibility

  • Lead product-related marketing communications and ensure consistent messaging across customer-facing and industry-facing materials.

  • Develop and publish technical blogs, product announcements, thought leadership content, and other communications that strengthen Axiado's market presence.

  • Present Axiado's technology, product strategy, and value proposition to customers, partners, analysts, and industry audiences.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling messaging for technical and business stakeholders.

  • Work closely with internal marketing and executive leadership to maximize product visibility, market awareness, and brand positioning.

Customer Collaboration & Voice of the Customer

  • Serve as a key interface between customers, sales, engineering, and executive leadership.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in product planning and roadmap discussions.

  • Engage directly with customers to understand business requirements, deployment challenges, and emerging datacenter infrastructure needs.

  • Refine product specifications and priorities based on customer feedback, market requirements, and business objectives.

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with strategic customers and industry partners.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead collaboration across engineering, architecture, software, firmware, sales, business development, and marketing organizations.

  • Align internal stakeholders around product priorities, development milestones, deliverables, and customer expectations.

  • Provide clarity and direction throughout the product development process.

  • Influence strategic decisions and drive accountability across cross-functional teams.

  • Lead research and analysis to develop platform strategies and ensure successful execution of product roadmaps.

  • Establish effective communication processes that keep internal teams aligned on product direction, customer needs, and market opportunities.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience in product management, product leadership, product planning, or related technology leadership roles.

  • Demonstrated experience leading product strategy, product development, and product lifecycle management.

  • At least 5 years of experience in customer-facing roles, including direct customer engagement, executive presentations, and strategic business discussions.

  • In-depth knowledge of server products, server architecture, and datacenter infrastructure.

  • Understanding of semiconductor products, ASIC/SoC technologies, hardware platforms, and associated software and firmware ecosystems.

  • Demonstrated experience developing product roadmaps, market requirements, go-to-market strategies, and commercialization plans.

  • Experience leading product marketing initiatives, competitive positioning, and customer-facing communications.

  • Ability to build compelling business cases, develop executive-level presentations, and measure product success.

  • Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, prototyping, implementation, testing, validation, and customer delivery.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical information to both technical and business audiences.

  • Proven ability to establish productive relationships with customers, executive leadership, and internal cross-functional teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives in a fast-paced technology environment.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in semiconductor, AI infrastructure, datacenter, networking, or enterprise server industries.

  • Experience with server management, platform architecture, hardware security, and infrastructure management technologies.

  • Background in networking, switching products, high-speed connectivity, or related infrastructure technologies.

  • Experience launching complex hardware and software products into enterprise or datacenter markets.

  • Experience presenting at industry conferences, customer events, and executive-level business meetings.

  • Experience developing technical blogs, thought leadership content, product collateral, and marketing communications.

  • Experience supporting sales organizations through product demonstrations, customer presentations, and technical positioning.

  • Previous experience managing product management or product marketing teams.

PREFERRED ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.

Master's degree in Engineering or Business Administration (MBA) is highly preferred.

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent in a diverse and collaborative environment. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, we have access to world-class research, technology, and engineering talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. We prioritize solving real-world engineering challenges over theoretical work alone and value persistence, intelligence, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. We believe that hard work, continuous improvement, and mutual support enable our teams to achieve their best work.

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

LOCATION: San Jose, CA.

The pay scale above is Axiado's good-faith estimate of the base salary range that Axiado reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire. Actual base salary will depend on the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications. The pay scale does not include stock options or other benefits, which are in addition to base salary.

Axiado does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. Axiado and its subsidiaries will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, reproductive health decision-making, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

This posting is for additional headcount to support the needs of the business.

title: Customer Experience Manager I Real Estate I Asset Management
description:
Overview Of The Role:


  • The Customer Experience Manager at Dubai Festival City Mall is responsible for redefining and elevating the mall's end-to-end customer experience. This role manages key customer-facing functions such as Customer Service, Concierge, and Valet, ensuring that all interactions reflect the mall's high standards of hospitality and service excellence. The manager leads efforts to go beyond traditional customer service operations by embedding a proactive, hospitality-driven mindset across the customer journey. Success in this role is measured by improved customer satisfaction, seamless service across touchpoints, and elevated staff engagement.


What You Will Do:


Customer Experience Strategy & Ownership


  • Own and continuously enhance the end-to-end customer journey at Dubai Festival City Mall.
  • Develop and implement the Mall's customer experience strategy, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.
  • Champion a hospitality-first service culture focused on proactive, personalised engagement.
  • Regularly review and improve the entire customer journey from pre-arrival to departure.
  • Identify service gaps and opportunities to improve customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, Security, and other teams to ensure customer experience consistency.
  • Develop initiatives that differentiate DFCM through service and create memorable customer moments.


Customer Service Operations


  • Lead the Customer Service function across all information desks and public areas.
  • Establish and maintain clear service standards and operating procedures.
  • Ensure team members have comprehensive knowledge of Mall services, tenants, promotions, and events.
  • Oversee customer enquiries, complaints, and feedback, ensuring timely and thoughtful response.
  • Implement escalation procedures for complex or sensitive cases.
  • Regularly review customer feedback to identify trends and implement corrective actions.
  • Maintain premium presentation standards for Customer Service desks and programs.


Concierge Services


  • Lead the development of a premium concierge service offering for the Mall.
  • Ensure Concierge services deliver proactive, personalised assistance beyond traditional information.
  • Develop concierge service standards, SOPs, and SLAs.
  • Benchmark concierge standards against leading hospitality and retail environments.
  • Train Concierge teams to cater to diverse customer profiles, including VIPs and families.


Valet & Arrival Experience


  • Oversee Valet operations to ensure a premium first and last impression.
  • Monitor greeting standards, vehicle handover times, customer communication, and professionalism.
  • Manage valet capacity during peak periods, holidays, and events.
  • Ensure third-party operator alignment with DFCM's standards.
  • Drive improvements to arrival and departure experiences, including signage and queuing.


Team Leadership & Service Culture


  • Lead, motivate, and develop the Customer Service, Concierge, and Valet teams.
  • Build a strong hospitality culture promoting proactive customer engagement.
  • Establish roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations among teams.
  • Conduct training programs covering hospitality, communication, and service recovery.
  • Identify high-performers for development opportunities and strengthen succession planning.
  • Ensure consistent grooming, uniform standards, and professional behavior.


Customer Feedback, Complaints & Service Recovery


  • Own customer feedback and complaint management framework.
  • Ensure complaints are logged, investigated, and resolved promptly.
  • Personally oversee escalated cases and analyze complaint trends.
  • Work with departments to develop corrective action plans and empowerment recovery mechanisms.
  • Use survey and direct feedback for continuous service improvement.


Performance Management & KPIs


  • Develop and monitor Customer Experience performance frameworks including CSAT and NPS.
  • Track metrics like complaint resolution, service response times, and mystery shopping scores.
  • Use performance data to set improvement targets and hold teams accountable.
  • Conduct internal service audits and create action plans from findings.


Skills

Required Skills To Be Successful:


  • Strong leadership and people-management skills.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Proficient in handling customer complaints and service recovery.
  • Strong operational and organizational skills with attention to detail.


What Qualifies You For The Role:


  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Retail Management, or related field.
  • Extensive experience in hospitality, luxury retail, shopping malls, or destination management.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing customer-facing teams and multiple service functions.
  • Experience managing outsourced service providers and ensuring compliance with SLAs.
  • Skilled in customer journey mapping, service standards, and complaints management.
  • Proficiency in English required; Arabic or additional languages advantageous for diverse customer interactions.

title: Enterprise Architect (AMP)
description:
## **About the Opportunity**

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

**Job Description**

## **Title                 Enterprise Architect (AMP)**

## **Department** **Enterprise Architecture**

**Location          London / Dublin**

**Reports To       Head of AMP Architecture**

**Level                7**

**About Fidelity International**

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we.  We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**

The AMP Enterprise Architecture team is aligned to Enterprise Architecture within FIL Platforms. FIL Platforms brings together accountability for how Fidelity delivers key business capabilities end to end.It owns both day to day performance and ongoing improvement, so work is done once, scaled across the firm, and focused on client and investment outcomes.

Enterprise Architecture serves the needs of Fidelity and its clients, by aligning Business, Process, and Technology strategies to achieve business value. To meet the demands of our current and future business models, Architecture set standards, principles and guidance that prioritises resilient, adaptable, consistent, and cost-effective architecture through process and technology delivery.

**About your role**

**Purpose of the Role**

As an Enterprise Architect for AMP you will provide technical expertise to both the Business and Technology stakeholders in order to direct the investment and transformation from an architecture perspective to help deliver the strategic AMP initiatives in line with the Business, Technology and Data strategies. This includes working with senior business stakeholders to understand and develop their longer term vision, aligning roadmaps to this, developing technology roadmaps that align to both the business vision as well as technology objectives, providing guidance on M&A activity.

**Key Responsibilities**

Architect

·         Identify the current state of how technology is used in the organisation, what technologies are being used and how they are deployed along with the business value the technology is providing.

·         Work with stakeholders to understand business drivers and business capabilities (future and current state), and determine corresponding enterprise system designs and change requirements to drive the organisation's targeted customer outcomes.

·         Work as part of the team in proposing and gaining agreement for target application architecture for AMP that includes the articulation of a clear transformation roadmap.

·         Manage key business stakeholders to achieve consensus agreement to vision and roadmap.

·         Ensure that technology solutions to business problems are both pragmatic and supportive of the Global strategic architecture direction.

·         Develop architectures that are aligned to business goals, drivers, and strategies; drawing on knowledge of current and possible future business trends, policies and practices and business competition landscape.

·         Understand, advocate and augment the principles of information technology strategies.

Strategize

·         Maintain a forward-looking perspective on emerging technology developments and their relevance to Business and Technology Strategies.

·         Monitor technology developments to ensure that the organisation is effectively positioned to respond to and leverage opportunities that enhance competitive position through the effective application of technology to the business.

·         Develop a roadmap for the evolution of the enterprise application portfolio from future to current state

Lead & Communicate

·         Be an advisor to the business and technology leads on AMP architecture and strategy.

·         Proactively communicate decisions, roadmap, insight to the technology and business colleagues.

·         Proactively input into and provide architectural leadership in governance forums.

Innovate

·         Participate in the development of new concepts to support business strategy and provide recommendations to leverage technology for competitive advantage, internal efficiency and improved service.

·         Participate in managing vendor relationships on new and existing products, evaluating usefulness and cost of products and making appropriate recommendations.

Collaborate

·         Architecture’s success will depend on close collaboration with many other teams in Fidelity, including Engineering, Data, Delivery, Change, Security and Business teams

Deliver

·         Design and deliver the transformation of the AMP technology estate, together with the Technology and Business teams.

·         Translate high level business architecture into technology architectures that align to global strategies, simplify the existing architecture, deliver cost saving opportunities and, where appropriate, reusable services.

**About you**

**Experience and Qualifications Required**

·         Designed & delivered large transformation programme from legacy to new technology

·         Extensive experience in the asset management across Investment Management, operations and distribution business

·         Experience working with senior business stakeholers

·         Skilled in the architecture, design and implementation of complex technology solutions

·         Strong communication skills with different types and levels of stakeholders both internal and external.

·         Effective leadership skills including negotiation, conflict resolution, influencing, bridge-building and political astuteness

·         Hands-on experience managing end-to-end systems development from customer specifications through to deployment

·         Experience of managing technology driven business process change

·         The ability to convey complex, abstract technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences

·         A good understanding of financial markets, products and organisations

·         Excellent and resourceful problem-solving skills, adaptable with a willingness to learn

·         Proactive and self-organising with a “can-do” approach

**Feel rewarded**

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. title: Data Product Owner
description:
Do you know how to treat data as a true product - translating complex stakeholder needs into clear, scalable data capabilities that drive measurable business impact?

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9nxt4LcByn0).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

_For this position, we are happily looking for candidates currently based in Portugal, Kenya and South Africa._

The Job

Data at Tiko isn't a passive reporting function; it is a core operational asset that directly powers our mission to empower girls and young women across our operating markets. You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of our data deliverables - from scoping requirements and prioritizing backlogs to driving user adoption and ensuring our data tools solve high-value operational problems.

We are looking for a pragmatic, outcome-driven Data Product Owner to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract. In this role, you will take ownership of our data product roadmap, bridging the gap between non-technical business units and our Data Engineering, Analytics, and Architecture squads.

Key Responsibility:

- Roadmap Ownership: Define, maintain, and execute the 12-month data product roadmap, aligning feature delivery across data pipelines, semantic layers, and BI tools with Tiko’s strategic priorities.

- Backlog Delivery: Translate complex cross-functional requirements into clear user stories, technical acceptance criteria, and data contracts for data engineers and analysts, managing sprint refinement and delivery pacing.

- Value & Enablement: Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical data squads, driving tool adoption, enforcing metric consistency, and ensuring data products solve real-world user needs.

About You

You are an assertive, context-aware product thinker who views data through an outcome-driven lens. You don't just take orders from business teams; you ask the probing "why" questions to uncover the root operational problem before writing a single user story. You are comfortable balancing technical debt against fast-moving business requests, communicating trade-offs clearly, and saying "no" constructively when a request doesn't align with core data product goals.

Requirements:

- 4+ years of experience operating as a Product Owner or Product Manager, specifically focused on Data Products, Analytics, or Data Infrastructure.
- Practical understanding of modern data stack concepts, including SQL, data pipelines, dbt semantic layers, and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Lightdash).
- Proven experience leading backlog grooming, sprint planning, and user story definition for technical or data-centric squads.
- Exceptional ability to translate business requirements into technical specs and communicate technical constraints back to executive stakeholders.
- Fully available for a dedicated 12-month fixed-term engagement.
- Fluent written and verbal English skills.

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Product Team | Technical Challenge | Final interview with the Product Team

The Rewards

The gross monthly salary brackets for this position are:

Kenya: Ksh354,096 - Ksh480,00 (x12)

South Africa: R72,734 - R96,979 (x12)

Portugal: €3,025 - €4,030 (x14)

Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

- Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
- A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
- Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
- The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
- A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. Leveraging your dual fluency in English and French, you will onboard and offboard partners, maintain user documentation, monitor aggregator uptime, and translate support metrics into actionable system optimizations—ensuring our technology reliably serves the people using it on the ground.

Key Responsibilities

User Support & Bilingual Stakeholder Management

- Empathetic Operations Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for our field teams who manage our healthcare partners, handling inquiries and resolving user friction in both English and French.
- Onboarding & Access Governance: Coordinate secure user onboarding, offboarding, and access management through CRM systems like Salesforce, to keep platform records clean, compliant, and up to date.

A logical problem-solver by nature, you combine technical curiosity with a sharp eye for detail. You excel at managing multiple competing priorities across Helpdesk queues and data spreadsheets without dropping the ball. You thrive in cross-functional team settings, value continuous professional growth, and take pride in knowing that your technical rigor directly enables young women to receive vital health services without interruption.

Requirements

- Language Fluency: Native or fluent command of both English and French (written and verbal, mandatory).
- Technical & IT Support Background: Solid background in computer systems, IT support, or technical customer support, with hands-on experience troubleshooting mobile applications.
- Helpdesk & CRM Tools: Proven experience using Helpdesk Ticketing Systems (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk) and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
- Data & Productivity Mastery: Advanced proficiency with Google Suite and MS Excel (advanced spreadsheet formulas, data analysis, and metric tracking).
- Incident Management: Practical experience in structured incident management, stakeholder communication, and standard operating procedures for technical support.

Compensation & Benefits

title: 🚀 Growth Associate – CEO Office 🚀
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa zlecenie: 5000 – 7500 PLN / mies. brutto
B2B: 5000 – 7500 PLN / mies. netto

🚀 Growth Associate – CEO Office 🚀

About us

We are Valueships, a consulting firm helping technology companies grow revenue and profitability through pricing, packaging and monetization. We work with AI companies, SaaS and subscription businesses, and custom software development firms.

We are building a consultancy that combines talented people, broad business knowledge and deep pricing expertise with the full potential of AI. We invest in our people so they can tackle more ambitious problems and deliver useful results faster.

We are an alternative to slow, process-heavy consulting. We focus on decisions clients can act on, implementation and business results. We roll up our sleeves, work through messy realities and take responsibility for what we deliver.

AI is central to how we work. Practical fluency with it, curiosity and sound judgment are essential to joining us.

Why choose Valueships?

  • Work at the forefront of AI in consulting. We actively explore new capabilities and move quickly to integrate useful tools, agents and automation into our processes and daily work. We commit a substantial budget to AI tools and our team members’ development in this area.

  • Learn growth from the inside. Work side by side with our CEO and Head of Growth, and see firsthand how sales, marketing and partnerships drive a fast-growing consultancy.

  • Stay close to real business impact. Join sales meetings, conferences and client conversations, and see how your work turns into new clients and revenue.

  • Do ambitious work with support. Work in a collaborative team with access to Partners and Leadership, flexible hours and respect for your life outside work.

About the role

We’re looking for a Growth Associate to join our CEO Office and work directly with our CEO and Head of Growth. Our CEO leads sales, marketing and our conference presence, and spends a lot of time with clients and on the road.

You will be his right hand across everything Growth-related: sales meetings, marketing, events and conferences, and the organization that keeps it all running. You’ll prepare and join meetings, support sales and marketing activities, build relationships and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a dynamic, fast-paced role. Priorities change quickly, many topics run in parallel, and you will often be the first point of contact for clients and partners. In return, you will learn faster than almost anywhere else. You’ll see how a CEO sells, builds a brand and grows a company, and you’ll be part of it every day.

📝 What you will do

Sales & client meetings

  • Prepare sales and client meetings: research, agendas, presentations and sales materials.

  • Join meetings online and sometimes in person, and handle follow-ups and next steps.

  • Support outbound campaigns and follow-ups after meetings and conferences.

Marketing & relationships

  • Manage the CEO’s LinkedIn presence: keep his content calendar, help create and publish posts and videos, and engage with his network.

  • Write scripts for the CEO’s video recordings and help turn them into ready-to-publish LinkedIn content.

  • Support the Growth team with marketing activities, such as newsletters, campaigns, case studies and post-conference recaps.

  • Build and maintain relationships with clients, SaaS communities, partners, conference organizers and international stakeholders.

Conferences & events

  • Coordinate our conference presence: registrations, event sign-ups, tickets, and communication with organizers (bios, photos, required information).

  • Help organize events, including webinars, meetups and client meetings, both online and offline.

  • Plan and book business trips end to end: flights, trains, hotels (in optimal locations) and transfers.

Running the CEO Office

  • Manage the CEO’s calendar and schedule internal and external meetings with the right priorities in mind.

  • Keep travel documentation, expense reports and cost summaries for marketing and other trips, and deliver cost invoices to accounting.

  • Take ownership of whatever comes up. No two days will be the same.

🛎️ What we’re looking for

  • Fluent Polish and English (minimum B2, ideally C1). You will communicate with international clients and partners every day.

  • Excellent communication skills. You enjoy working with people and are confident in front of clients.

  • Strong multitasking and organization. You can juggle many topics at once without losing track of details.

  • High energy and readiness for an intensive, dynamic pace of work, including business travel.

  • A strong interest in sales, marketing and business growth, and a hunger to learn a lot, fast.

  • Practical AI fluency. You confidently use at least one mainstream AI assistant, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, and use it to work faster and better.

  • A proactive, can-do attitude and extreme ownership.

  • An early-career profile. Around 0–2 years of experience is welcome. Internships, student organizations and personal projects all count. You don’t need experience in every area listed above. You’ll learn most of it on the job.

  • Nice to have (none of these are required):

  • experience in B2B marketing, sales support, event organization or as an assistant (ideally in SaaS, tech or startups)

  • LinkedIn and social media experience

  • good copywriting skills in English

  • familiarity with simple design tools such as Canva

  • being based in Wrocław

🚀 What we offer

  • Flexible choice of employment form: mandate contract or B2B contract.

  • Salary: 5,000–7,500 PLN per month (net on a B2B contract or gross on a mandate contract), depending on experience.

  • A unique learning opportunity: working directly with the CEO on sales, marketing and company growth.

  • Business travel to international conferences and client meetings.

  • Hybrid work from our Wrocław office if you’re based in Wrocław, or remote work from elsewhere in Poland, with business travel as needed.

  • Investment in AI tools and your development, including financial support for relevant courses or postgraduate studies.

  • Average working time of 7 hours a day and a truly flexible schedule.

  • Access to Partners and Leadership for problem-solving and learning.

  • 2–3 days of on-site onboarding, with costs covered by Valueships.

  • Team off-sites twice a year.

  • The opportunity to grow into a Partner role and own part of Valueships.

Start date: as soon as possible.

Ready to join?

If you want to work at the heart of a growing consultancy, learn growth directly from its CEO and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would like to meet you.

You can apply even if you are still developing some of the skills above. Energy, communication skills, practical AI fluency and a willingness to learn are essential. We will help you with the rest.

Recruitment process

The process usually takes 2–3 weeks:

  1. Screening call. We discuss your experience, motivation and examples of how you use AI. You can ask questions about the role and Valueships.

  1. Practical recruitment task. A short, realistic task, for example preparing for a sales meeting at a conference and planning the trip. AI use is expected.

  1. Final conversation with our CEO. Meet the person you will work with every day, discuss your task, and explore whether working together is a good fit for both sides.

The conversations will be held in Polish, and the recruitment task will be in English.

title: Healthcare Assistant (HCA) UAE National (Emirati)
description:
Job Summary

The Healthcare Assistant will support the Nursing Department in providing safe and

effective patient care, assisting licensed healthcare professionals with delegated clinical

activities, patient monitoring, patient coordination and daily clinic operations, in

accordance with the DOH Scope of Practice.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist nurses and other licensed healthcare professionals with delegated patient

care activities.

• Support patients with activities of daily living, including mobility, positioning,

personal hygiene, feeding and general comfort.

• Measure and record basic vital signs, including blood pressure, temperature, pulse

and oxygen saturation, and report abnormal findings.

• Monitor and document patient intake and output and report any concerns to the

supervising nurse.

• Prepare patient rooms, equipment and supplies and maintain cleanliness and

infection control standards.

• Assist with patient transportation, appointments, follow-ups and coordination

between departments.

• Guide patients through their clinic visits and support a positive patient experience.

• Maintain accurate patient care documentation and ensure confidentiality.

• Report changes in patient condition, incidents and safety concerns to the

supervising healthcare professional.

• Perform additional duties as assigned by the Head of Department (HOD), within the

scope of the role.

• All other duties as assigned by HOD related to patient care and other duties.

Skills

Qualifications & Requirements

• Diploma in Healthcare Assistant from a recognized institution.

• UAE National (Emirati). Family Book: Required by law

• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

• Valid DOH license or completed Dataflow verification preferred.

• Candidates without a DOH license may be considered, subject to meeting DOH

licensing requirements and availability to join at the earliest.

• Valid BLS certification as required by DOH.

• Good communication, interpersonal and patient coordination skills.

Scope of Practice

All clinical activities must be performed within the approved DOH Healthcare Assistant

Scope of Practice, following appropriate training, competency assessment and supervision

by licensed healthcare professionals. The HCA must not independently diagnose,

prescribe medication or perform procedures outside their authorized scope.

title: Lead Employment Counsel
description:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our [mission](https://www.greenhouse.com/mission) is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a **Lead Employment Counsel** to join our team!

Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you'll be Greenhouse's dedicated employment lawyer and the go-to legal partner for our People team and business leaders. You'll advise across the full employee lifecycle in the US and our international footprint, including employer of record and contractor arrangements, own our employment policies and agreements, and manage outside counsel on litigation and specialized matters.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. In a single day you might walk an HR business partner through an accommodation request, mark up a sales commission plan, and prepare for a mediation. You'll also build the training, templates, and self-service guidance that let a busy People team handle routine questions with confidence and escalate the right ones. And because Greenhouse builds hiring software, you'll have a real voice in how AI is reshaping employment law, both for us and for our customers.

### **Who will love this job**

- **A trusted advisor**- you build credibility quickly with HR partners, managers, and executives, and you turn legal risk into plain, practical guidance they can act on
- **A builder who scales** - as the sole employment specialist, you prioritize well and multiply your impact through policies, playbooks, and training rather than answering every question one at a time
- **A detail-obsessed drafter**- you sweat the language in agreements, policies, and compensation plans because you know that's where the risk lives
- **A pragmatic, curious lawyer**- you track a fast-moving landscape (pay transparency, restrictive covenants, new leave mandates, AI in employment decisions) and make sound calls grounded in ethics, integrity, and the human impact of every decision

### **What you’ll do**

- Serve as the primary legal advisor to the People team (HR business partners, People Operations, Total Rewards, and Talent Acquisition) and business leaders on employee relations, performance management, terminations, reductions in force, leaves of absence, and accommodations
- Lead wage and hour compliance, including FLSA and state exemption classification, timekeeping and overtime practices, payroll issues, and periodic classification audits in partnership with Total Rewards
- Review and advise on compensation programs, including sales commission and bonus plans, overpayment recoupment, privileged pay equity analyses, and pay transparency requirements
- Draft, negotiate, and maintain employment documents and policies, including offer letters, confidentiality and invention assignment agreements, restrictive covenants, separation and contractor agreements, and handbook content with state and country supplements
- Conduct or oversee workplace investigations, and manage employment litigation matters with outside counsel, from demand letters and EEOC through class and representative actions, mediation, and settlement
- Advise on employment law outside the US, supporting employer of record and contractor arrangements, entity launches, temporary work-from-abroad requests, and relocations alongside local and immigration counsel
- Build and deliver training for managers, HR, and recruiters, create self-serve resources, and share clear, actionable updates on legal developments with Legal and People leadership
- Partner with Product, Privacy, and HR technology stakeholders on the use of AI in hiring and employment decisions, vendor assessments, employee and candidate data retention, and the employment law implications of product launches
- Support M&A diligence and integration, benefits and EEO/affirmative action compliance, manage outside counsel relationships and budgets, and represent Greenhouse externally as an employment law subject matter expert
- Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

### **You should have**

- JD from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one US state bar
- 7+ years of labor and employment law experience at a law firm and/or in-house
- Deep knowledge of US federal and multi-state employment law, especially wage and hour
- Experience advising on employment matters outside the US and working with employer of record providers and local counsel
- A track record of managing employment litigation with outside counsel, including settlement strategy
- Experience with workforce planning and management
- Experience owning employment policies, agreements, and compensation plan terms, and conducting or overseeing workplace investigations
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including giving practical advice to non-lawyers and executives and designing engaging training, plus the judgment and organization to work independently as the subject matter expert
- Experience using AI tools effectively while verifying output, protecting privileged and employee data, and keeping final legal judgment human
- In-house experience, strongly preferred
- Familiarity with the HR tech industry, a plus
- Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

_Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis._

_If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked_ [_here_](https://www.greenhouse.io/ccpa-candidate) _._

_The national pay range for this role is $163,800 - $230,680. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role._

_Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO)._

_The anticipated closing date for this role is December 18th, 2026._

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through [using our own product](https://www.greenhouse.com/interviewing-at-greenhouse) to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. title: Business Officer
description:
## Job Description

### Position Summary:

The Business Officer serves as the embedded senior financial leader for multiple divisions. The position leads unit-level financial management, including financial strategy, budget development, forecasting, endowment oversight, internal controls, and compliance. The Business Officer partners with unit leadership and the Senior Business Officer to align financial decisions with institutional priorities and to provide clear, actionable financial guidance. The role also supervises and develops embedded finance staff in a complex, matrixed environment.

**For full consideration, please apply by Monday, November 23, 2026, 11:59 PM (MT).**

### Essential Job Duties:

- Serve as the embedded senior financial leader for the college or division and the primary finance liaison between the unit and central administrative functions. Partner with unit and Finance leadership on financial strategy, governance, and operational priorities, translating complex financial information into clear recommendations for leadership and non-financial audiences.
- Develop and execute long-range financial strategy, including resource allocation, sustainability analysis, reserve management, endowment expenditure oversight, and scenario planning.
- Lead the annual budget development cycle and maintain multi-year forecasts, financial models, and targets using historical data, current trends, and stakeholder input.
- Ensure sound internal controls, policy compliance, audit readiness, and appropriate application of university, state, federal, GAAP, and GASB requirements.
- Oversee analysis of all fund types and complex funding sources; identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost efficiencies, and optimized fund utilization.
- Supervise, coach, evaluate, and develop embedded finance staff; establish performance expectations, lead onboarding, and foster a collaborative, accountable team culture.
- Maintain financial dashboards and reporting, lead process improvement and change-management efforts, and support data-driven decision making.
- Other Duties as Assigned.

### Conditions of Employment:

- Pre-employment Criminal Background Check (required for all new hires).

### Supervision:

- Directly supervises 4-6 FTE; Directly supervises embedded professional finance staff. Responsibilities include assigning work, setting performance expectations, conducting performance evaluations, coaching and mentoring, onboarding, professional development, and workload prioritization.

### Minimum Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree required in business, accounting, finance, public administration or related field including formal course work through intermediate accounting or four years of demonstrated equivalent experience.
- 8+ years of progressively responsible professional experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
- 3+ years of supervisory experience of professional finance staff including responsibility of completing performance evaluations.
- 3+ years of working with a complex account structure and establishing, reconciling and making recommendations to improve existing structures or establish new ones.
- Demonstrated experience managing complex projects and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously.
- Strong, comprehensive understanding of internal controls and the ability to analyze and implement effective systems of internal controls.
- Demonstrated understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
- Evidence of professional communication skills with the ability to speak to all levels of the organization, including the ability to present complex financial information to non-financial audiences.

### Preferred Qualifications:

- Master’s degree in finance, business, or a closely related field (such as MBA, MPA, or related) or CPA/CMA certification.
- Higher education or government finance experience.
- Experience with any of the following: endowment accounting, gift compliance, sponsored programs, capital project finance and Fund Accounting or Governmental Accounting Standards (GASB).
- Familiarity with CSU HR systems, budget system, , and central administrative processes
- Track record of process improvement and operational transformation.
- 8+ years of progressive experience in financial management with 5+ years of senior level managerial experience in a complex environment.
- Working knowledge of Federal Uniform Guidance and related compliance requirements.
- Analytical abilities, including the use of Microsoft excel, statistical techniques, financial modeling, data management, and data mining tools.
- Strong organizational and complex problem-solving skills, follow-through and attention to detail.
- Ability to work effectively in a multi-layered team environment, as well as autonomously.

## Salary Range

$125,000-$150,000

## Required Application Documents

To apply, please upload the following applicant documents. Ensure your materials fully address the required and preferred job qualifications of the position. title: Director, Experiential Learning and Global Partnerships
description:
**About Us**

At [**the George Washington University College of Professional Studies**](https://cps.gwu.edu/), you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of experts from across disciplines and backgrounds, who will challenge you to rethink assumptions, test your ideas, and look at ways to make the greatest impact. Here, you’ll learn how to use your skills to make an impact that ripples outward through industries and communities, elevating your career trajectory and connecting you to corners of the world you never thought possible.

**About the Role**

The Director, Experiential Learning and Global Partnerships leads the College's portfolio of experiential education initiatives, residency programs, and strategic partnerships that support student success and advance the College's academic mission.

Reporting to the Vice Dean for Academic Affairs, the Director provides leadership for the Experiential Learning and Global Partnerships team and collaborates with faculty, staff, university partners, alumni, employers, and external organizations to strengthen established programs, expand high-impact learning opportunities, develop strategic partnerships to support the College's academic and strategic goals. The Director is responsible for team leadership, partnership strategy, program development, operational oversight, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.

**People Management & Team Leadership**

- Lead, supervise, coach, and develop the Experiential Learning and Global Partnerships team.
- Establish team priorities, goals, workflows, and performance expectations.
- Lead hiring, onboarding, performance management, and professional development activities.
- Promote collaborative, service-oriented, and results-driven team culture.

**Strategic Leadership & Academic Affairs**

- Partner with the Vice Dean for Academic Affairs to develop and implement strategic priorities that advance the College's and the University’s experiential learning and partnership goals.
- Collaborate with faculty and academic leaders to identify, develop, and expand experiential and applied learning opportunities.
- Lead assessment, planning, and continuous improvement efforts to support program quality, effectiveness, and growth.
- Monitor emerging trends and opportunities that support innovation and advance College and University priorities.

**Partnerships & External Engagement**

- Lead established partnerships and develop new partnerships that support experiential learning, residency programs, global engagement, and other strategic College and University priorities.
- Provide strategic leadership for existing residency programs and partnership-based initiatives, including those involving partner institutions and organizations in Latin America, Spain, the US and other areas of strategic importance to the College.
- Develop and maintain relationships with academic institutions, corporations, nonprofit organizations, alumni, community partners, and other external stakeholders in the United States and internationally.
- Negotiate and oversee partnership agreements, contracts, memoranda of understanding, and other collaborative arrangements.
- Identify and pursue opportunities for new programs, partnerships, and initiatives that support student engagement, cross-cultural experiences, and portfolio growth.
- Collaborate with faculty, College leadership, and university stakeholders to develop and sustain experiential learning opportunities and residency programs.
- Partner with Marketing & Communications, as well as the Recruitment team, to promote experiential education initiatives, partnerships, and global engagement opportunities.

**Program & Portfolio Leadership**

- Provide strategic oversight for residency programs, partnership-based learning opportunities, and other experiential learning initiatives.
- Guide the development, implementation, and evaluation of new and existing programs and initiatives.
- Support faculty engagement and collaboration in the delivery of experiential learning opportunities.
- Monitor program outcomes and use data to inform decision-making, resource allocation, and future growth.

**Financial & Operational Management**

- Oversee budgets, contracts, resource allocation, and financial performance across the portfolio.
- Ensure compliance with university policies, risk management requirements, and applicable regulations.
- Oversee operational planning and reporting to support strategic goals and organizational effectiveness.
- Monitor and communicate program outcomes, partnership activity, and portfolio performance to College leadership.

Performs other related duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration and the flexibility of remote work. This is a hybrid position, based at GW’s Foggy Bottom campus in Washington, D.C. The schedule typically involves three days in person and two remote days per week – though the schedule may change based on business needs and priorities such as in-person events.
