title: Lead Data Analyst, Marketing (SEM)
description:
Who we are: 
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.
We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.
Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.


About the role
Join Marketing Analytics as a senior individual contributor focused on Search Engine Marketing (SEM) to lead paid search analytics for Rover globally. You'll shape how we measure and optimize acquisition across our growing portfolio of brands and markets.
As a key thought partner for SEM leaders, Finance, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering, you'll set the analytical agenda and stay hands-on with the analysis. A central question: when our brands compete for the same searches, how do we know if we have grown the business as a whole?
This role is based in our Barcelona office in Poblenou, with two office days per week (Mondays and Thursdays). You must be based in Barcelona or be willing to relocate.

Your impact
Guide bidding and investment across brands. Evaluate spend allocation, marginal returns, customer lifetime value (LTV), and payback. Help SEM teams assess cross-brand cannibalization and identify where additional spend generates incremental growth.
Lead experimentation and incrementality. Design and analyze channel tests, geo-split experiments, and multibrand tests. Choose appropriate methods, assess statistical power and uncertainty, and turn results into recommendations on bidding and spend.
Explain performance and identify opportunities. Diagnose changes in acquisition cost, conversion, and return on ad spend (ROAS). Translate auction dynamics, customer behavior, and marketplace conditions into clear recommendations that lead to action.
Strengthen attribution and reporting. Reconcile platform and internal measurement, distinguish attributed results from incremental growth, and build trusted dashboards. Partner with engineering and Data Science on data quality, conversion signals, and customer-value inputs.
Own the SEM analytics roadmap. Identify important questions, challenge assumptions, and prioritize by business impact. Build learning agendas for different markets and lead stakeholders toward decisions grounded in evidence and clear trade-offs.
Raise the team's analytical standards. Mentor analysts, review SQL and analytical methods, and develop reusable tools and documentation. Balance statistical rigor with business needs.

Your qualifications
6+ years of analytics experience, with a track record of turning complex analysis into business decisions and measurable outcomes.
Advanced SQL and strong statistical analysis skills in Python or R, including reviewing others' code and collaborating with engineering on data models.
Proven experimental design and A/B testing experience, including applying causal inference or geo-based methods and explaining their limitations.
Experience independently leading large analytical initiatives, managing stakeholder expectations and timelines, and influencing strategy across functions.
Clear communicator with technical and non-technical audiences, who is able to shape compelling data narratives through analysis and data visualization.

Nice to have
Strong understanding of marketing attribution and acquisition economics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), LTV, ROAS, and payback.
Experience with multibrand businesses, international markets, or a two-sided marketplace.
Experience with marketing mix modeling (MMM), customer LTV modeling, or transformation tools such as dbt.
Experience using AI tooling to move faster on routine work and to check your own reasoning. You can also explain and defend every line of analysis you ship.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you, even if you don't bring every nice-to-have.

Benefits of working at Rover
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout


Pension plan


Private medical insurance


25 days PTO


Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)


Gym membership


€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet


Annual €150 wellness reimbursement


Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time


Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going 


Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more


Dog-friendly office

Compensation:
In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €61,858 - €75,163. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.


The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Head of Infrastructure
description:
#### **About Signaturit Group, a Namirial Company**

Signaturit Group, part of the Namirial group, is the European leader in secure digital transactions. Its cloud-native, unified and modular platform enables public and private organisations to manage the entire lifecycle of their digital operations: from identity verification and onboarding to electronic signatures, authentication, communications, fraud prevention, qualified archiving and electronic invoicing.

As a Qualified Trust Service Provider (QTSP) under the eIDAS Regulation, the group guarantees the highest level of legal certainty and regulatory compliance, anticipating initiatives such as eIDAS 2 and the European Digital Identity Framework (EUDI Wallet).

Following the integration of Signaturit into the Namirial Group in 2025, the company consolidates a multinational position with more than 250,000 customers, a presence in more than 90 countries, and a team of more than 1,400 employees. Headquartered in Italy and with a strong presence in Spain, France, Germany and LATAM and South-East Asia —the group combines global reach with local proximity to offer direct service to businesses and public administrations

**What you will do at Signaturit, A Namirial company 🚀**

As Head of IT for France, you will be responsible for managing and evolving the on-premise IT infrastructure of the French site, in coordination with the technology standards defined at group level (tooling, security, monitoring, backup).

The scale of the team means this role calls for a hands-on approach: not just planning and coordination, but direct implementation and troubleshooting on virtualization infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

- Manage and maintain the on-premise infrastructure built on VMware, Proxmox, and Nutanix, ensuring operational continuity, performance, and security

- Plan and execute capacity planning, patching, upgrades, and migrations across virtualization platforms

- Lead the local IT team, distributing operational workload and providing direct technical support when needed Ensure the French infrastructure stays aligned with group standards (3-2-1 backup, monitoring, security, IaC)

- Manage storage, networking, and backup/disaster recovery systems for the site

- Collaborate with the Head of Infrastructure, Architecture & Platforms and with the other infrastructure teams (Italy, Spain) on cross-country initiatives

- Contribute to defining operational processes and documentation (runbooks, incident/crisis management playbooks)

- Ensure compliance with the regulatory requirements applicable to a QTSP (e.g. eIDAS, NIS2, GDPR) as they relate to IT infrastructure.


**What we believe should contribute to your success in this context 🎯**

- Solid experience (5+ years) managing on-premise virtualization infrastructure.

- Hands-on, proven expertise in at least two of VMware, Proxmox, and Nutanix (knowledge of all three is a strong plus)

- Solid knowledge of enterprise storage, networking (switching, firewalling), and backup systems (e.g. Veeam)

- Familiarity with automation and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible)

- Experience with Linux and Windows Server operating systems in production environments

- Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Dynatrace, Better Stack) and perimeter security (e.g. Fortinet).

- What we're looking for a profile that is technical first, managerial second: someone who still wants to get their hands dirty

- Decision-making autonomy and the ability to manage priorities independently

- A problem-solving mindset in complex, critical infrastructure environments (trust services sector)

- Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, across countries.

- Fluent in French & English


**Interview process (indicative, may require additional stages if required)**

- HR Discovery Call (30 min)

- 1st interview with our business (direct report)

- Business case

- 2nd interview with our business & business case feedback

- Online personnality assessment

- Reference check


**Why Join Us 🤝**

- 👩🏽‍💻 Flexible hybrid work set up

- ⏰ Flexible working hours and A framework status with RTT

- 🏥 Health Insurance 100% covered

- 🍽️ Meal Vouchers (Ticket restaurants)

- 💂🏼‍♀️ Tailor-made onboarding and skills development program

- 📚 Access to specialized technical training platforms

- 🎂 Regular events to maintain a good atmosphere

- ✍🏻 Permanent role

- 💰Base salary: 80/85K€, depending on assessed level of autonomy .Variable component: up to 8K€ upon 100% achievement of objectives defined with your manager.


**Join Our Vision** 🚀

Be part of Signaturit Group's journey to revolutionize digital transactions across Europe and beyond. We are excited to welcome fresh talent who are eager to make a meaningful impact in the digital world.

For more information, explore our [website](https://www.signaturit.com/) and discover how you can contribute to our mission.

title: Business Manager (Customer Experience)
description:

**About Aberdeen**

Aberdeen Group plc is one of Europe’s largest investment companies, and we are built on a long-standing culture of caring about the future and making a positive impact. Together we invest for a better future. We do it to make a difference to the lives of our clients and customers, our employees, society, and our shareholders. Our business is structured around three distinct areas focused on our clients' changing needs: Aberdeen Investments, Aberdeen Adviser, and interactive investor.

As Business Manager to the Chief Client Experience Officer, you will help shape and deliver the client experience agenda while investing in your tomorrow through exposure to strategic leadership and transformation activity across the business.

The Client Experience function is focused on continually improving how clients interact with Aberdeen and ensuring positive outcomes across every stage of the client journey. Working closely with business leaders across Aberdeen Adviser and the wider Group, the team drives strategic priorities, service improvement, governance and performance insight. title: Ecosystem Trainer
description:
Would you enjoy working with different actors in the Tiko ecosystem to ensure that they are knowledgeable about our platform and its offers? Continue reading to find out more about our Ecosystem Trainer role in Hawassa, Ethiopia!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJYCIChXdKE).

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

title: Inshore Marine Protected Area Policy Officer
description:
**This is an Expression of Interest (EOI) opportunity, available on a lateral move basis only. Applications are open to Core Scottish Government employees only.**

**Job Title** –  Inshore Marine Protected Area Policy Officer

**Working Arrangement** – Staff in roles compatible with hybrid working should spend 40% of their contracted working time working in person at their contractual workplace. More information can be found within [Hybrid Working Policy](https://scotsconnect.sharepoint.com/sites/saltireredirect?siteId=mylifeandcareer&pageId=8c5a454f-11b6-4349-a97e-96ba6acf3f51&pageParams=working-in-person-hybrid-working) .The role will involve significant travel across Scotland to support consultation events and stakeholder engagement.

**Grade** – B2

**Advert type** – **level transfer**

**Duration** – Temporary till 31st March 2027

**Eligibility** - Expressions of interest are invited from substantive colleagues on level transfer from Core SG only.

**Skilled Worker Sponsorship not being offered**

Skilled Worker sponsorship is not available for this role. As a result, we are unable to appoint candidates who require Skilled Worker sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must have an existing and ongoing right to work in the UK.

**Overview**

The Marine Directorate sits within DG Net Zero and is part of the core Scottish Government. Its purpose is to manage Scotland's seas in line with the vision to deliver prosperity and environmental sustainability, working closely with a range of delivery partners. With 61% of the UK sea area, a fishing and aquaculture industry worth over £1 billion, 50,000 jobs in the marine economy and at least 6,500 marine species, this is a high-profile and fast-paced policy area.

The Marine Environment, Planning and Corporate Portfolio is responsible for ensuring the environmental protection of Scotland's marine area. This post sits within the Planned and Protected Seas Programme, which leads on the spatial protection of marine habitats and species and the ecosystems that support them, so that society continues to enjoy the natural goods and resources provided by our seas.

You will play a key role in supporting the development and implementation of fisheries management measures for Scotland's inshore Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) and Priority Marine Features (PMFs).

This varied and rewarding role offers the opportunity to work at the centre of marine policy delivery, supporting the publication of public consultations and accompanying evidence, coordinating the completion and clearance of statutory assessments, and helping to develop fisheries management measures from consultation towards implementation. You will also contribute to the development and clearance of statutory fisheries orders, support the management of consultation analysis, and assist with stakeholder engagement, communications and parliamentary business.

This varied and rewarding role offers you the autonomy to manage your own workload and work across teams to deliver transparent, inclusive, and well-governed marine policy.This will ensure policy proposals are evidence-based, legally compliant, and clearly communicated and show the Scottish Government’s approach to marine protection is transparent, consultative, and grounded in sound governance.

**Key responsibilities**

- Support the management of consultation analysis, working closely with external contractors to ensure consultation responses are transferred, analysed and reported effectively, and that findings are reflected in policy development.
- Support the publication of consultation outcomes and supporting evidence relating to fisheries management measures for Scotland's inshore MPAs and proposed PMF management areas.
- Support the development of final fisheries management measures and site proposals by analysing consultation responses, assisting in the appraisal of options, maintaining decision records, and contributing to advice and submissions for Ministers.
- Support stakeholder engagement and consultation activity, including attending meetings and events, providing secretariat support, maintaining effective relationships with delivery partners and ensuring stakeholders receive clear and timely information.
- Contribute to communications, ministerial briefings, Parliamentary Questions, Ministerial correspondence, Freedom of requests and other casework, ensuring responses are accurate, evidence-based and delivered within agreed deadlines.
- Monitor progress across a range of policy and delivery workstreams, tracking actions, coordinating contributions from partners and supporting the successful implementation of Scotland's inshore MPA fisheries management programme.

**Success Profile**

Success profiles are specific to each job and they include the mix of behaviours, experience and technical criteria (if applicable) that candidates will be assessed on.

**Experience:**

- Experience of analysing and synthesising information from multiple sources to support decision-making.
- Experience coordinating and monitoring delivery across multiple workstreams and partners.

**Behaviours:**

1. Making effective decisions (Level 3)

2. Communicating and influencing (Level 3)

3. Working together (Level 3)

4. Delivering at pace (Level 3)


You can find out more about Success Profiles Behaviours, here: [Success profiles: candidate guide - gov.scot](https://www.gov.scot/publications/success-profiles-candidate-guide/pages/behaviour-levels/)

**Working Pattern**

This post is a full-time role, but we welcome applications from staff with different working patterns. Proposed working patterns will be assessed against the business requirements for this post. The role will involve significant travel across Scotland to support consultation events and stakeholder engagement.

We have an opportunity for a B2 to join the team on a temporary basis till 31st March 2027.

**Further Information**

Further information about this opportunity is available from [mathew.leslie@gov.scot](mailto:mathew.leslie@gov.scot)

**How to Apply**

Please submit a CV and an Expression of Interest (maximum 500 words) outlining your suitability for the role, relevant skills and experience, and what you would bring to the team. Please align this to how you meet the behaviours, experience and technical skills listed in the Success Profile above.

Vacancies close at 11:59pm on the date displayed in the table, unless otherwise stated on the job advert.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Please see our [candidate guidance](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/use-of-ai-tools/) for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

If invited for further assessment, this will consist of a light touch interview.

Discussions are scheduled for w/c 30th November, however this may be subject to change.

**Recruitment Principles**

As a government organisation, we adhere to the [Civil Service Commission Recruitment Principles](https://civilservicecommission.independent.gov.uk/document/02a-recruitment-principles-april-2018-final/?d102_cookies_enabled=all) and we investigate any complaints received in relation to recruitment cases.

**About us**

The Scottish Government is the devolved government for Scotland. We have responsibility for a wide range of key policy areas including: education, health, the economy, justice, housing and transport. We offer rewarding careers and employ people across Scotland in a wide range of professions and roles.

Our staff are part of the [UK Civil Service](https://www.civil-service-careers.gov.uk/about-us/) observing the Civil Service Code and working for Ministers and senior stakeholders to deliver vital public services which improve the lives of the people of Scotland.

We offer a supportive and inclusive working environment along with a wide range of employee benefits. Find out more about [what we offer](https://www.jobs.gov.scot/what-we-offer).

As part of the UK Civil Service, we uphold the [Civil Service Nationality Rules](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/nationality-requirements/).

**Security checks**

Successful candidates must complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), before they can be appointed. BPSS is comprised of four main pre-employment checks – Identity, Right to work, Employment History and a Criminal Record check (unspent convictions).

You can find out more about BPSS on the [UK Government website](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard), or read about the different levels of security checks in our [Candidate Guide](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/pre-employment-checks/).

**Equality statement**

We are committed to equality and inclusion and we aim to recruit a diverse workforce that reflects the population of our nation.

Find out more about our commitment to [diversity](https://www.jobs.gov.scot/an-inclusive-organisation) and how we offer and support [recruitment adjustments](https://www.jobs.gov.scot/requesting-adjustments-2) for anyone who needs them.

**Further information**

Find out more about our organisation, what we offer staff members and how to apply on our [Careers Website](https://www.jobs.gov.scot/).

Read our [Candidate Guide](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/introduction/) for further information on our recruitment and application processes.

title: Senior AWS GCP Cloud Engineer
description:
***We are unable to sponsor for this permanent full-time role***

***Position is bonus eligible***

Prestigious Financial Institution is currently seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer with strong AWS, Kubernetes, and Python experience. Candidate will be focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Candidate will lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them, as well as build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms (AWS and GCP preferred) in a professional setting.
  • Deep, hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and GitOps (Argo CD).
  • Deep, hands-on experience using Terraform, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and scripting languages (Python) to deploy, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong experience supporting containerized applications and Linux-based systems.
  • Strong understanding of networking, IAM, cloud observability, and common cloud services such as AWS VPC, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, and Lambda.
  • Familiarity with managing secrets and sensitive configuration using tools such as HashiCorp Vault.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating fault-tolerant systems with on-call responsibilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including working effectively with engineers, security, and operations teams.
  • Interest in continuous learning and in developing the engineers around you.

description:

description:

title: Research Fellow in Health and Care Evaluation
description:
We wish to appoint an exceptional Research Fellow in Health and Care Evaluation to join the Prevention and Early Intervention research theme of the NIHR Applied Research Collaboration for Greater Manchester (NIHR ARC-GM) based at the University of Manchester. NIHR ARC-GM aims to undertake timely, needs-driven, transformative applied health and social care research to benefit communities locally and nationally.

The postholder will conduct robust and timely service evaluation in response to the needs of the funder and other stakeholders. You will develop, undertake and report high quality research and evaluation using your expertise and experience in qualitative and/or mixed methods methodologies and approaches. At ARC-GM, co-production is at the heart of our approach, and you will work with our partners to translate their strategic priorities into answerable research questions, ensuring that our research is relevant, useful and applicable to service needs and achieves impact on policy and practice. This post offers the opportunity to work as part of a multi-disciplinary, supportive team to build relationships with decision makers. The post holder will provide timely insights, helping guide implementation, scaling, or de-implementation. We also hope that the postholder can contribute to methodological development, including approaches for short-timescale evaluations.

The successful candidate will work with Professor Pete Bower, Dr Christine Camacho and other members of the NIHR ARC team and will be based in the Division of Population Health, Health Services Research & Primary Care in the Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health.

This is a full-time post based in Manchester and hybrid working arrangements are possible (with agreement from your line manager).

title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Finance
description:
Overview of the role

Lead the Financial Planning & Analysis agenda across Automotive operations in the UAE and overseas markets. You will translate business strategy into integrated financial plans, provide clear insights into performance, and support leadership decisions on growth, profitability and resource allocation.

Acting as the key link between business units, Automotive leadership and Group Finance, you will drive consistent planning, forecasting and executive reporting while strengthening analytics, automation and technology-enabled decision-making.

What you will do

• Lead planning and forecasting: Own the annual budget, periodic forecasts and long-range plans, integrating P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital and capital expenditure.

• Challenge business assumptions: Partner with business units to assess volume, pricing, margins, productivity, costs and investments, developing scenarios and identifying risks, opportunities and mitigation actions.

• Deliver executive reporting: Lead performance packs and business reviews for the Automotive CFO, President and senior leadership, turning financial and operational results into clear insights, recommendations and actions.

• Support commercial decisions: Provide analysis for pricing, campaigns, incentives, channel strategy, cost optimisation and capital expenditure prioritisation.

• Strengthen performance management: Standardise KPIs, reporting methodologies and benchmarking across business units, linking financial outcomes to operational drivers and tracking performance-recovery actions.

• Drive systems and process improvement: Lead the FP&A technology roadmap, improve planning models and dashboards, automate reporting, and support adoption of BI and AI-enabled decision-support tools.

• Maintain financial integrity: Ensure accurate, reconciled reporting, transparent assumptions, strong data quality and appropriate model governance.

• Partner with Corporate Finance: Align planning assumptions on liquidity, funding and working capital, and contribute operating forecasts and performance evidence to business cases and post-investment reviews.

• Lead and coach the FP&A function, build commercial and digital capabilities, strengthen succession, and support talent development and Emiratization objectives.

Skills

Required skills to be successful

• Advanced financial modelling, scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.

• Strong capability in integrated financial planning, driver-based forecasting and performance analytics.

• Commercial judgement and the ability to translate complex data into practical business recommendations.

• Clear executive communication, presentation and financial storytelling skills.

• Confidence to constructively challenge assumptions and influence senior stakeholders across multiple businesses and markets.

• Strong understanding of KPI frameworks, benchmarking, data governance and financial controls.

• Proficiency in enterprise planning, ERP and BI platforms, supported by advanced Excel skills.

• Ability to lead change, improve processes and develop a collaborative, accountable team.


About the team

Reporting to the General Manager – Divisional Finance, you will lead a team of four within Automotive Finance, supporting operations across the UAE and overseas markets.

You will work closely with Automotive leadership, Managing Directors, business unit Finance Heads, FP&A and operational teams, as well as Group Finance, Corporate Finance and finance transformation stakeholders. The team brings together planning, analytics and business insight to provide a consistent view of performance across a complex, multi-business portfolio.

What equips you for the role

• Chartered Accountant, CPA, CFA, ACCA, MBA in Finance or an equivalent professional qualification.

• 10–15 years of relevant finance experience, including leadership of FP&A or commercial finance in a large, complex, multi-business organisation.

• Demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, executive reporting, scenario modelling and cross-functional business partnering.

• Strong knowledge of management reporting, financial modelling, performance analytics and enterprise planning systems.

• Working knowledge of IFRS and its implications for planning and management performance.

• Hands-on ownership of an enterprise planning or consolidation platform, with SAP BPC preferred; Anaplan or Oracle EPM also acceptable, using SAP as the source system.

• Exposure to driver-based or AI-assisted forecasting and tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

• Experience in automotive, distribution, retail or another asset- and working-capital-intensive sector would be advantageous.

title: Guest Experience Expert
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. If you are someone who gets excited about the possibilities to connect with others, then Aloft Hotels is the place for you. In joining Aloft Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
description:
- **Closing:**

   12:00pm, 20th Nov 2026 GMT



**Machine Learning Platform Engineer**

Remote (UK-based) | Full-time | Salary: £65,358 + benefits including 4.5-day week and 11% employer pension

**Do your best work, for the right reasons.**

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to help us build beautifully simple, high-impact digital products that support teachers and improve outcomes for pupils across the UK.

Oak is a fully remote, mission-driven organisation offering high levels of flexibility, autonomy, and purpose. We’re a national not-for-profit working in partnership with teachers to create the highest-quality, sequenced curriculum and lesson resources for pupils across all subjects and age groups.

Our culture has been independently recognised through:

- **Flexa verified** (93% overall score, including 95% for working hours and 97% for role modelling)

- **Escape the City's Top 1% Employers** – based on anonymous colleague reviews of culture, development, and impact

- **Investors in People Gold -** through external accreditation and colleague feedback


**💡 About the Role**

You’ll join our Engineering Platform team, which builds the foundations our engineers and product squads rely on to ship reliable, secure software. As our Machine Learning Platform Engineer, you’ll focus on the infrastructure that gets AI models deployed and running reliably in production, from model management and version control to orchestration and scaling.

This is a new role. We’re splitting the machine learning engineer role across two teams. You’ll lead the build, deploy and operate side, working closely with our Intelligence Platform team’s Machine Learning Engineer, who develops and evaluates the models themselves. They build the models; you make sure they can be deployed, scaled and trusted in production by the engineers and squads who use them.

You’ll also help shape how we work. That means moving deployment off local machines into repeatable, automated delivery, strengthening how we monitor our services, and setting standards for our emerging agent-engineering practices.

As part of the Oak team, you'll contribute to the wider success and culture of the organisation, and support and role model our five values: create the right environment, be a great colleague, own your role but work for the team, make things happen, and keep getting better

**💡What you'll be doing:**

- Build, maintain and secure the infrastructure that lets Oak build, deploy and operate reliable software and AI systems to be highly available and accessible to the widest number of users that meet Government Digital Service standards.

- Move deployment off local machines and into repeatable, automated delivery using CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

- Manage, version and orchestrate models so that those developed by our Intelligence Platform team can be deployed, scaled and run reliably in production.

- Lead the continuous improvement of the observability, performance and reliability of Oak’s platform and cloud services and support teams across engineering to use SLOs and SLAs effectively.

- Maintain monitoring, logging and alerting so teams can understand service quality and resolve problems quickly.

- Take an active role in the design and implementation of automation that speeds up development, secures systems or improves service quality.

- Contribute to, and develop, Oak’s engineering standards, including our emerging agent-engineering practices.

- Work in cross-functional and product-oriented squads with colleagues from across the organisation, as required.

- Deputise for other members of the Platform team and take on other general responsibilities as required.


**🌱 What we're looking for**

You’ll have solid experience running cloud infrastructure in production, and a real interest in what it takes to run machine learning and AI systems well. This is a fast-moving field, so we don’t expect years of experience in it. If you’ve spent a few months deploying or operating models, or you’ve run comparable production systems and want to apply those skills to AI, we’d love to hear from you. Experience with event-driven architectures using serverless technologies such as Google Cloud Run, AWS Lambda or Azure Functions will help, but you can grow into some of this with us. What matters most is that you care about making models reliable, secure and easy for others to ship.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

- Experience leading the continuous improvement of observability, monitoring and reporting solutions for complex cloud infrastructures.

- Demonstrable experience deploying, orchestrating and operating machine learning or AI systems in production, or clear, transferable experience operating comparable production systems.

- Proven experience of infrastructure-as-code practices, promoting reproducibility and consistency across cloud environments

- Experience of security controls for cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, including secrets management, access control and least-privilege principles.


- Desire to build beautiful, easy-to-use digital products with an understanding of the importance of accessibility in all its forms.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across teams


The successful candidate will have a desire to contribute across all areas to ensure Oak's success. You will be comfortable moving quickly and with agility, and be confident working with a range of digital systems (including proprietary ones, as required). You will continually look for ways that the team can keep getting better. You will be excellent at working as part of a remote team, building relationships and managing your time effectively

**📖 See how we work**

Want to know more about how we build our products? Our Engineering Substack shares how we build AI and data tools for education, including the decisions, trade-offs and lessons we've learned along the way. Read Oak's Engineering Substack - [https://engineering.thenational.academy/](https://engineering.thenational.academy/)

**💛 Our Benefits**

- 25 days annual leave, plus one extra day for each year of service (up to 28)

- Additional Oak closure days over Christmas/New Year

- 11% employer pension contribution (with no minimum employee contribution)

- A 36-hour working week, with half-days on Fridays or every other Friday off

- Fully remote working - we’ll support your home set-up and offer coworking options if preferred

- Twice-yearly in-person offsites to collaborate, connect, and have fun

- A culture that genuinely supports flexibility, autonomy, and trust


**🌈 Inclusion and Belonging**

We believe diverse teams build better products. We warmly welcome applicants from all backgrounds, particularly those who are underrepresented in the tech and education sectors.

If you're from an underrepresented group, there's a good chance you're discounting yourself before you've even started. That's more common than you'd think, and it means we may miss out on brilliant people. If you're excited by this role but don't meet every requirement, please apply anyway.

We use the Applied platform to help reduce bias in our hiring process. Answers are anonymised and reviewed by a panel of humans.

**📌 Key Info**

Location: Remote, but you must be based in the UK with the legal right to work here

- Sponsorship: Unfortunately, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time

- Closing date: Friday 20 November 2026 (We’ll be reviewing applications as they come in and may close the role early)


If this sounds like the kind of role and team where you could do your life’s best work, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll answer a few admin questions and some questions related to your day-to-day job. Your answers will go through our sift process: all answers will be anonymised, randomised, and then reviewed by a panel of reviewers (real humans), so it's your thinking that gets assessed, not your CV.

If you're shortlisted, we'll invite you to interview. We give everyone feedback at the end of the process.

**Interview dates:**

First stage interviews: Thursday 26 and Monday 30 November 2026

Technical Assessment interviews: Week commencing 7 December 2026

We are receiving excellent responses to our job advertisements. This may lead us to close the role early, so if you are considering applying, don't leave it too long to avoid missing out.

### **We are an equal opportunity employer.**

We are committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

description:

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. title: Senior Research Fellow in Sustainable Urban Mobility – CO/ALIGN
description:
_Advertising Salary_Salary Details:

£28,615 - £32,722 per annum (Incl. LWA)

**This post is part-time, 17.5 hours per week and fixed term until 31 December 2028. The salary stated above is the pro-rata amount, the full time salary would be £57,231 - £65,444 per annum (Incl. LWA).**

The University of Westminster is seeking a Senior Research Fellow to contribute to CO/ALIGN, an international project funded through ESRC/UKRI under the Driving Urban Transitions programme. The project examines how civil society organisations, coalitions and governance can support sustainable and inclusive urban mobility transitions.

Working with Professor Enrica Papa in the School of Architecture and Cities, you will deliver research within Westminster’s assigned responsibilities. These include maintaining and extending the civil society organisation database and GIS webmap, contributing to the CSO Atlas with international partners, conducting interviews, and supporting the London Living Lab with Possible. You will also contribute to evaluation, academic publications, policy outputs and knowledge exchange.

You will hold a relevant PhD, or have equivalent research experience, and bring expertise in sustainable mobility, urban governance, community-led initiatives or related fields. Strong qualitative or mixed-methods research skills, experience of stakeholder engagement and evidence of high-quality research outputs are essential. title: Het Holland Festival zoekt een senior medewerker development: particulieren (0,8-1 fte)
description:
Houd je van theater, dans, muziek en muziektheater en weet je anderen enthousiast te maken daarvoor? Heb je oprechte belangstelling voor mensen en minimaal 7 jaar ervaring met het vak development en het realiseren van ambitieuze targets? Dan is het Holland Festival op zoek naar jou!

Holland Festival

Holland Festival toont de transformerende kracht van de podiumkunsten die een groot en divers publiek raken, verbinden en aan het denken zetten over de wereld waarin we leven. Elk jaar in juni presenteren we een samenhangend, internationaal programma door excellente makers van over de hele wereld met multidisciplinair, artistiek risicovol en grootschalig werk dat anders niet in Nederland te zien is. Al bijna 80 jaar lang.

Als belangrijke coproducent en presenterend festival stimuleert Holland Festival ambitieus en innovatief werk dat de artistieke grenzen verlegt. Het festival is artist driven en moedigt unieke samenwerkingen aan tussen internationale en Nederlandse makers.

Holland Festival staat voor diversiteit, toegankelijkheid en maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Met een zorgvuldig samengesteld internationaal programma bereikt het festival een breed publiek en biedt het een festivalervaring die uitnodigt tot reﬂectie en dialoog.


Over de rol

This is where you talk about the role. Tell a story about what your new team member will do in this role. Talk about who they'll work with and what sort of workflow they'll be using. Focus on the outcomes and impact of the work they'll do, and not too much on specific tasks. Let the candidates know in what way they'll have an impact on your company and customers. Get them excited for the role!


De functie
Als senior medewerker development: particulieren ben je onderdeel van het Developmentteam. Je belangrijkste taak is het verbinden van onze particuliere donateurs en het behalen van de targets die daarbij horen. Je bent gedreven om deze relaties te betrekken, benut de kansen die je ziet om het aantal donaties te vergroten en gaat op een empathische manier recht op je doel af voor resultaten die belangrijk zijn: het festival kan niet zonder deze steun.


Plaats binnen de organisatie
Je werkt binnen de afdeling Development en rapporteert aan het hoofd Development. Je werkt ook samen met de directeur en de andere afdelingen om in verbinding met hen je ambitieuze doelen te realiseren.

Wat ga je doen? Werkzaamheden zijn onder andere, maar niet uitsluitend:

· Ontwikkelen en laten groeien van inkomsten uit particuliere schenkingen. Dit doe je door het vergroten en onderhouden van waardevolle relaties met (potentiële) particuliere donateurs voor de Vriendenkringen van Liefhebbers, (Jonge) Begunstigers, Beschermers, Hartsvrienden en Governors en met overige particuliere schenkers;

· Opzetten en realiseren van succesvolle nieuwe manieren van schenken en grote particuliere wervingscampagnes;

· Verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van een beleid voor nalatenschappen;

· Coördineren van de Vriendenadministratie en communicatie-uitingen voor Vrienden en relaties in samenwerking met andere afdelingen;

· Zorgen voor een effectief en aantrekkelijk activiteitenprogramma per festivaljaar, met ontvangsten en evenementen tijdens en buiten het festival voor zowel bestaande als potentiële donateurs.


Jouw profiel

· Initiatiefrijk en ambitieus (de targets zijn niet vrijblijvend);

· Een goede, inspirerende gesprekspartner: autonoom, empathisch, creatief, gedreven en representatief in NE + EN;

· Flexibel, doel- en resultaatgericht;

  • WO-/HBO-opleiding en minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring (let op: dit is een harde voorwaarde).

Wat Holland Festival biedt:

Een uitdagende en veelzijdige functie binnen een inspirerende en levendige werkomgeving met een internationale scope.

Je werkt in ons mooie kantoor in hartje Amsterdam, met uitzicht over het IJ, in een klein team van zeer bevlogen professionals die hun eigen expertise inzetten om elk jaar weer een wereldwijd toonaangevend festival neer te zetten.

Het gaat om een functie van 30,4 of 38 uur (0,8 of 1 fte) per week gedurende de maanden juli-mei en 38 uur (1 fte) in juni, met een dienstverband voor 12 maanden, met de intentie tot verlenging voor onbepaalde tijd bij goed functioneren.

Deze functie is ingeschaald in schaal 6 van het eigen salaris- en functiehuis, lopend van €4.872 tot €6.665 per maand op basis van een fulltime aanstelling. Inschaling is afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Daarnaast ontvang je 8% vakantiegeld, heb je recht op 30 vakantiedagen (op basis van een fulltime aanstelling), en neem je deel aan de pensioenregeling via PFZW.

Er is veel ruimte en aandacht voor zowel persoonlijke als professionele groei, met een persoonlijk opleidings- en theaterbudget, en een ruime personeelsregeling voor tickets tijdens het jaarlijkse Holland Festival.




Interesse? Solliciteer nu om jouw expertise in te zetten voor het Holland Festival!

Solliciteren kan door een bijgewerkte cv en motivatiebrief uiterlijk 22 november te uploaden. We zijn geïnteresseerd in mensen met development- of fondsenwervingservaring, maar als je denkt dat deze baan perfect bij jou past en je hebt een andere route genomen: neem dan contact op voor een informeel gesprek, want de juiste persoon is belangrijker dan het juiste cv.

Vroeg solliciteren wordt erg op prijs gesteld. De eerste gespreksronde vindt plaats op 25 en 26 november. De tweede ronde volgt in de week van 1 december. Als je door bent naar de 2e ronde, maakt het uitwerken en presenteren van een casus mogelijk deel uit van de procedure.

Het streven is om uiterlijk 9 december de hele procedure afgerond te hebben.

Het Holland Festival omarmt de perspectievenrijkdom die mensen met verschillende achtergronden samen te bieden hebben, en streeft ernaar als organisatie een afspiegeling te vormen van de samenleving. Mensen van alle achtergronden zijn welkom en worden aangemoedigd te solliciteren.

Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Mathilde Smit, hoofd Development, mathilde.smit@hollandfestival.nl of 020- 2052072.

title: Planning Manager | Al-Futtaim Electric Mobility | BYD
description:
Overview Of The Role:

  • BYD is not just an automaker, it is a global technology company leading electric mobility, battery innovation, and sustainable transport solutions. Guided by our mission “Technological Innovations for a Better Life”, BYD is shaping a zero-emission future worldwide. As part of Al-Futtaim Automotive, you will be at the forefront of this transformation in the UAE.
  • We are seeking an experienced Planning Manager to contribute towards the planned growth and development of the EV Brand (BYD – Polestar – Denza – Yangwang) in its aim to explore untapped opportunities and raise administrative effectiveness, thus optimizing business in an increasingly sophisticated and expanding car market.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and propose order plans and trim ratio plans to determine production volumes by model, channel, grade, and color.
  • Ensure these plans align with and achieve the agreed-upon sales objectives.
  • Prepare and analyze data to negotiate optimally with OEMs for the supply of models.
  • Continuously review supply requirements with channels and management to achieve the desired Month of Stock (MOS) ratio.
  • Prepare and build grade mix plans for each model.
  • Incorporate these plans into monthly orders to maximize revenue.
  • Prepare and forecast accurate trends by analysing past data on colour, grade, and channels.
  • Utilize these insights to maintain an optimum supply across the entire range and grades.
  • Prepare analysis for the logical rationalization of the lineup by reducing the number of materials.
  • Aim to increase efficiency and reduce maintenance costs through these rationalizations.
  • Prepare a comprehensive presentation on the Sales Stock Order Plan (SSOP).
  • Present order recommendations and the rationale behind them to senior management and obtain sign-off on the proposed monthly production volumes.
  • Conduct regular meetings with other departments within AFEMC group (Polestar, BYD, Denza, Yangwang).
  • Align sales forecasting, monthly targets, campaign plans, marketing activities, product changes, and logistics requirements with the order plan.
  • Ensure these efforts collectively maintain the health of the stock.


Skills

Required Skills To Be Successful:

  • Bachelors / Masters Degree with demonstrated experience in planning and numbers.
  • 5 years’ experience in automotive brands.
  • Experience from EV specific brands, especially Chinese desirable.
  • Supply chain knowledge.
  • Driving commercial results with measurable key performance indicators.
  • Proficient in AI tools (CoPilot, Claude), PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI and SAP.
  • Data Analytics tools / usage of AI Tools to delvier faster results (Claude etc.).

About The Team:

  • You will join the Planning and Supply team, supporting BYD, Polestar, Denza and Yangwang within Al-Futtaim Electric Mobility. Working closely with sales, marketing, product, logistics and OEM partners, you will align demand forecasts, monthly orders and model, grade and colour mix plans with sales objectives. You will prepare Sales Stock Order Plan (SSOP) recommendations for senior management approval and coordinate supply requirements to maintain healthy stock levels and the desired Month of Stock (MOS) ratio.

title: Game Economy Designer
description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in video games, with teams spread across the four corners of the world who create original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin's Creed to Rainbow Six, including Just Dance and many more. We believe that diversity of perspectives drives progress for both players and teams. If you are passionate about innovation and want to push the boundaries of entertainment, join our adventure and help us create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As an intermediate game economy designer, you will contribute to economic design and engagement strategies across the entire HD portfolio, promoting the optimization of in-game progression, player retention and microtransaction systems.

You will conduct audits and improve economic models by providing critical analysis and recommendations aimed at increasing average revenue per user (ARPU) as well as retention and reactivation indicators across the entire HD games portfolio. You will lead balancing tests, foster collaboration between teams and leverage emerging technologies, such as AI, to refine game economies.

As a member of the economic design community, you will develop your expertise and promote process improvements and industry best practices.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

- Support HD production teams in designing and improving their monetization strategies and economic models, becoming a trusted partner for questions related to economic design, progression and retention.
- Take part in reviews and audits of economic models, progression systems and retention mechanisms across the HD portfolio.
- Coordinate and take part in economic balancing tests (playtests, quality control), provide hands-on support in collaboration with other support teams, and play a key role in the validation process for GaaS titles.
- Review economic management tools and operational monitoring processes related to progression and economy, leveraging emerging technologies (e.g., AI) and methodologies to help teams optimize their microtransactions and retention.
- Contribute to the economic design community by sharing knowledge, promoting best practices and taking part in process improvement.
- Carry out competitive and benchmarking analyses to share external trends and industry best practices within the organization.
- Strengthen economic design expertise within LRS and the monetization community.

#### Qualifications

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TEAM**

- Experience in game design, ideally with experience in online games or GaaS titles
- Interest in player economy and progression systems, along with basic knowledge in these areas
- Comfort using quantitative data and simulation tools
- A genuine passion for video games, especially competitive or online titles
- Strong analytical and mathematical skills
- Ability to model, adjust and simulate reward and progression systems
- Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and data-driven decision-making
- Ability to collaborate and communicate constructively with design, monetization and analytics teams
- Attention to detail, with the ability to maintain and iterate on complex, interdependent systems
- Good understanding of player motivation factors, learning theories, player psychology and pacing of progression
- Knowledge of acquisition, retention and monetization levers, as well as video game business models
- Knowledge of modeling tools (Excel, VBA, Tableau, simulation tools, etc.)
- Ability to conduct competitive benchmarking and synthesize it into concrete recommendations
- Constant drive for improvement (shows initiative, takes on challenges)
- Creative mindset, with the ability to propose features aligned with the game's vision

title: Landfill Attendant
description:
Under the supervision of Lead Hand, Landfill, the Landfill Attendant will assist customers with recycling, material diversion, and waste disposal as well as the day-to-day operations of the Clairmont Centre for Recycling and Waste Management.

This is a front-line position with continual contact with clients and requiring good interpersonal skills with the public and contractors.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Able to identify recycled products, household hazardous waste, and diversion items.
  • Sort, separate, and package recycled or diverted products for transport.
  • Coordinate with contractors for the transportation of materials off site for further processing.
  • Assist customers with waste disposal questions and direction. Including recycling and recycling awareness, identification and separation of hazardous, prohibited, and restricted wastes, provide assistance, and guide users to the appropriate disposal areas.
  • Assist customers with recycling and diversion materials sorting, placement in the various designated areas, and proper use of transfer station areas.
  • Assist the Lead Hand, Transfer Stations, in tracking, reporting, and maintaining records for the materials recycled or diverted through County supported initiatives.
  • Maintenance and cleaning of the transfer station components, bins and equipment, Shelve and Share, Recycle Discovery Site, scale, diversion areas, landfill facilities, roads, and grounds.
  • Conduct load checks for fugitive waste and ensure customers are placing materials in the proper areas.
  • Educate and promote waste diversion with the facility users.
  • Scale operation and heavy equipment operation (skid steer, tool cat).
  • Ensure all work-related information is kept confidential as per policy and in accordance with the Access to Information and Protection of Privacy Act.
  • Comply with records management practices as stated in the Records Management Policy.
  • Other duties as required.

Education and Experience:

  • A valid Class 5 driver's license.
  • Grade 12 or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Clean criminal records check and driver's abstract.
  • Farm machinery and/or heavy equipment operation experience considered an asset.
  • Customer service experience and ability to interact positively and respectfully with waste haulers, members of the public, and co-workers.
  • Previous landfill, transfer station, or recycling experience is an asset.
  • Valid or ability to achieve Landfill Certification and/or Transfer Station Certification an asset.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Ability to work compressed work weeks, including weekend work and overtime.
  • Must be proficient in MS Office and able to learn other programs.
  • Ability to undertake labour such as lifting, sweeping, cleaning, and shoveling.
  • Customer Service principles and practices.
  • Ability to work as a member of a team.
  • Ability to interact in a professional and respectful manner, communicate instructions, educate, and assist customers daily.
  • Tact and sound judgment.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.

The County of Grande Prairie provides a competitive compensation package, including benefits, paid vacation and participation in the Local Authorities Pension Plan (LAPP). We actively support professional development opportunities and foster an engaging work environment.

  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) allowance
  • County-branded clothing allowance
  • Personal fuel card with discounted price
  • County campground discount

Shift Details: This full-time, permanent position entails a 40-hour work week, on a two-week rotation of shifts.

Hourly Pay Rate: $34.24 to $40.28 per hour.

As part of the County of Grande Prairie’s commitment to provide a safe and healthy workplace, we encourage and support a scent-free environment.

title: QA QC ENGINEER
description:
Job Summary

The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for implementing and monitoring quality assurance and quality control processes across construction and MEP projects to ensure compliance with project specifications, international standards, and client requirements. This role ensures that works are executed with the highest level of quality, safety, and efficiency while minimizing rework and delays.

Candidate Profile

Responsibilities

1. Quality Planning & Documentation

  • Review and implement the project’s Quality Plan, ITPs (Inspection & Test Plans), method statements, and related documents.
  • Prepare and maintain QA/QC records including inspection reports, NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports), and corrective action plans.
  • Coordinate with consultants/clients for approvals of QA/QC documentation.

2. Inspections & Testing

  • Conduct inspections for incoming materials, in-process work, and final deliverables to ensure compliance with specifications.
  • Monitor subcontractor works to verify adherence to project quality standards.
  • Arrange and witness laboratory/material testing as per project requirements.
  • Ensure calibration and certification of testing equipment.

3. Compliance & Standards

  • Ensure all works comply with relevant codes, standards (ISO, ASTM, BS, ACI, etc.), and contractual requirements.
  • Support the implementation of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems within the project.
  • Report deviations and propose corrective/preventive actions.

4. Coordination & Communication

  • Liaise with site engineers, project managers, and consultants to resolve quality issues.
  • Conduct regular QA/QC meetings to review progress, NCRs, and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with HSE teams to ensure integration of quality and safety standards.

5. Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Promote awareness of quality requirements among project staff and subcontractors.
  • Conduct toolbox talks and quality awareness training sessions.


Skills

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or related field
  • Certification in QA/QC or ISO 9001 (Lead Auditor preferred)
  • Strong knowledge of international standards (ASTM, BS, ISO, etc.)
  • Proficiency in MS Office and QA/QC documentation systems

Required Experiences

Minimum 7 years of QA/QC experience in construction projects

UAE experience is mandatory, preferably in Abu Dhabi

Previous experience on Aldar projects is highly preferred

Experience in:

  • Building construction (villas, residential/commercial towers) or infrastructure projects
  • QA/QC processes including inspections, testing, and documentation

Strong knowledge of:

  • Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs)
  • Method Statements and material submittals
  • NCR management and corrective actions

Experience working with:

  • Consultants, contractors, and third-party testing labs
